幼.mnemonic: Muscle like sewing thread — おさない. 幼稚園: where the threads tangle happily.

欲.etymology: Phono-semantic: 谷 'valley' (phonetic ヨク) + 欠 'gaping' — an emptiness that gapes like a valley: desire, want.
欲.mnemonic: A hunger with a canyon's acoustics — ほしい. 欲しい: the valley asking politely.

翌.etymology: Phono-semantic: wings (羽) + 立 (phonetic ヨク) — the day standing ready on the wing: the next, the following.
翌.mnemonic: Tomorrow already perched and flexing — ヨク. 翌日: the day that takes off at midnight.

乱.etymology: Simplified from 亂: hands trying to untangle a snarled skein — chaos: disorder, riot.
乱.mnemonic: A tongue wagging on a loose hinge — みだれる. 乱れる: hair, ranks, hearts — anything that had order.

卵.etymology: Pictograph: paired egg-sacs with the yolk-dots inside — eggs, roe.
卵.mnemonic: Two eggs drawn mid-cluster, dots for yolks — たまご. 卵かけご飯: the pictograph, cracked over rice.

lesson_examples.jp: 朝（あさ）ごはんに　卵（たまご）を　たべます。
lesson_examples.en: I eat an egg for breakfast.

裏.etymology: Phono-semantic: 里 (phonetic リ) tucked inside the split garment (衣) — the lining side: the back, the hidden side.
裏.mnemonic: The village sewn into the coat's lining — うら. 裏口: the door on the lining side of the house.

律.etymology: Compound: the road (彳) ruled out by the brush (聿) — the written measure all steps must keep: law, meter, rhythm.
律.mnemonic: Rules written in bar lines — リツ. 法律 for citizens, リズム for drummers: same grid.

lesson_examples.jp: みんなで　法律（ほうりつ）を　まもります。

論.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 侖 'well-ordered' (phonetic ロン) — words stacked in order: reasoned argument, discourse.
論.mnemonic: Claims shelved in strict sequence — ロン. 論文: the shelf, footnoted; 議論: two shelves colliding.

遺.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 貴 (phonetic イ) — the precious thing left on the road behind: to leave, bequeath.
遺.mnemonic: What stays when the traveler goes on — イ. 遺産: the suitcase left to you; 世界遺産: left to everyone.

沿.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 㕣 (phonetic エン) — following the water's edge: along.
沿.mnemonic: The path that copies the river — そう. 沿線: everything strung along the train line.

lesson_examples.jp: 川（かわ）沿（ぞ）いを　歩（ある）きます。

恩.etymology: Phono-semantic: 因 'what one rests on' (phonetic オン) + heart (心) — the kindness one's heart rests on: obligation-laden grace.
恩.mnemonic: The favor that became part of your foundations — オン. 恩人: the person your heart still leans on.

我.etymology: Pictograph: a toothed halberd, borrowed since the oracle bones for the first person: I, the self.
我.mnemonic: The self, drawn as a weapon — われ. 我々: two blades walking together.

lesson_examples.jp: 我（われ）を　わすれて　走（はし）りました。

閣.etymology: Phono-semantic: gate (門) + 各 (phonetic カク) — the high pavilion above the gate: tower; the ministers gathered there: cabinet.
閣.mnemonic: The gilded upper room — カク. 金閣寺 shines; 内閣 governs.

株.etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + 朱 (phonetic シュ) — the stump that stays and sprouts: a stump; the standing share of an enterprise: stock.
株.mnemonic: The stump that keeps paying shoots — かぶ. 株式会社: a forest of stumps, incorporated.

揮.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 軍 (phonetic キ) — the hand that signals the army: to wave, wield, conduct.
揮.mnemonic: One raised hand moves the whole formation — キ. 指揮者: the conductor's entire job description.

貴.etymology: Compound: goods lifted in both hands over treasure (貝) — held high: precious, noble; honorific 'your' (貴社).
貴.mnemonic: Held above the money it outranks — とうとい. 貴重品: the hotel-safe kanji.

郷.etymology: Pictograph origin: two people facing each other over a shared dish — the community that eats together: home village.
郷.mnemonic: Dinner facing familiar faces — きょう, ゴウ. 故郷: the table you grew up at.

lesson_examples.jp: 故（こ）郷（きょう）に　帰（かえ）ります。
lesson_examples.en: I'm going back to my hometown.

筋.etymology: Compound: fibers like bamboo (⺮) in the flesh (月) with strength (力) — sinew, muscle; the fiber of an argument: the plot, the logic.
筋.mnemonic: Bamboo-fiber cables under the skin — すじ. 筋肉 lifts; 筋が通る: the plot holds.

系.etymology: Compound ideograph: a hand holding threads together — the connected line: lineage, system.
系.mnemonic: One thread pinched at the top, everything hangs from it — ケイ. 文系・理系: which thread you hang from at 18.

激.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 敫 (phonetic ゲキ) — water dashing on rock: violent, intense.
激.mnemonic: The rapids section of any emotion — はげしい. 激安, 激辛: intensity as marketing.

lesson_examples.jp: 激（はげ）しい　運（うん）動（どう）を　しました。

穴.etymology: Pictograph: the mouth of a dwelling-cave — a hole; the radical of all excavations (空, 究, 窓).
穴.mnemonic: The cave door our ancestors called home — あな. 穴場: the hole worth knowing about.

憲.etymology: Compound: the standard displayed under the roof, watched by eye and heart — the fundamental law: constitution.
憲.mnemonic: The rules above even the rulers — ケン. 憲法: the roof over the law.

絹.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 肙 (phonetic ケン) — the worm's thread: silk.
絹.mnemonic: The worm's lifework, unwound — きぬ. 絹の道: the Silk Road, literally.

厳.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 嚴): a craggy cliff phonetic — forbidding as a rock face: strict, severe, solemn.
厳.mnemonic: The cliff face of authority — きびしい. 厳しい先生: geology in human form.

lesson_examples.jp: 先（せん）生（せい）は　厳（きび）しいです。

源.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 原 'spring at the cliff' (phonetic ゲン) — 原 restored to its waters: the source.
源.mnemonic: 原 with the water switched back on — みなもと. 資源, 電源: sources you drill and sources you plug.

己.etymology: Pictograph: a coiled cord — borrowed since antiquity for the self: I, oneself.
己.mnemonic: The line that loops back to its own start — おのれ. 自己: the self, squared.

lesson_examples.jp: 自（じ）己（こ）ベストを　目（め）指（ざ）します。
lesson_examples.en: I'm aiming for my personal best.

后.etymology: Pictograph: the mirror image of 司 'director' — the sovereign consort: empress; also 'after' in 午後's ancestor.
后.mnemonic: 司 reflected: command from the other throne — コウ. 皇后: the empress beside the emperor.

孝.etymology: Compound ideograph: the child (子) carrying the elder (耂) — the young supporting the old: filial piety.
孝.mnemonic: The child shoulders the grandparent — コウ. 親孝行: paying the oldest debt.

皇.etymology: Compound: radiance (白) over the king (王) — the king with the shining crown: emperor.
皇.mnemonic: A king, backlit — コウ. 天皇: the shining above the crown above the land.

鋼.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 岡 'ridge' (phonetic コウ) — metal hard as the ridge line: steel.
鋼.mnemonic: Iron that did strength training — はがね. 鉄鋼: industry's spine.

穀.etymology: Phono-semantic: husk (殻) + grain (禾) — grains in their husks: cereals.
穀.mnemonic: Everything that comes armored in a husk — コク. 穀物: the pantry's foundation.

lesson_examples.jp: 穀（こく）物（もつ）を　育（そだ）てます。

裁.etymology: Phono-semantic: cutting (𢦏, phonetic サイ) + cloth (衣) — cutting cloth to measure: to tailor; cutting cases to measure: to judge.
裁.mnemonic: Scissors through fabric, gavel through disputes — さばく. 裁判所: the tailor shop for arguments.

策.etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 朿 (phonetic サク) — the bamboo slips of counsel: a plan, a policy; originally also the riding crop.
策.mnemonic: Plans written on slips, with a spur inside — サク. 対策: the counter-scheme.

蚕.etymology: Compound (simplified from 蠶): the insect (虫) sent from heaven (天) — the worm that spins wealth: silkworm.
蚕.mnemonic: Heaven's bug — かいこ. Its thread bought empires: 蚕 over 糸.

姿.etymology: Phono-semantic: 次 (phonetic シ) + woman (女) — the shape one presents: figure, appearance.
姿.mnemonic: The silhouette before the name registers — すがた. 後ろ姿: the figure walking away.

至.etymology: Pictograph: an arrow arrived at the ground — reaching the very point: to arrive; the utmost (至急).
至.mnemonic: The arrow can go no further — いたる. 冬至: the sun's arrival at its southern limit.

視.etymology: Phono-semantic: 示 (phonetic シ) + 見 'see' — looking with intent: to view, regard.
視.mnemonic: Seeing, upgraded to watching — シ. 無視: aiming the gaze away on purpose.

磁.etymology: Phono-semantic: stone (石) + 茲 (phonetic ジ) — the stone that draws: magnet; the fine fired stone: porcelain.
磁.mnemonic: The rock with invisible threads (茲) pulling — ジ. 磁石: the pointing stone.

射.etymology: Compound ideograph: the body (身) drawn and the hand (寸) releasing — loosing the arrow: to shoot, emit.
射.mnemonic: Whole body behind the release — シャ. 注射: the clinical arrow; 反射: light shooting back.

尺.etymology: Pictograph: a hand spanning a length — the shaku, the old Japanese foot (~30cm): measure.
尺.mnemonic: Thumb to little finger: the carpenter's ruler before rulers — シャク. 尺八: the flute, one-shaku-eight.

樹.etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + a phonetic (ジュ) — the standing living tree, planted and kept: timber.
樹.mnemonic: 木's ceremonial full name — ジュ. 樹木, 街路樹: trees with paperwork.

宗.etymology: Compound ideograph: the altar (示) under the roof (宀) — the ancestral shrine: the founding line: sect, religion.
宗.mnemonic: The altar the whole clan shares — シュウ. 宗教: the roofed altar, systematized.

就.etymology: Compound: moving to the capital's high ground (京) — taking one's place: to take up (a post), to settle.
就.mnemonic: Arriving where your career lives — シュウ. 就職: settling into the harness.

衆.etymology: Compound ideograph: many people (three 人) under the sun/eye — the multitude: the masses.
衆.mnemonic: Three means everyone — シュウ. 衆議院: the house of the many.

従.etymology: Compound (simplified from 從): one person walking behind another (从) on the road (彳) — to follow, comply.
従.mnemonic: Footsteps matched to footsteps — したがう. 従業員: those who walk the company's pace.

lesson_examples.jp: コーチの　指（し）示（じ）に　従（したが）います。

縦.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 従 (phonetic ジュウ) — the warp thread running lengthwise: vertical.
縦.mnemonic: The thread that follows gravity — たて. 縦書き: Japanese, written the tall way.

縮.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 宿 (phonetic シュク) — cloth drawn in on itself: to shrink, contract.
縮.mnemonic: The sweater that came back from the wash a size smaller — ちぢむ. 短縮: schedules doing the same.

熟.etymology: Phono-semantic: 孰 (phonetic ジュク) + fire (灬) — cooked through: ripe, matured, practiced.
熟.mnemonic: Slow heat until fully done — ジュク. 熟語: word-pairs aged together; 塾: the cram school homophone next door.

lesson_examples.jp: よく　熟（じゅく）した　果（くだ）物（もの）です。

傷.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + a phonetic (ショウ) — the hurt carried on a person: wound, damage.
傷.mnemonic: The mark the story leaves — きず. 傷つく: hearts and knees alike.

lesson_examples.jp: 傷（きず）に　薬（くすり）を　つけます。
lesson_examples.en: I put medicine on the wound.

障.etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 章 (phonetic ショウ) — the wall in the way: to obstruct.
障.mnemonic: A rampart where the road wanted to be — さわる. 故障: the machine's private rampart.

仁.etymology: Compound ideograph: person (亻) + two (二) — what passes between two people: benevolence, the Confucian heart.
仁.mnemonic: Kindness needs a minimum of two — ジン. 仁: ethics in three strokes.

垂.etymology: Pictograph: branches heavy to the ground — hanging down: to droop, dangle.
垂.mnemonic: The willow's posture — たれる. 垂直: hanging true — the plumb line's kanji.

推.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 隹 (phonetic スイ) — pushing forward: to推 recommend; pushing thought forward: to infer.
推.mnemonic: Give the idea a shove and see where it rolls — おす. 推理: detective work; 推し: your favorite, shoved at everyone.

lesson_examples.jp: 新（あたら）しい　方（ほう）法（ほう）を　推（すい）薦（せん）します。

寸.etymology: Ideograph: a hand with a dot at the pulse — one thumb-width below the wrist: the sun (~3cm): small measure.
寸.mnemonic: The doctor's finger finding the pulse: precision — スン. 寸法: measurements, tailor-grade.

lesson_examples.jp: 寸（すん）法（ぽう）を　はかります。

盛.etymology: Phono-semantic: 成 (phonetic セイ) + dish (皿) — the dish piled to completion: heaped, flourishing.
盛.mnemonic: Rice mounded past the rim — もる, さかん. 大盛り: prosperity, per bowl.

聖.etymology: Compound: the one whose ear (耳) hears heaven and whose mouth (口) speaks it — the sage: holy.
聖.mnemonic: Ears open upward, words passed down — セイ. 聖書: the transcript.

誠.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 成 (phonetic セイ) — words that become deeds: sincerity.
誠.mnemonic: Say it, then be it — まこと. 誠実: the audit both passed.

舌.etymology: Pictograph: the tongue extended from the mouth (口).
舌.mnemonic: Stuck out for the doctor — した. 舌 does the tasting in 味's world.

宣.etymology: Compound: the ruler's word spreading (亘) from under the palace roof (宀) — to proclaim.
宣.mnemonic: Announced from the palace steps — セン. 宣伝: proclamation with a budget.

lesson_examples.jp: たいかいの　開（かい）始（し）を　宣（せん）言（げん）します。
lesson_examples.en: The start of the tournament is declared.

染.etymology: Compound ideograph: cloth dipped in tree-sap water nine (九) times — steeped: to dye, to seep in.
染.mnemonic: Nine baths in the vat until the color stays — そめる. 感染: the unwanted kind of soaking-in.

銭.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 戔 'pared small' (phonetic セン) — metal cut small: coins, small change.
銭.mnemonic: Metal shaved into pocket money — ぜに. 銭湯: a coin, a bath, a century of custom.

創.etymology: Phono-semantic: 倉 (phonetic ソウ) + blade (刂) — the first cut into new material: to originate, found; also a wound.
創.mnemonic: Creation starts with an incision — ソウ. 創造: the blade's noble career.

奏.etymology: Compound: both hands offering up to heaven — presenting before the throne: to perform, play music.
奏.mnemonic: Music lifted upward like an offering — かなでる. 演奏: the concert kanji.

誕.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 延 (phonetic タン) — originally 'extravagant talk'; settled on the grandest announcement: a birth.
誕.mnemonic: The announcement worth exaggerating — タン. 誕生日: the yearly re-proclamation.

忠.etymology: Phono-semantic: 中 'center' (phonetic チュウ) + heart (心) — the heart held dead center: loyalty.
忠.mnemonic: A heart that doesn't wobble — チュウ. 忠犬ハチ公: the statue of this kanji.

潮.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 朝 (phonetic チョウ) — the morning water that comes and goes: the tide.
潮.mnemonic: The sea's commute — しお. 風潮: the tide, applied to opinions.

腸.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 昜 (phonetic チョウ) — the long coiled organ: intestines.
腸.mnemonic: The body's longest corridor — チョウ. 大腸・小腸: the plumbing diagram.

敵.etymology: Phono-semantic: 啇 (phonetic テキ) + 攵 'strike' — the one you trade blows with: enemy, rival.
敵.mnemonic: Whoever the stick is pointed at — かたき. 素敵, oddly: 'enemy-class' good — stunning.

lesson_examples.jp: 敵（てき）に　勝（か）ちました。

糖.etymology: Phono-semantic: rice (米) + 唐 (phonetic トウ) — sweetness refined from grain, via Tang China: sugar.
糖.mnemonic: Rice's sweetest descendant — トウ. 砂糖: sand-sugar, the pantry pair.

討.etymology: Compound: words (言) + hand (寸) — the punitive expedition declared and executed: to attack; to examine (検討).
討.mnemonic: First the proclamation, then the strike — うつ. 検討します: the boardroom's polite siege.

納.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 内 (phonetic ノウ) — brought inside and stored: to deliver, pay in, accept.
納.mnemonic: The tribute tucked into the storehouse — おさめる. 納豆: beans put away — fermented history.

派.etymology: Compound: water (氵) branching (𠂢) — a stream split from the main: a faction; to send off a branch: dispatch.
派.mnemonic: The river splits and each branch names itself — ハ. 派手: the loudest branch.

lesson_examples.jp: 立（りっ）派（ぱ）な　演（えん）技（ぎ）でした。

俳.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 非 (phonetic ハイ) — the performer of light verse and play: actor; the verse: haiku.
俳.mnemonic: A person balancing on 非's two wings — ハイ. 俳句 and 俳優: seventeen syllables, or a whole career.

肺.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 市 (phonetic ハイ) — the paired breathing organs: lungs.
肺.mnemonic: The chest's twin markets, trading air — ハイ. 肺活量: their turnover.

班.etymology: Compound ideograph: jade (王王) divided by the blade (刂) — shares distributed to groups: a squad, a team.
班.mnemonic: The treasure split, one piece per team — ハン. 班長: keeper of the piece.

秘.etymology: Phono-semantic: originally altar (示) + 必 (phonetic ヒ) — what the gods keep to themselves: secret.
秘.mnemonic: Locked with a stake through it (必) — ひめる. 秘密: the kanji that begs to be told.

俵.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 表 (phonetic ヒョウ) — the straw bale a person shoulders: a bag of rice; the sumo ring's border.
俵.mnemonic: The rice bale, and the ring made of them — たわら. 土俵: where sumo lives.

奮.etymology: Compound ideograph: a great bird (大+隹) beating up from the field (田) — bursting upward: roused, energized.
奮.mnemonic: Wings exploding out of the paddy — ふるう. 興奮: takeoff, emotionally.

陛.etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + a phonetic — the steps of the throne one addresses from below: Majesty (陛下).
陛.mnemonic: You speak to the stairs, not the throne — ヘイ. 陛下: 'below the steps', etiquette fossilized.

lesson_examples.jp: 陛（へい）下（か）に　あいさつを　します。

幕.etymology: Phono-semantic: 莫 (phonetic マク) + cloth (巾) — the great hanging cloth: curtain; the general's curtained camp: the shogunate (幕府).
幕.mnemonic: The cloth that hid a government — マク. 幕が上がる: history and theater share the verb.

密.etymology: Phono-semantic: 宓 (phonetic ミツ) + mountain (山) — hidden close in the hills: secret; packed close: dense.
密.mnemonic: Deep in the mountains, packed tight — ミツ. 秘密 and 密度: hidden things and crowded ones.

盟.etymology: Compound: the oath sworn over the blood dish (皿) under heaven's lights (明) — a sworn alliance.
盟.mnemonic: The pact sealed at the bright bowl — メイ. 同盟, 連盟: leagues great and sporting.

模.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 莫 (phonetic モ) — the wooden mold things are copied from: model, pattern.
模.mnemonic: The template everything traces — モ. 模様 patterns cloth; 規模 patterns scale.

訳.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 譯): words (言) + a phonetic — words carried across languages: to translate; the sense behind words: reason (わけ).
訳.mnemonic: Meaning measured into another tongue — やく, わけ. 申し訳ない: 'no explanation can be measured out' — the deep apology.

覧.etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + 見 'see' — looking over the whole: to peruse, view.
覧.mnemonic: Eyes sweeping the full inventory — ラン. ご覧ください: the honorific sweep.

臨.etymology: Compound: the bowed eye (臣) bent over many things (品) — overlooking from above: to face, attend, be present at.
臨.mnemonic: Leaning over the situation in person — のぞむ. 臨時: presence improvised — 'temporary'.

朗.etymology: Phono-semantic: 良 (phonetic ロウ) + moon (月) — clear as moonlight: bright, sonorous.
朗.mnemonic: A voice with moonlight in it — ほがらか. 朗読: reading aloud, silver-toned.

依.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 衣 'clothes' (phonetic イ) — leaning on what wraps you: to depend on.
依.mnemonic: Wrapped in someone else's coat — イ. 依頼: asking to borrow their sleeve too.

偉.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 韋 (phonetic イ) — a person of uncommon stature: great, admirable.
偉.mnemonic: Standing a size larger than the crowd — えらい. 偉い!: the pat on the head, and the statues later.

lesson_examples.jp: あの　人（ひと）は　とても　偉（えら）い　学者（がくしゃ）です。
lesson_examples.en: That person is a very eminent scholar.

違.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 韋 'feet circling opposite ways' (phonetic イ) — paths that miss each other: to differ, be wrong.
違.mnemonic: Two patrols circling the wall in opposite directions, never meeting — ちがう. 違います: politely, 'our paths differ'.

lesson_examples.jp: 答（こた）えが　違（ちが）います。

鋭.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 兌 (phonetic エイ) — metal ground to a point: sharp, keen.
鋭.mnemonic: The blade's edge and the mind's — するどい. 鋭い質問: the question that draws blood.

越.etymology: Phono-semantic: run (走) + 戉 (phonetic エツ) — running past the barrier: to cross, exceed.
越.mnemonic: Vault the checkpoint at a sprint — こえる. 引っ越し: crossing over with all your boxes.

煙.etymology: Phono-semantic: fire (火) + 垔 (phonetic エン) — what fire sends up: smoke.
煙.mnemonic: Fire's signature, drifting west over the dirt — けむり. 禁煙: the signature forbidden indoors.

汚.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + a phonetic — water gone stagnant and foul: dirty, to stain.
汚.mnemonic: The puddle nobody steps in twice — きたない. 汚れる: the white shirt's destiny.

lesson_examples.jp: 手（て）が　汚（よご）れて　います。

奥.etymology: Compound: the grain stored deepest under the roof — the innermost recess: the interior, the far back.
奥.mnemonic: Past every sliding door, the last room — おく. 奥さん: the one who governs it, by old convention.

押.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 甲 (phonetic オウ) — the hand bearing down: to push, press, stamp.
押.mnemonic: Palm flat on the shell, weight in — おす. Doors again: 押 push, 引 pull — the daily pair.

欧.etymology: Phono-semantic: 区 (phonetic オウ) + 欠 — chosen purely for sound to transcribe 'Europe' (欧羅巴): the West across Eurasia.
欧.mnemonic: The district (区) that left everyone open-mouthed (欠) with its cathedrals — オウ. 欧米: Europe-and-America in one breath.

菓.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 果 'fruit' (phonetic カ) — sweets made where fruit left off: confectionery.
菓.mnemonic: Fruit, perfected by a pastry chef — カ. お菓子: the orchard's decadent grandchildren.

介.etymology: Pictograph: a person between two dividing lines — wedged between parties: to mediate; armor pressed on the body; shellfish in shells.
介.mnemonic: Squeezed exactly in the middle — カイ. 紹介: wedging two strangers into acquaintance.

皆.etymology: Compound: people lined up (比) speaking as one (白, here 'declare') — the whole company: all, everybody.
皆.mnemonic: The line-up answers in unison — みんな. 皆さん: the polite roll call.

較.etymology: Phono-semantic: cart (車) + 交 (phonetic カク) — chariots matched shaft to shaft: to compare.
較.mnemonic: Two carts drag-raced to settle it — カク. 比較: the formal word for lining them up.

乾.etymology: Phono-semantic: sunrise over the banner (龺) + a phonetic — moisture drawn off by the climbing sun: to dry.
乾.mnemonic: Sun up, laundry out, puddles gone — かわく. 乾杯!: draining the glass dry, cheerfully.

換.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 奐 (phonetic カン) — one thing handed out for another: to exchange, convert.
換.mnemonic: Old one out, new one in, same hand — かえる. 乗り換え: doing it with entire trains.

lesson_examples.jp: 電車（でんしゃ）を　乗（の)り換（か）えます。

汗.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 干 (phonetic カン) — the body's water on its way to drying: sweat.
汗.mnemonic: Water queued at the skin's drying rack — あせ. 汗をかく: summer's subscription service.

環.etymology: Phono-semantic: jade (王) + 瞏 (phonetic カン) — the jade ring with no start or end: a circle, a surrounding.
環.mnemonic: The ring that comes all the way around you — カン. 環境: the ring you live inside.

甘.etymology: Pictograph: a mouth with something held on the tongue — savoring: sweet; going easy: indulgent.
甘.mnemonic: Tongue pinning the candy in place — あまい. 甘える: sweetness as a strategy.

lesson_examples.jp: この　お菓（か）子（し）は　甘（あま）いです。

含.etymology: Phono-semantic: 今 (phonetic ガン) + mouth (口) — held in the mouth unswallowed: to contain, include.
含.mnemonic: In the mouth, not yet down the hatch: included but pending — ふくむ. 税込み cousins: the price 含む everything.

祈.etymology: Phono-semantic: altar (ネ) + 斤 (phonetic キ) — asking at the altar: to pray, to wish.
祈.mnemonic: At the shrine, palms together, one precise request — いのる. 祈り: the axe-sharp kind of hoping.

喫.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 契 (phonetic キツ) — taking in by mouth: to eat, drink, smoke.
喫.mnemonic: The mouth signs the contract — キツ. 喫茶店: consumption with saucers; 喫煙: with regrets.

詰.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 吉 (phonetic キツ) — pressed until nothing more fits: to stuff, cram; to press with questions.
詰.mnemonic: Packed to the click of the lid — つめる. 缶詰: the tin; 詰め込み勉強: the student version.

巨.etymology: Pictograph: a giant carpenter's square held at the middle — outsized: gigantic.
巨.mnemonic: A ruler too big for any hand — キョ. 巨大: measured with that ruler.

lesson_examples.jp: 巨（きょ）大（だい）な　木（き）が　あります。

叫.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 丩 (phonetic キョウ) — the voice wrung out at full force: to shout, scream.
叫.mnemonic: The mouth twisted like a wrung towel — さけぶ. 叫び: the sound with no polite form.

恐.etymology: Phono-semantic: 巩 (phonetic キョウ) + heart (心) — the heart gripped: fear, dread.
恐.mnemonic: Something takes the heart in both hands and squeezes — おそれる. 恐竜: 'the dreadful dragons'; 恐れ入ります: fear, weaponized as politeness.

挟.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 夾 'one flanked by two' (phonetic キョウ) — held from both sides: to pinch, insert between.
挟.mnemonic: Caught between finger and thumb — はさむ. The bookmark's whole career.

lesson_examples.jp: パンに　ハムを　挟（はさ）みます。
lesson_examples.en: I put ham between the bread.

況.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 兄 (phonetic キョウ) — how the waters stand: the state of things: situation.
況.mnemonic: Check the river's mood before crossing — キョウ. 状況: today's water report for everything.

狭.etymology: Phono-semantic: 犭 + 夾 (phonetic キョウ) — squeezed from both sides: narrow, tight.
狭.mnemonic: The alley the dog fills wall to wall — せまい. 狭い部屋: Tokyo's default setting.

lesson_examples.jp: この　道（みち）は　狭（せま）いです。

偶.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 禺 (phonetic グウ) — a matched figure, a double: pair, even number; meetings that pair up by chance: accidental.
偶.mnemonic: Bumping into your double at the corner — グウ. 偶然: coincidence, the universe's even numbers.

lesson_examples.jp: まちで　偶然（ぐうぜん）　ともだちに　あいました。
lesson_examples.en: I met a friend by chance in town.

隅.etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 禺 (phonetic グウ) — where the walls meet: a corner, a nook.
隅.mnemonic: The angle the broom always misses — すみ. 隅々まで: into every last one.

lesson_examples.jp: 部屋（へや）の　隅（すみ）に　置（お）いて　ください。
lesson_examples.en: Please put it in the corner of the room.

掘.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 屈 'bent' (phonetic クツ) — bent over, working downward: to dig.
掘.mnemonic: Back bent, dirt flying — ほる. 発掘: digging with a permit and a brush.

靴.etymology: Phono-semantic: leather (革) + 化 (phonetic カ) — hide transformed for the feet: shoes, boots.
靴.mnemonic: Leather reincarnated (化) as footwear — くつ. 靴を脱ぐ: the threshold ritual.

傾.etymology: Compound: person (亻) + 頃 'head atilt' — the whole figure tipping: to lean, incline.
傾.mnemonic: The tower, the listener, the argument: all tipping — かたむく. 傾向: which way things lean lately.

恵.etymology: Compound: a generous heart (心) beneath — kindness bestowed: favor, blessing.
恵.mnemonic: The heart that gives without invoicing — めぐみ. 知恵: the mind's version of the gift.

迎.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 卬 'facing up' (phonetic ゲイ) — going out to meet: to welcome.
迎.mnemonic: Down the path to meet them halfway — むかえる. お迎え: the pickup at the station, the kanji of waiting parents.

lesson_examples.jp: 駅（えき）まで　迎（むか）えに　行（い）きます。
lesson_examples.en: I'll go to the station to pick you up.

肩.etymology: Compound: the body's door-frame (戸) of flesh (月) — where loads hang: the shoulder.
肩.mnemonic: The body's lintel — かた. 肩こり: the lintel complaining, nationally.

賢.etymology: Phono-semantic: 臤 'capable' (phonetic ケン) + 貝 — capability worth treasure: wise, clever.
賢.mnemonic: Smart enough that people pay for the opinion — かしこい. 賢い: the compliment with interest.

軒.etymology: Phono-semantic: cart (車) + 干 (phonetic ケン) — originally the carriage's raised canopy; the house's overhang: eaves; houses counted by their eaves.
軒.mnemonic: Count the rooflines down the street — けん. 一軒, 二軒: houses tallied by their hat brims.

枯.etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + 古 'old' (phonetic コ) — the tree gone old and dry: to wither.
枯.mnemonic: The tree that turned to paper standing up — かれる. 枯れ葉: autumn's confetti.

雇.etymology: Phono-semantic: 戸 (phonetic コ) + bird (隹) — originally a migratory bird whose seasons set farm work: to hire.
雇.mnemonic: The bird shows up each season, and gets put on payroll — やとう. 雇用: employment, feathers optional.

互.etymology: Pictograph: two hooks meshed together — each holding the other: mutual, reciprocal.
互.mnemonic: Neither hook works alone — たがい. お互いに: the handshake, drawn.

御.etymology: Compound: attending on the move (彳) — managing the lord's horses; the honorific prefix (御〜, お/ご) grown from that service.
御.mnemonic: The polish applied before any noun meets a superior — ご, お, ギョ. ご飯, お茶, 御社: service in prefix form.

更.etymology: Pictograph: the night-watch drum struck again — the watch renewed: to renew; still more: further; deep into the night (更ける).
更.mnemonic: Another watch, another drumbeat — さらに. 更新: hitting refresh, formally.

硬.etymology: Phono-semantic: stone (石) + 更 (phonetic コウ) — stone-firm: hard, stiff.
硬.mnemonic: Refreshed and still rock solid — かたい. 硬貨: coins, the hard kind of money.

肯.etymology: Compound: the meat that yields at the joint (止+月) — where things give way: to consent, affirm.
肯.mnemonic: The joint bends: yes — コウ. 肯定: agreement with a grammar section.

荒.etymology: Phono-semantic: 艹 + 巟 'flood over lost land' (phonetic コウ) — fields gone to weed and water: wild, rough.
荒.mnemonic: The farm after ten years of nobody — あらい. 荒れる: weather, skin, and meetings all do it.

lesson_examples.jp: 海（うみ）が　荒（あ）れて　います。

郊.etymology: Phono-semantic: 交 (phonetic コウ) + city (阝) — where town crosses into country: the suburbs.
郊.mnemonic: The last crosswalk before the fields — コウ. 郊外: commuter-belt kanji.

腰.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 要 (phonetic ヨウ — itself originally a waist) — the body's pivot restored to flesh: hips, lower back.
腰.mnemonic: 要 was the waist all along; add the body and it aches — こし. 腰が痛い: the pivot filing a complaint.

込.etymology: A kokuji — made in Japan: movement (辶) + enter (入) — pressing in: crowded; the 'into' of compound verbs (申し込む, 詰め込む).
込.mnemonic: Everyone entering at once, nobody exiting — こむ. 申込み: pressing yourself into a form.

婚.etymology: Phono-semantic: woman (女) + 昏 'dusk' (phonetic コン) — weddings were held at dusk in ancient China: marriage.
婚.mnemonic: The ceremony timed to the sunset — コン. 結婚: two threads tied at dusk.

歳.etymology: Compound: the year-star's full circuit marked off — one completed year: age (〜歳), the year's close.
歳.mnemonic: One more ring on the trunk — サイ. 二十歳: twenty rings, special reading, はたち.

咲.etymology: Originally a variant of 笑 'laugh' — in Japanese the laughter settled on flowers: to bloom.
咲.mnemonic: The bud laughs open — さく. 桜が咲く: the country's favorite sentence each April.

伺.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 司 (phonetic シ) — attending on a superior to inquire: to visit or ask, humbly.
伺.mnemonic: Knocking softly at the director's door — うかがう. 伺います: 'I shall present myself' — keigo's house call.

刺.etymology: Compound: a thorned branch (朿) + blade (刂) — the point that goes in: to stab, pierce; a calling card (名刺) 'stuck' on arrival.
刺.mnemonic: Thorn plus knife: pointed twice over — さす. 刺身: pierced fresh; 名刺: pierced into memory.

lesson_examples.jp: はりが　指（ゆび）に　刺（さ）さって　いたい。
lesson_examples.en: The needle pricked my finger and it hurts.

脂.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 旨 'tasty' (phonetic シ) — the delicious part of the meat: fat, grease.
脂.mnemonic: The marbling that makes wagyu wagyu — あぶら. 脂: flavor's guilty address.

湿.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 濕): water (氵) + a phonetic — moisture soaked in: damp, humid.
湿.mnemonic: Laundry that refuses to finish drying — しめる. 湿気: June in Japan, bottled.

lesson_examples.jp: 湿（しめ）った　空気（くうき）ですね。
lesson_examples.en: The air is damp, isn't it.

舟.etymology: Pictograph: a small dugout boat seen from above, thwarts drawn in — a boat; the humble original of 船.
舟.mnemonic: The rowboat before shipbuilding got ideas — ふね. 小舟: the pictograph, still afloat.

lesson_examples.jp: 川（かわ）で　小（こ）舟（ぶね）に　乗（の）ります。
lesson_examples.en: I ride a small boat on the river.

柔.etymology: Compound: wood (木) supple enough for a spear-shaft (矛) — bending without breaking: soft, gentle.
柔.mnemonic: The sapling the spear is cut from: strength that bends — やわらかい. 柔道: winning by yielding.

緒.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 者 (phonetic ショ/チョ) — the thread's end you grasp first: a cord, a beginning; ties of feeling (情緒).
緒.mnemonic: Find the loose end and everything follows — お. 一緒: two ends of the same cord.

召.etymology: Phono-semantic: 刀 (phonetic ショウ) + mouth (口) — the call from above: to summon; in keigo, the honored doing of eating and wearing (召し上がる).
召.mnemonic: The order that arrives with authority behind it — めす. 召し上がれ: 'be summoned to eat' — dinner, elevated.

床.etymology: Compound: wood (木) laid under the roof (广) — the raised planks one sleeps on: floor, bed.
床.mnemonic: Boards up off the dirt: civilization's first mattress — ゆか, とこ. 床屋: the barber, from the shop's raised floor.

昇.etymology: Phono-semantic: sun (日) + 升 (phonetic ショウ) — the sun climbing by measured degrees: to ascend, rise.
昇.mnemonic: The sun taking the stairs — のぼる. 昇進: your own measured sunrise at work.

紹.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 召 (phonetic ショウ) — tying one person's thread to another's: to introduce.
紹.mnemonic: Two strangers, one knot — ショウ. 紹介: matchmaking at the thread level.

畳.etymology: Compound (simplified from 疊): mats folded and layered — the tatami; to fold up (畳む); rooms measured in mats.
畳.mnemonic: The floor sold by the mat — たたみ. 六畳: six mats, one Tokyo apartment.

触.etymology: Phono-semantic: horn (角) + 虫 (phonetic ショク) — the feeler reaching out: to touch, to contact.
触.mnemonic: Antenna meets surface — さわる. お手を触れないでください: museums vs. this kanji, forever.

伸.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 申 'stretching bolt' (phonetic シン) — the body drawn long: to stretch, extend.
伸.mnemonic: Arms up, spine crackling like lightning — のびる. 背伸び: stretching for the top shelf, literally and socially.

寝.etymology: Compound: under the roof (宀), onto the bed-plank (爿) — laid down: to sleep.
寝.mnemonic: Roof, bed, done — ねる. 寝坊: this kanji winning against your alarm.

lesson_examples.jp: きょうは　早（はや）く　寝（ね）ます。
lesson_examples.en: I'm going to bed early today.

辛.etymology: Pictograph: the tattooing needle of punishment — sharp pain: bitter, harsh; on the tongue: spicy.
辛.mnemonic: The needle on your tongue — からい; the needle in your week — つらい. Same kanji, two stings.

震.etymology: Phono-semantic: rain/sky (雨) + 辰 (phonetic シン) — the sky's tremor brought to earth: to quake, shake.
震.mnemonic: The storm that shakes from below instead — ふるえる. 地震: the kanji Japan checks its phone for.

吹.etymology: Compound ideograph: mouth (口) + 欠 'wide open' — breath pushed out: to blow.
吹.mnemonic: Cheeks full, candles doomed — ふく. 吹奏楽: blowing, organized into a band.

姓.etymology: Phono-semantic: woman (女) + 生 'born' (phonetic セイ) — the name of one's birth-line (the oldest clans traced through mothers): surname.
姓.mnemonic: The name you were born already carrying — セイ. 姓名: surname first, in Japan as in the kanji.

占.etymology: Compound ideograph: the diviner reading cracks (卜) and pronouncing (口) — to divine; to claim the spot the omen names: to occupy.
占.mnemonic: Read the crack, call the future, plant the flag — うらなう, しめる. 占い at the corner; 独占 in the boardroom.

双.etymology: Compound ideograph (simplified from 雙): two hands — a matched two: a pair, twin.
双.mnemonic: Two right hands, identical — ソウ. 双子: the kanji looking in a mirror.

捜.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 叟 (phonetic ソウ — an elder with a torch indoors) — hunting by torchlight: to search.
捜.mnemonic: Torch in one hand, the other feeling the dark — さがす. 捜査: searching with a warrant.

lesson_examples.jp: なくした　かぎを　捜（さが）して　います。
lesson_examples.en: I'm searching for the key I lost.

掃.etymology: Compound ideograph: hand (扌) + broom (帚) — the broom at work: to sweep.
掃.mnemonic: Hand meets broom, dust loses — はく. 掃除: the weekend's opening ceremony.

lesson_examples.jp: 部屋（へや）を　掃（そう）除（じ）します。

燥.etymology: Phono-semantic: fire (火) + 喿 (phonetic ソウ) — dried by heat until it crackles: to parch.
燥.mnemonic: So dry it sings like birds in a dead tree — ソウ. 乾燥: winter air, skin's enemy.

憎.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 曽 (phonetic ゾウ) — resentment layered on resentment: to hate.
憎.mnemonic: Grudges stacked like steamer trays — にくむ. 憎い: the dish that took years to cook.

贈.etymology: Phono-semantic: money (貝) + 曽 (phonetic ゾウ) — value handed over in layers of wrapping: to present, bestow.
贈.mnemonic: The gift wrapped one layer per bow — おくる. 贈り物: generosity, laminated.

替.etymology: Compound: one man stepping in as another steps out (夫夫) — a swap declared (曰): to exchange, substitute.
替.mnemonic: Shift change at the counter — かえる. 両替: money's version; 着替え: your wardrobe's.

袋.etymology: Phono-semantic: 代 (phonetic タイ) + garment (衣) — cloth sewn to carry: a bag, a sack.
袋.mnemonic: Clothing for objects — ふくろ. 手袋: bags for hands — gloves, adorably.

濯.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 翟 (phonetic タク) — cloth beaten and rinsed like a bird bathing: to wash, rinse.
濯.mnemonic: The washing thrashing like wings in the tub — タク. 洗濯: the machine still imitates the bird.

lesson_examples.jp: 洗（せん）濯（たく）を　します。

恥.etymology: Compound ideograph: ear (耳) + heart (心) — the heart heard in the burning ears: shame.
恥.mnemonic: Ears red before the mind admits it — はずかしい. 恥ずかしい: biology outing you.

遅.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 遲): movement (辶) + a phonetic — dragging along the road: slow, late.
遅.mnemonic: A sheep on a leash setting the pace — おそい, おくれる. 遅刻: the sheep wins again.

lesson_examples.jp: 電車（でんしゃ）が　遅（おく）れて　います。

畜.etymology: Compound: what the field (田) stores and raises (玄, accumulation) — animals kept: livestock.
畜.mnemonic: The farm's walking inventory — チク. 家畜: the animals with jobs.

駐.etymology: Phono-semantic: horse (馬) + 主 (phonetic チュウ) — the horse halted at the master's post: to station, park.
駐.mnemonic: Tie the horse where the lamp burns — チュウ. 駐車場: the hitching post, paved.

超.etymology: Phono-semantic: run (走) + 召 (phonetic チョウ) — leaping clear over: to exceed, transcend; the prefix 'ultra-'.
超.mnemonic: Called, and you clear the bar entirely — こえる. 超いい: slang's favorite kanji since the 90s.

沈.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 冘 (phonetic チン) — pulled under: to sink, to brood.
沈.mnemonic: Weight on the ankles, water closing over — しずむ. 沈黙: conversation doing the same.

lesson_examples.jp: 夕日（ゆうひ）が　海（うみ）に　沈（しず）みます。
lesson_examples.en: The evening sun sinks into the sea.

珍.etymology: Phono-semantic: jade (王) + 㐱 (phonetic チン) — a gem seldom seen: rare, precious, curious.
珍.mnemonic: The stone the collector has never managed to buy — めずらしい. 珍しい: the eyebrow-raise kanji.

泥.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 尼 (phonetic デイ) — earth and water settled together: mud.
泥.mnemonic: Water that gave up moving — どろ. 泥棒: the thief, forever tracked by it.

滴.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 啇 (phonetic テキ) — water falling bead by bead: a drop, to drip.
滴.mnemonic: The faucet's midnight metronome — しずく. 一滴: one bead of anything precious.

lesson_examples.jp: 水（みず）の　滴（しずく）が　落（お）ちます。

殿.etymology: Compound: the great guarded hall — palace; the address written to its occupant: 〜殿.
殿.mnemonic: The building with its own honorific — との, デン. 宮殿: the hall; 田中殿: the letterhead bow.

lesson_examples.jp: 殿（との）さまの　お城（しろ）です。

塗.etymology: Phono-semantic: 涂 (phonetic ト) + earth (土) — mud spread on walls: to plaster, paint, smear.
塗.mnemonic: Trowel the wet earth smooth — ぬる. ペンキ塗りたて: wet paint, the bench's warning.

渡.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 度 (phonetic ト) — going across the water: to cross; passing something across: to hand over.
渡.mnemonic: Ford the river, parcel held high — わたる, わたす. 横断歩道's cousin: every crossing is a 渡り.

途.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 余 (phonetic ト) — the road underway: route, course.
途.mnemonic: The part of the journey you're still inside — ト. 途中: mid-road, where everything interesting happens.

怒.etymology: Phono-semantic: 奴 (phonetic ド) + heart (心) — the heart driven like a slave: rage.
怒.mnemonic: The heart worked past its limit snaps — おこる. 怒る: management by volcano.

倒.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 到 (phonetic トウ) — a person brought down: to topple, collapse.
倒.mnemonic: Timber, but for people and governments — たおれる. 面倒: the fallen thing you now must lift.

凍.etymology: Phono-semantic: ice (冫) + 東 (phonetic トウ) — locked in ice: to freeze.
凍.mnemonic: The east wind files everything under ice — こおる. 冷凍: the freezer aisle's kanji.

塔.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 荅 (phonetic トウ) — coined to transcribe Sanskrit 'stupa': the pagoda, any tower.
塔.mnemonic: The word built to hold a borrowed building — トウ. 東京タワー's ancestor: 五重塔.

盗.etymology: Compound: drooling (次) over another's dish (皿) — desire acted on: to steal.
盗.mnemonic: Eyeing the plate one table over, then taking it — ぬすむ. 強盗: the impatient version.

筒.etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 同 (phonetic トウ) — the bamboo tube: a cylinder, a pipe.
筒.mnemonic: Bamboo's natural product: the tube — つつ. 封筒: the envelope, a flattened one.

到.etymology: Phono-semantic: 至 'reach' + 刂 (phonetic トウ) — getting all the way there: arrival.
到.mnemonic: The arrow hits the floor point-down: here — トウ. 到着: wheels touching tarmac.

逃.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 兆 (phonetic トウ) — reading the omen and running: to flee.
逃.mnemonic: See the cracks forming and go — にげる. 逃げる: wisdom, at speed.

突.etymology: Compound: bursting from the hole (穴) — a dog springing out: sudden thrust: to pierce, to jut.
突.mnemonic: Out of the burrow, straight at you — つく. 突然: the kanji with no warning label.

曇.etymology: Compound ideograph: sun (日) + cloud (雲) — the sun filed behind clouds: overcast.
曇.mnemonic: Sun present but unavailable — くもり. The forecast's middle child: 晴れ, 曇り, 雨.

鈍.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 屯 (phonetic ドン) — a blade gone soft: dull, slow.
鈍.mnemonic: The knife that squashes tomatoes — にぶい. 鈍行: the train equivalent, stopping everywhere.

軟.etymology: Phono-semantic: cart (車) + 欠 (phonetic ナン) — a ride cushioned soft: soft, pliable.
軟.mnemonic: Suspension that yawns over bumps — やわらかい's formal cousin, ナン. 柔軟: flexibility, doubled.

猫.etymology: Phono-semantic: beast (犭) + 苗 (phonetic ビョウ — near the meow) — the animal that guards the seedlings from mice: the cat.
猫.mnemonic: The beast hired by the rice sprouts — ねこ. 猫: paid in fish, works when it feels like it.

悩.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + the brain phonetic — the head churning the heart: to worry, be troubled.
悩.mnemonic: Brain and heart arguing after midnight — なやむ. 悩み: the meeting with no agenda that never ends.

lesson_examples.jp: ずっと　悩（なや）んで　います。
lesson_examples.en: I've been worrying about it for a while.

濃.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 農 (phonetic ノウ) — liquid thick with substance: concentrated, dark, dense.
濃.mnemonic: The broth boiled down to its argument — こい. 濃い coffee, 濃い relationships: both keep you up.

杯.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 不 (phonetic ハイ) — the wooden wine cup: a cup; the counter for cupfuls.
杯.mnemonic: The cup that says 'not empty yet' — ハイ. 乾杯: making it empty anyway; 一杯: one more.

泊.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 白 (phonetic ハク) — the boat moored in shallow clear water for the night: to lodge, stay over.
泊.mnemonic: Anchor down where the water shows white sand — とまる. 二泊三日: two anchorings, three days.

薄.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 溥 (phonetic ハク) — spread thin as marsh grass on water: thin, weak, pale.
薄.mnemonic: One layer stretched to cover too much — うすい. 薄い tea, 薄い excuses: same transparency.

lesson_examples.jp: この　本（ほん）は　薄（うす）いです。

爆.etymology: Phono-semantic: fire (火) + 暴 'violent' (phonetic バク) — fire let loose all at once: to explode.
爆.mnemonic: 暴 with a lit fuse — バク. 爆発: the loudest kanji in the set; 爆笑: laughter at the same yield.

肌.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 几 (phonetic キ) — the body's surface: skin, and the feel of any surface.
肌.mnemonic: What the world touches first — はだ. 肌寒い: when air and skin disagree.

髪.etymology: Phono-semantic: the long-hair radical (髟) + a phonetic (友-form) — the hair of the head.
髪.mnemonic: The kanji wearing its own wig — かみ. 髪を切る: the monthly harvest.

抜.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 拔): hand (扌) + a phonetic — pulled clean out: to extract, omit, surpass.
抜.mnemonic: One firm tug and it's free — ぬく. 手を抜く: extracting your effort; 追い抜く: extracting yourself past someone.

般.etymology: Compound: the boat (舟) poled around (殳) — carrying about; spread to all sides: general, sundry.
般.mnemonic: The ferry that serves every dock — ハン. 一般: the general public, all aboard.

販.etymology: Phono-semantic: money (貝) + 反 'turn over' (phonetic ハン) — goods turned over for cash: to sell, deal.
販.mnemonic: Flip the stock, pocket the difference — ハン. 自動販売機: the flip, automated on every corner.

彼.etymology: Phono-semantic: step (彳) + 皮 (phonetic ヒ) — the one over there, a walk away: that; in modern Japanese, he (彼) and she (彼女).
彼.mnemonic: The person on the far sidewalk — かれ. 彼女: 'that woman over there' turned into 'girlfriend' — Japanese romance in one etymology.

疲.etymology: Phono-semantic: sickness (疒) + 皮 (phonetic ヒ) — worn down to the hide: exhausted.
疲.mnemonic: Nothing left under the skin — つかれる. お疲れさま: the national password at day's end.

被.etymology: Phono-semantic: garment (衤) + 皮 (phonetic ヒ) — thrown over one: to cover; what falls on one: to suffer, incur; grammar's passive marker.
被.mnemonic: The blanket you didn't ask for — こうむる. 被害: what landed on you; 被る: wearing it anyway.

匹.etymology: Pictograph: bolts of cloth folded in pairs — a matched measure: an equal; the counter for small animals.
匹.mnemonic: Small creatures counted like bolts of cloth — ひき. 犬一匹, 猫二匹: the pet census.

lesson_examples.jp: 犬（いぬ）が　二（に）匹（ひき）　います。

怖.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 布 (phonetic フ) — the heart under a thrown cloth: dread, fear.
怖.mnemonic: The sheet over the mirror at night — こわい. 怖い: the kanji children spell with their faces.

普.etymology: Compound: the sun (日) shining on all alike (並) — everywhere the same: universal, ordinary.
普.mnemonic: One sun, no favorites — フ. 普通: the grand cosmic word for 'normal'.

浮.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 孚 (phonetic フ) — held up on the surface: to float; unmoored: fickle (浮気).
浮.mnemonic: A hand keeping the child's chin above water — うく. 浮気: a heart floating off its mooring.

lesson_examples.jp: 船（ふね）が　浮（う）いて　います。

符.etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 付 (phonetic フ) — the split bamboo tally whose halves match: a token, a mark.
符.mnemonic: The half that proves you're you — フ. 切符: the token that rides trains.

膚.etymology: Phono-semantic: a tiger-crowned phonetic + flesh — the body's outer layer, formally: skin.
膚.mnemonic: 肌's formal twin, wearing a tiger hat — フ. 皮膚科: where skin gets its paperwork.

舞.etymology: Compound: the sleeved dancer (無's original picture) given feet (舛) — the borrowed dancer danced again: to dance.
舞.mnemonic: 無 got its body back and its feet — まう. 舞台: the stage; お見舞い: dancing attendance on the sick.

lesson_examples.jp: 雪（ゆき）が　舞（ま）って　います。
lesson_examples.en: Snow is dancing in the air.

封.etymology: Compound: earth mounded (圭) by hand (寸) at the border — territory sealed off: to seal, enfeoff.
封.mnemonic: Press the mound of wax down firm — フウ. 封筒: the envelope, sealed by descent.

幅.etymology: Phono-semantic: cloth (巾) + 畐 (phonetic フク) — the bolt's full breadth: width; the counter for hanging scrolls.
幅.mnemonic: How far the cloth reaches unrolled — はば. 道幅: the street measured shoulder to shoulder.

払.etymology: Simplified from 拂: hand (扌) + a phonetic — sweeping away: to brush off; sweeping money across the counter: to pay.
払.mnemonic: Flick it off the palm — はらう. 支払い: dust and debts, same gesture.

lesson_examples.jp: お金（かね）を　払（はら）います。

沸.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 弗 (phonetic フツ) — water in revolt: to boil, seethe.
沸.mnemonic: The pot arguing with its lid — わく. お湯が沸いた: teatime's starting gun.

lesson_examples.jp: お湯（ゆ）が　沸（わ）きました。

壁.etymology: Phono-semantic: 辟 (phonetic ヘキ) + earth (土) — rammed earth standing up: a wall.
壁.mnemonic: The problem you can lean on — かべ. 壁にぶつかる: progress meeting architecture.

捕.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 甫 (phonetic ホ) — the hand closing on the runner: to catch, arrest.
捕.mnemonic: Fingers close, chase over — つかまえる. 逮捕: the formal grip.

lesson_examples.jp: どろぼうが　捕（つか）まりました。

募.etymology: Phono-semantic: 莫 (phonetic ボ) + strength (力) — calling strength in from far and wide: to recruit, solicit.
募.mnemonic: Posters in every field at dusk: hands wanted — つのる. 募集中: the kanji on the shop door.

抱.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 包 'wrap' (phonetic ホウ) — arms wrapped around: to embrace, to hold (ideas and babies alike).
抱.mnemonic: The hand-powered version of 包 — だく, かかえる. 抱きしめる: wrapping with intent.

坊.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 方 (phonetic ボウ) — the temple ward and its resident monk; affectionately, any little boy (〜坊).
坊.mnemonic: The little monk of the household — ボウ. 赤ん坊: the newest resident; 寝坊: his favorite sin.

帽.etymology: Phono-semantic: cloth (巾) + 冒 'covering the eye' (phonetic ボウ) — cloth over the head: a hat.
帽.mnemonic: The cloth that shades the 冒's eye — ボウ. 帽子: sold one floor below 靴.

忙.etymology: Compound: heart (忄) + 亡 'lost' — the heart gone missing in the rush: busy.
忙.mnemonic: The kanji admits it: busyness is a lost heart — いそがしい. 忙しい: read the parts and wince.

磨.etymology: Phono-semantic: 麻 (phonetic マ) + stone (石) — worked against stone: to grind, polish.
磨.mnemonic: Stone plus patience — みがく. 歯を磨く: the twice-daily polish.

埋.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 里 (phonetic マイ) — put under the ground: to bury, fill in.
埋.mnemonic: The village under the soil line — うめる. 埋める: holes, schedules, silences.

眠.etymology: Phono-semantic: eye (目) + 民 (phonetic ミン) — the eye closed down: to sleep.
眠.mnemonic: The whole population of you, eyes shut — ねむる. 眠い: the 3 p.m. kanji.

娘.etymology: Compound: woman (女) + 良 'good' (phonetic) — the good young woman of the house: daughter.
娘.mnemonic: 女 plus 良: the house's pride — むすめ. The kanji every father agrees with.

戻.etymology: Compound: turning back at the door (戸) — coming back the way one went: to return, restore.
戻.mnemonic: U-turn on the doorstep — もどる. 払い戻し: money making the same U-turn.

与.etymology: Simplified from 與: many hands passing something together — to give, grant, take part.
与.mnemonic: Handed across with a hook so it can't drop — あたえる. 給与: bestowal, salaried.

溶.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 容 (phonetic ヨウ) — taken into the liquid: to dissolve, melt.
溶.mnemonic: The sugar accepts the invitation — とける. 溶ける: ice cream's one-act tragedy.

踊.etymology: Phono-semantic: foot (足) + 甬 (phonetic ヨウ) — feet springing up: to dance, leap.
踊.mnemonic: Feet with a geyser under them — おどる. 盆踊り: the whole town's feet agreeing.

頼.etymology: Phono-semantic: 束 (phonetic ライ) + head (頁) — leaning one's head on another: to rely, entrust, request.
頼.mnemonic: Handing your bundle to someone and your worries with it — たのむ. 頼りになる: the shoulder that holds.

絡.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 各 (phonetic ラク) — threads wound around each other: to entangle; lines kept between people: contact.
絡.mnemonic: Your thread looped through theirs — からむ. 連絡して: keep the loop alive.

粒.etymology: Phono-semantic: rice (米) + 立 (phonetic リュウ) — one grain standing alone: a grain, a droplet, the counter for tiny things.
粒.mnemonic: One grain at attention — つぶ. 一粒: rice, tears, and vitamins all counted alike.

了.etymology: Pictograph: a swaddled child, arms bound — wrapped up: finished, understood.
了.mnemonic: Wrapped, tied, done — リョウ. 終了 and 了解: the kanji that ends screens and radio calls.

lesson_examples.jp: やっと　しごとが　終了（しゅうりょう）しました。

涼.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 京 (phonetic リョウ) — the cool of water in the air: refreshing.
涼.mnemonic: The breeze off the palace moat — すずしい. 涼しい: August's most wanted adjective.

療.etymology: Phono-semantic: sickness (疒) + 尞 (phonetic リョウ) — treatment applied to the sickbed: to heal.
療.mnemonic: Light brought to the bedside — リョウ. 治療: the sickbed's exit plan.

lesson_examples.jp: 病院（びょういん）で　治（ち）療（りょう）を　受（う）けます。
lesson_examples.en: I receive treatment at the hospital.

涙.etymology: Compound: water (氵) + 戻 'turning back at the door' — the water of turning back: tears.
涙.mnemonic: Water at the doorway of goodbye — なみだ. 涙: the kanji at every train-platform scene.

零.etymology: Phono-semantic: rain (雨) + 令 (phonetic レイ) — the last drops falling away to nothing: to dwindle: zero.
零.mnemonic: Rain ordered to stop: none left — レイ. 零点: the score with weather in its history.

齢.etymology: Phono-semantic: teeth (歯) + 令 (phonetic レイ) — age read from the teeth, as with horses: one's years.
齢.mnemonic: Count the teeth, name the years — レイ. 年齢: the dentist's guess, made official.

恋.etymology: Simplified from 戀: a heart (心) caught in tangled threads — longing that binds: romantic love.
恋.mnemonic: The heart, gift-wrapped in knots it tied itself — こい. 恋人: the person holding the other end.

湾.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + a 'bent bow' phonetic (ワン) — the coast bent like a bow: a bay.
湾.mnemonic: The shoreline drawn back like a bowstring — ワン. 東京湾: the bow aimed at the Pacific.

lesson_examples.jp: 湾（わん）に　船（ふね）が　入（はい）ります。

腕.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 宛 (phonetic ワン) — the bending limb: the arm; what arms learn: skill.
腕.mnemonic: The limb that carries your craft — うで. 腕がいい: praise aimed at the arm, meant for the whole person.

亜.etymology: Pictograph: the cross-shaped plan of an ancient tomb chamber — borrowed for 'second-rank' (亜熱帯) and to transcribe Asia (亜細亜).
亜.mnemonic: The floor plan that named a continent — ア. 亜熱帯: one rank below tropical.

哀.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) muffled in the garment (衣) — the cry into the sleeve: grief, pity.
哀.mnemonic: Weeping into the collar — あわれ. 哀しい: 悲しい's more literary tears.

握.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 屋 (phonetic アク) — the closing fist: to grip, grasp.
握.mnemonic: Fingers closing like a roof over the palm — にぎる. 握手 shakes; おにぎり feeds.

扱.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 及 (phonetic キュウ) — the hand dealing with what it reaches: to handle, treat.
扱.mnemonic: Whatever lands in reach becomes your job — あつかう. 取り扱い注意: handle with this kanji.

威.etymology: Compound: the matriarch under arms — awe-inspiring authority: dignity, menace.
威.mnemonic: Power that doesn't raise its voice — イ. 威力: force, dressed formally.

尉.etymology: Compound: originally a hand pressing flat (the root of 慰) — the officer who keeps ranks pressed in order: lieutenant.
尉.mnemonic: The one who irons the ranks flat — イ. 大尉: captain of creases.

慰.etymology: Phono-semantic: 尉 'press smooth' (phonetic イ) + heart (心) — smoothing the heart: to console, comfort.
慰.mnemonic: Ironing the wrinkles out of someone's chest — なぐさめる. 慰める: the gentlest verb with a soldier inside.

為.etymology: Pictograph: a hand leading an elephant to work — to do, to make; the doing-for: sake (ため).
為.mnemonic: Getting an elephant to work: the original verb 'to do' — ため. 為に: for the sake of; 行為: the deed.

維.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 隹 (phonetic イ) — the holding cord: fiber; to hold together: maintain.
維.mnemonic: The tether that keeps the bird — イ. 維持: holding the line; 明治維新: re-tying the whole state.

緯.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 韋 (phonetic イ) — the crosswise weft thread: woof; the earth's crosswise lines: latitude.
緯.mnemonic: The thread running east-west — イ. 緯度: the loom lines of the globe.

壱.etymology: Complex variant of 一 used on documents so no one can forge a stroke: the legal 'one'.
壱.mnemonic: 一 in a business suit — イチ. 金壱万円: one, notarized.

逸.etymology: Compound: the rabbit (兎) bolting down the road (辶) — slipping away: to deviate, be lost; running ahead of the pack: excel.
逸.mnemonic: The rabbit off the path — イツ. 逸話: the story that escaped the official record.

稲.etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + a phonetic — the standing rice plant: rice in the field.
稲.mnemonic: Rice before it's 米: still green, still bowing — いね. 稲妻: lightning, 'the rice's wife', ripener of grain.

芋.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 于 (phonetic ウ) — the swollen root: taro, potato.
芋.mnemonic: The plant whose treasure is underground — いも. 焼き芋: winter's street-corner kanji.

姻.etymology: Phono-semantic: woman (女) + 因 (phonetic イン) — the alliance made through marriage: matrimony.
姻.mnemonic: The cause (因) two families sign — イン. 婚姻届: love's paperwork.

陰.etymology: Compound: the cloudy (云) side of the hill (阝) — the dark north face: shade, yin.
陰.mnemonic: 陽's other slope — かげ. 陰で: in the shadows, where gossip lives.

隠.etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + a phonetic — tucked behind the hill: to hide.
隠.mnemonic: Behind the hill, behind the hands, behind the heart — かくす. 隠れ家: the hideout café.

韻.etymology: Phono-semantic: sound (音) + 員 (phonetic イン) — sounds that answer each other: rhyme, resonance.
韻.mnemonic: Echo on the payroll — イン. 韻を踏む: stepping on the rhyme, the rapper's kanji.

渦.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 咼 (phonetic カ) — water turning on itself: a vortex.
渦.mnemonic: The drain's spiral signature — うず. 渦: Naruto's namesake swirl.

唄.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 貝 (phonetic バイ) — Japan's character for folk song: the shamisen ballad.
唄.mnemonic: A song worth shells — うた. 小唄: the teahouse setlist.

浦.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 甫 (phonetic ホ) — the sheltered shore: inlet, bay.
浦.mnemonic: The cove where boats overnight — うら. 浦島太郎: the bay's most famous commuter.

影.etymology: Phono-semantic: 景 'light-scene' (phonetic エイ) + 彡 'strokes' — what light draws behind things: shadow, silhouette.
影.mnemonic: The scenery's dark copy — かげ. 影武者: the shadow that stands in for the general.

詠.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 永 'long' (phonetic エイ) — words drawn out long: to chant, compose verse.
詠.mnemonic: Vowels stretched toward forever — よむ. 詠む: what poets do to syllables.

疫.etymology: Phono-semantic: sickness (疒) + 殳 (phonetic エキ) — disease on forced march: epidemic.
疫.mnemonic: Illness with a weapon — エキ. 免疫: the body's standing army against it.

悦.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 兌 'loosen' (phonetic エツ) — the heart unknotted: delight.
悦.mnemonic: The knot in the chest slips free — エツ. ご満悦: visibly, smugly pleased.

謁.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 曷 (phonetic エツ) — formally requesting to speak before the throne: an audience.
謁.mnemonic: Words admitted past the guards — エツ. 謁見: the throne-room appointment.

閲.etymology: Phono-semantic: gate (門) + 兌 (phonetic エツ) — checked one by one at the gate: to inspect, peruse.
閲.mnemonic: Every page shows its papers at the gate — エツ. 閲覧室: the reading room; 検閲: the gate gone wrong.

宴.etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 妟 'ease' (phonetic エン) — feasting at ease under the roof: banquet.
宴.mnemonic: The party the roof was built for — エン. 宴会: bonenkai's formal name.

lesson_examples.jp: たのしい　宴（うたげ）です。

援.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 爰 'rope passed down' (phonetic エン) — the hand on the rescue rope: to aid.
援.mnemonic: Grab the rope, pull them up — エン. 応援: aid delivered by shouting.

炎.etymology: Compound ideograph: fire on fire (火火) — blaze; the body's blaze: inflammation (〜炎).
炎.mnemonic: Twice the fire — ほのお. 炎上: bonfires and internet comment sections.

猿.etymology: Phono-semantic: beast (犭) + 袁 (phonetic エン) — the long-armed climber: monkey.
猿.mnemonic: The beast in the trailing sleeves — さる. 猿も木から落ちる: even this kanji falls sometimes.

縁.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 彖 (phonetic エン) — the hem-thread where things meet: edge; the unseen thread between people: fate, affinity.
縁.mnemonic: The invisible string that put you both on the same train — えん. ご縁があれば: 'if the thread allows'.

艶.etymology: Compound: abundance (豊) of color (色) — lustrous: glossy, alluring.
艶.mnemonic: Color with the volume up — つや. 艶やか: lacquer, hair, and rumor.

鉛.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 㕣 (phonetic エン) — the soft grey metal: lead.
鉛.mnemonic: The heaviest pencil ancestor — なまり. 鉛筆: lead's daily gig, graphite notwithstanding.

凹.etymology: Pictograph: a shape with a dent in the top — concave. Its partner 凸 bulges.
凹.mnemonic: The kanji IS the dent — オウ. 凹凸: bumps and hollows, drawn literally; へこむ: feeling like the shape looks.

lesson_examples.jp: ここが　凹（へこ）んでいます。

旺.etymology: Phono-semantic: sun (日) + 王 (phonetic オウ) — sunlight at royal strength: vigorous, flourishing.
旺.mnemonic: The sun on the throne — オウ. 旺盛: appetite and energy at full blaze.

殴.etymology: Phono-semantic: 区 (phonetic オウ) + 殳 'striking arm' — blows delivered: to beat.
殴.mnemonic: The striking arm let loose in the ward — なぐる. 殴る: the police-report verb.

翁.etymology: Phono-semantic: 公 (phonetic オウ) + 羽 — the white-feathered elder: venerable old man.
翁.mnemonic: Down-white hair like feathers — おきな. The Noh stage's oldest mask.

憶.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 意 (phonetic オク) — thoughts kept in the heart: to remember.
憶.mnemonic: The heart's archive room — オク. 記憶: memory, filed under feeling.

乙.etymology: Pictograph: a bent hook or sprouting shoot — the second of the old ordinal signs (甲乙丙): the latter; quaint charm (乙な).
乙.mnemonic: The runner-up's curly ribbon — オツ. 甲乙つけがたい: too close to rank.

lesson_examples.jp: 甲（こう）と　乙（おつ）を　くらべます。
lesson_examples.en: We compare the first and the second.

卸.etymology: Compound: unloading goods from the cart (the root of 御す) — goods set down in bulk: wholesale.
卸.mnemonic: Crates set down before the shop opens — おろす. 卸売: selling by the pallet.

lesson_examples.jp: にもつを　卸（おろ）します。

穏.etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + a phonetic — the harvest safely in, the heart at rest: calm, mild.
穏.mnemonic: Granary full, hands folded — おだやか. 穏やかな海: the sea off duty.

佳.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 圭 'ritual jade' (phonetic カ) — fine as ceremonial jade: excellent.
佳.mnemonic: A person cut like a gem — カ. 佳作: the prize just under the prize.

lesson_examples.jp: 佳（か）作（さく）に　えらばれました。
lesson_examples.en: It was chosen as an honorable mention.

嫁.etymology: Compound ideograph: the woman (女) entering the house (家) — the bride; to marry into.
嫁.mnemonic: 女 + 家: the wedding in one glyph — よめ. 花嫁: the bride in bloom.

寡.etymology: Compound: the household head left divided under the roof — bereft: widowed; reduced: few (寡黙).
寡.mnemonic: One chair now empty under the roof — カ. 寡黙: words gone few.

lesson_examples.jp: 彼（かれ）は 寡黙（かもく）です。
lesson_examples.en: He is a man of few words.

暇.etymology: Phono-semantic: sun/day (日) + 叚 'borrowed' (phonetic カ) — days on loan from duty: leisure.
暇.mnemonic: Borrowed daylight, no agenda — ひま. 暇なとき: the loan everyone wants extended.

架.etymology: Phono-semantic: 加 'add' (phonetic カ) + wood (木) — timber added across: to span, to shelve.
架.mnemonic: Beams added between banks — かける. 架け橋: the bridging kanji, literal and diplomatic.

禍.etymology: Phono-semantic: altar (ネ) + 咼 (phonetic カ) — misfortune sent from beyond: calamity.
禍.mnemonic: The altar's dark invoice — わざわい. コロナ禍: the suffix of bad years.

稼.etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + 家 (phonetic カ) — bringing the harvest home: to earn.
稼.mnemonic: Grain carried through your own gate — かせぐ. 稼ぐ: the paycheck verb.

箇.etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo tallies (⺮) + 固 (phonetic カ) — one bamboo tally per item: the counter 箇/ヶ.
箇.mnemonic: One stick per thing — カ. 三箇月 or 3ヶ月: same tally, shrunk.

華.etymology: Pictograph: a plant in full cascade of blossom — flowering splendor; also China (中華).
華.mnemonic: 花's gala outfit — はな, カ. 豪華: luxury in bloom; 中華: the flowering middle kingdom.

蚊.etymology: Phono-semantic: insect (虫) + 文 (phonetic ブン — the whine ぶーん) — the humming biter: mosquito.
蚊.mnemonic: The bug that writes (文) itchy notes on your arm — か. 蚊取り線香: the green spiral counterattack.

雅.etymology: Phono-semantic: 牙 (phonetic ガ) + bird (隹) — originally a crow-name, borrowed for courtly refinement: elegant.
雅.mnemonic: The bird that behaves at court — みやび. 優雅: grace with a pedigree.

餓.etymology: Phono-semantic: food (飠) + 我 (phonetic ガ) — the self stripped to hunger: to starve.
餓.mnemonic: When 'I' and 'food' are the only two thoughts left — ガ. 餓死: hunger's last entry.

塊.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 鬼 (phonetic カイ) — a mass of earth: clod, lump.
塊.mnemonic: A ghost-shaped fistful of dirt — かたまり. 塊: gold nuggets and cheese chunks alike.

壊.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + a phonetic — walls brought down: to break, destroy.
壊.mnemonic: The wall returns to dirt — こわす. 破壊: demolition, budgeted.

怪.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + a phonetic — the heart's prickle at the uncanny: strange, suspect.
怪.mnemonic: The shiver before the ghost story starts — あやしい. 怪物, 妖怪: mystery's staff directory.

悔.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 毎 (phonetic カイ) — the heart replaying it every time: regret.
悔.mnemonic: Every (毎) night the heart reruns the tape — くやしい. 後悔: hindsight with teeth.

懐.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + a phonetic — what's carried against the chest: the bosom pocket; what the chest carries longest: nostalgia.
懐.mnemonic: The inside pocket over the heart — ふところ, なつかしい. 懐かしい: warmth from the old pocket.

戒.etymology: Compound ideograph: both hands on the halberd (戈) — on guard: to admonish, warn; the precepts kept.
戒.mnemonic: Weapon held at ready as a rule of life — カイ. 警戒: the guard posture, institutional.

拐.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + a phonetic — taken away by force or trick: to abduct.
拐.mnemonic: The hand that leads someone the wrong way — カイ. 誘拐: the crime-drama kanji.

劾.etymology: Phono-semantic: 亥 (phonetic ガイ) + 力 — force brought against an official's misdeeds: impeachment.
劾.mnemonic: Muscle applied to a minister — ガイ. 弾劾: the impeachment headline.

慨.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 既 'already' (phonetic ガイ) — the heart sighing over what's already done: lament.
慨.mnemonic: Too late, and the heart knows it — ガイ. 感慨: the long exhale at anniversaries.

概.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 既 (phonetic ガイ) — the leveling stick drawn across a measure: the rough whole: outline.
概.mnemonic: The plank that levels the details away — ガイ. 概要: the gist, planed smooth.

涯.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 厓 'cliff-edge' (phonetic ガイ) — where the water meets its edge: the bound, the horizon.
涯.mnemonic: The waterline of a life — ガイ. 生涯: from first shore to last.

該.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 亥 (phonetic ガイ) — the item the text points at: the said, relevant.
該.mnemonic: The legal finger pointing back up the page — ガイ. 該当: 'applies to you'.

垣.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 亘 (phonetic エン→かき) — the low earthen wall: hedge, fence.
垣.mnemonic: The waist-high wall neighbors chat over — かき. 垣根: the polite boundary.

嚇.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 赫 'blazing red' (phonetic カク) — a scarlet-faced roar: to menace.
嚇.mnemonic: Two fires' worth of shouting — カク. 威嚇: the growl before the bite.

核.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 亥 (phonetic カク) — the fruit's stone: kernel, core; the atom's: nucleus.
核.mnemonic: The pit inside the peach, the core inside the atom — カク. 核心: the middle of the middle.

殻.etymology: Compound: the hard casing struck (殳) away — husk, shell.
殻.mnemonic: What cracks off and gets swept up — から. 貝殻: the beach's confetti.

獲.etymology: Phono-semantic: hound (犭) + 蒦 (phonetic カク) — the hunting dog's catch: to seize, win.
獲.mnemonic: The retriever returns with the prize — える. 獲得: points, titles, territory.

穫.etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + 蒦 (phonetic カク) — the grain version of 獲: to reap.
穫.mnemonic: 獲's farming twin — カク. 収穫: the year's catch, in sheaves.

郭.etymology: Phono-semantic: 享 (phonetic カク) + city (阝) — the walled outer town: enclosure, quarter.
郭.mnemonic: The city's outer ring wall — カク. 輪郭: the outline — a face's city wall.

隔.etymology: Phono-semantic: wall (阝) + 鬲 (phonetic カク) — a partition between: to separate; every other (隔週).
隔.mnemonic: The wall that makes two rooms of one — へだてる. 隔離: separation, medical grade.

岳.etymology: Compound ideograph: a hill (丘) stacked on a mountain (山) — the high peak.
岳.mnemonic: Mountain with a mountain on top — たけ. 山岳: alpine country; 岳父: the father-in-law summit.

掛.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 卦 (phonetic カイ→か) — hung by hand: to hang, to set upon.
掛.mnemonic: Hooked up by hand — かける. 腰掛け, 掛け算, 声を掛ける: Japanese hangs everything on this verb.

喝.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 曷 (phonetic カツ) — the sharp bark of rebuke: to scold; Zen's waking shout.
喝.mnemonic: The master's one-syllable thunder — カツ. 喝!: enlightenment, or at least attention.

括.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + a phonetic — drawn together and tied: to bundle, bracket.
括.mnemonic: Everything cinched in one tie — カツ. 一括: paid in one bundle; 括弧: brackets, the typographic string.

渇.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 曷 (phonetic カツ) — water run out: thirst, drying up.
渇.mnemonic: The canteen's hollow slosh — かわく. 渇き: thirst, literal or ambitious.

滑.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 骨 (phonetic カツ) — wet bone-smooth: slippery; to glide.
滑.mnemonic: Wet bones underfoot: skating guaranteed — すべる. 滑走路: the runway, professionally slippery.

褐.etymology: Phono-semantic: garment (衤) + 曷 (phonetic カツ) — the coarse hemp cloak's color: brown.
褐.mnemonic: The beggar's cloak shade — カツ. 褐色: tan, in formalwear.

轄.etymology: Phono-semantic: cart (車) + 害 (phonetic カツ) — the linchpin that keeps the wheel on: control, jurisdiction.
轄.mnemonic: Pull the pin and the cart is nobody's — カツ. 管轄: whose pin it is.

且.etymology: Pictograph: offerings stacked on a stand — one atop another: moreover, furthermore.
且.mnemonic: And another layer on the pile — かつ. 且つ: the conjunction shaped like its meaning.

鎌.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 兼 (phonetic ケン→かま) — the curved reaping blade: sickle.
鎌.mnemonic: The blade that gathers as it cuts — かま. 鎌倉: the sickle-storehouse city.

刈.etymology: Compound ideograph: stalks crossed (メ) under the blade (刂) — mowing: to reap, trim.
刈.mnemonic: X marks the swath — かる. 芝刈り: the lawn's haircut.

lesson_examples.jp: くさを　刈（か）ります。

冠.etymology: Compound: a hand (寸) setting the cover (冖) on the head (元) — the coming-of-age capping: crown.
冠.mnemonic: Hand places the circle on the first head — かんむり. 王冠: the bottle cap kept its dignity.

lesson_examples.jp: 優（ゆう）勝（しょう）の　冠（かんむり）を　もらいました。

勘.etymology: Phono-semantic: 甚 (phonetic カン) + 力 — the effort of weighing things — done so often it becomes instinct: intuition.
勘.mnemonic: Calculation compressed into a hunch — カン. 勘がいい: the auditor who guesses right.

examples.word: お勧め・御勧め・御薦め
お勧め・御勧め・御薦め

勧.etymology: Phono-semantic: 雚 (phonetic カン) + 力 — effort applied to another's will: to urge, recommend.
勧.mnemonic: The friendly push toward the door — すすめる. 勧誘: persuasion with pamphlets.

喚.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 奐 (phonetic カン) — the summoning cry: to call out, summon (to court).
喚.mnemonic: The bailiff's shout down the corridor — カン. 召喚: summoned, in games and law alike.

堪.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 甚 (phonetic カン) — ground that bears the load: to endure.
堪.mnemonic: Soil that holds under anything — たえる. 堪忍: patience, load-tested.

寛.etymology: Compound: a spacious house (宀) with room to overlook faults: generous, lenient.
寛.mnemonic: A roof wide enough for everyone's flaws — カン. 寛容: the roomy heart.

lesson_examples.jp: うちで　寛（くつろ）ぎます。

患.etymology: Phono-semantic: 串 'skewer' (phonetic カン) + heart (心) — the heart run through: illness, affliction.
患.mnemonic: Worry on a skewer through the chest — カン. 患者: the one the skewer chose.

憾.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 感 (phonetic カン) — feeling that stays lodged: regret.
憾.mnemonic: 感 with a splinter left in — カン. 遺憾: diplomacy's 'deep regret'.

敢.etymology: Compound: grasping and striking regardless — venturing boldly: daring.
敢.mnemonic: Swinging first, calculating later — あえて. 敢えて: doing it anyway, on purpose.

棺.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 官 (phonetic カン) — the final wooden housing: coffin.
棺.mnemonic: The last官舎 (official residence) — カン. 棺: administration's endpoint.

款.etymology: Compound: sincere address before the altar — cordiality; the inscribed clauses of it: articles (of a contract).
款.mnemonic: Warm words, then the fine print — カン. 定款: the company's founding clauses.

歓.etymology: Phono-semantic: 雚 (phonetic カン) + 欠 'open mouth' — joy voiced aloud: delight.
歓.mnemonic: The cheer that opens every throat — カン. 歓迎会: delight, catered.

監.etymology: Compound: the bowed eye (臣) checking its reflection in the water dish (皿) — inspection from above: to oversee.
監.mnemonic: The supervisor's eye in every mirror — カン. 監督: the film director; 監視: the cameras.

緩.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 爰 (phonetic カン) — the rope let out: slack, gentle, gradual.
緩.mnemonic: Tension released a hand at a time — ゆるい. 緩和: the loosening, policy-grade.

缶.etymology: Pictograph: an ancient clay jar — recycled in modern times for the tin can.
缶.mnemonic: The jar that went industrial — カン. 缶コーヒー: the vending machine's clay pot.

肝.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 干 (phonetic カン) — the vital organ of courage: liver; nerve, the essential point (肝心).
肝.mnemonic: Where the old anatomy stored your nerve — きも. 肝心: liver-and-heart important.

艦.etymology: Phono-semantic: ship (舟) + 監 (phonetic カン) — the armored overseeing vessel: warship.
艦.mnemonic: The boat with a supervisor and cannons — カン. 軍艦: the navy's kanji.

貫.etymology: Compound ideograph: coins (貝) strung on a cord — run straight through: to pierce, carry through.
貫.mnemonic: One string through every coin — つらぬく. 貫く: holding your line through everything.

還.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 瞏 (phonetic カン) — the full circle home: to return, restore.
還.mnemonic: The long loop that ends at the start — カン. 返還, 還暦: giving back, and the 60-year loop.

鑑.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 監 (phonetic カン) — the bronze mirror one checks against: model, connoisseurship (鑑定).
鑑.mnemonic: The reference mirror for judging the real thing — かんがみる. 図鑑: the specimen book — your Kanjidex's namesake.

閑.etymology: Compound: a tree (木) grown in the gateway (門) — traffic long gone: idle, quiet.
閑.mnemonic: So few visitors a tree took the doorway — カン. 閑静: real-estate-listing quiet.

陥.etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 臽 'pit' (phonetic カン) — ground giving way: to cave in, fall into.
陥.mnemonic: The hillside opens and takes the road with it — おちいる. 欠陥: the flaw you fall through.

頑.etymology: Phono-semantic: 元 (phonetic ガン) + head (頁) — a head set hard: obstinate.
頑.mnemonic: The skull that won't update — ガン. 頑張る: stubbornness, weaponized for good.

企.etymology: Compound ideograph: a person on tiptoe (止) peering ahead — reaching for what's next: to plan, undertake.
企.mnemonic: On tiptoes, eyeing the opportunity — くわだてる. 企業, 企画: tiptoe institutionalized.

伎.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 支 (phonetic ギ/キ) — performed skill: artistry — the 伎 of 歌舞伎.
伎.mnemonic: 技's stage twin — キ. 歌舞伎: song, dance, skill.

奇.etymology: Phono-semantic: 大 + 可 (phonetic キ) — the improbably big: odd, wondrous; odd numbers (奇数).
奇.mnemonic: 'That big? Surely not' — キ. 奇跡 wonders; 奇数 just refuses to pair.

幾.etymology: Compound: fine threads by the guard's blade — barely perceptible: how many? how much? (幾つ).
幾.mnemonic: Counting threads at the checkpoint — いくつ. 幾ら: the eternal market question.

lesson_examples.jp: 幾（いく）つですか。

忌.etymology: Phono-semantic: 己 (phonetic キ) + heart (心) — what the heart shuns: taboo; the shunned days: mourning.
忌.mnemonic: The date the heart circles in black — いむ. 一周忌: the first year's return.

既.etymology: Compound ideograph: the diner turning from the finished meal — done: already.
既.mnemonic: Plate empty, face turned away — すでに. 既に: too late, it happened.

棋.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 其 (phonetic キ) — the wooden game piece: shōgi, go.
棋.mnemonic: Wood carved into strategy — キ. 将棋: the general's board.

棄.etymology: Compound (grim origin): a winnowing basket carrying away an infant — to discard: abandon.
棄.mnemonic: Carried out with the chaff — すてる's cold cousin, キ. 放棄, 棄権: rights and races, dropped.

軌.etymology: Phono-semantic: cart (車) + 九 (phonetic キ) — the wheel's worn groove: track, orbit.
軌.mnemonic: Where every cart before you went — キ. 軌道: orbit — the sky's wheel-rut.

輝.etymology: Phono-semantic: light (光) + 軍 (phonetic キ) — light in full force: to shine, sparkle.
輝.mnemonic: An army of light — かがやく. 輝く: stars, trophies, eyes.

飢.etymology: Phono-semantic: food (飠) + 几 (phonetic キ) — the empty table: hunger, famine.
飢.mnemonic: A table with nothing on it — うえる. 飢餓: the empty-table pair.

騎.etymology: Phono-semantic: horse (馬) + 奇 (phonetic キ) — mounted astride: riding; the counter for horsemen.
騎.mnemonic: One rider, one horse, counted together — キ. 騎士: the knight kanji.

鬼.etymology: Pictograph: a spirit with a monstrous head — the dead returned: ghost, ogre.
鬼.mnemonic: The big-headed visitor from the other side — おに. 鬼ごっこ: tag, with a demon 'it'.

亀.etymology: Pictograph: a turtle — head, shell segments, tail — whose heated shells gave the first oracle cracks.
亀.mnemonic: The animal whose back invented divination — かめ. 亀: slow, sacred, still recognizable.

lesson_examples.jp: 池（いけ）に　亀（かめ）が　います。
lesson_examples.en: There is a turtle in the pond.

偽.etymology: Compound: person (亻) + 為 'made' — man-made rather than genuine: fake, false.
偽.mnemonic: Done (為) by someone, passed off as real — にせ. 偽物: the flea-market warning.

儀.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 義 (phonetic ギ) — righteousness embodied in form: ceremony, etiquette, apparatus.
儀.mnemonic: Righteousness with a dress code — ギ. 儀式 and 地球儀: rites, and the globe on your desk.

宜.etymology: Compound: offerings properly stacked (且) under the roof — fitting, appropriate.
宜.mnemonic: Everything arranged as it should be — ギ. 宜しく: 'appropriately, please' — Japan's universal handshake.

戯.etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + 戈 — mock combat: play, jest, drama (戯曲).
戯.mnemonic: Swordplay with the edges off — たわむれる. 悪戯: mischief, いたずら.

擬.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 疑 (phonetic ギ) — made to resemble until you doubt: to imitate, simulate.
擬.mnemonic: A copy good enough to raise 疑 — ギ. 擬音語: sound-mimicking words — ワンワン, ドキドキ.

欺.etymology: Phono-semantic: 其 (phonetic ギ) + 欠 — words breathed to mislead: to deceive.
欺.mnemonic: The open mouth selling the empty basket — あざむく. 詐欺: fraud's formal name.

犠.etymology: Phono-semantic: ox (牛) + 義 (phonetic ギ) — the flawless beast given up: sacrifice.
犠.mnemonic: The best of the herd, for the greater claim — ギ. 犠牲: what the plan cost.

菊.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 匊 (phonetic キク) — the imperial bloom: chrysanthemum.
菊.mnemonic: Petals packed like grains in a fist — キク. 菊: on passports and November altars.

吉.etymology: Compound ideograph: the gentleman's (士) word (口) — auspicious speech: good fortune.
吉.mnemonic: The fortune slip you hoped for — キチ. 大吉: the shrine's jackpot.

却.etymology: Compound: withdrawing (去) from the kneeling audience (卩) — sent back: to reject; contrary to expectation (却って).
却.mnemonic: The petition handed back at the steps — キャク. 返却 returns books; 却下 returns hopes.

脚.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 却 (phonetic キャク) — the supporting legs: shins, the legs of furniture and arguments.
脚.mnemonic: What everything stands on — あし, キャク. 脚本: the script — a play's legs.

虐.etymology: Compound: the tiger's claw raked downward — cruelty from power: to oppress.
虐.mnemonic: The claw with authority behind it — しいたげる. 虐待: the news word nobody wants.

丘.etymology: Pictograph: two low rises on the plain — a hill.
