丘.mnemonic: The mountain's apprentice — おか. 丘の上: every anime's confession spot.

及.etymology: Pictograph: a hand catching up to a person — to reach, extend to; 'and' in legal lists (及び).
及.mnemonic: Fingers closing on the runner's shoulder — およぶ. 普及: reaching everyone.

朽.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 丂 (phonetic キュウ) — timber gone soft: to rot.
朽.mnemonic: The beam your foot goes through — くちる. 不朽: the works that never do.

窮.etymology: Phono-semantic: hole (穴) + 躬 (phonetic キュウ) — the body bent in the last corner of the cave: destitute, cornered.
窮.mnemonic: Backed into the burrow's end — キュウ. 窮地: the corner with no next move.

糾.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 丩 (phonetic キュウ) — cords twisted tight; investigation winding to the truth: to examine severely.
糾.mnemonic: The interrogation braids every loose end — キュウ. 糾弾: censure, rope-tight.

拒.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 巨 (phonetic キョ) — the hand held out flat: to refuse.
拒.mnemonic: A palm the size of the request — こばむ. 拒否: no, in writing.

拠.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 処 (phonetic キョ) — the grip one stands on: base, grounds.
拠.mnemonic: The handhold the argument climbs from — キョ. 証拠: the grip that holds in court.

虚.etymology: Phono-semantic: 虍 (phonetic キョ) + a mound — the great abandoned hill: emptiness, falsehood (虚偽).
虚.mnemonic: The tiger guards an empty den — キョ. 虚しい: hollow, echoing.

距.etymology: Phono-semantic: foot (足) + 巨 (phonetic キョ) — the stretch between footfalls: distance.
距.mnemonic: Giant steps measured out — キョ. 距離: the number between here and there.

享.etymology: Pictograph: the offering hall receiving gifts — to receive, partake of.
享.mnemonic: The hall where blessings are served — キョウ. 享受: enjoying what came down to you.

lesson_examples.jp: 自（し）然（ぜん）を　享（きょう）受（じゅ）します。
lesson_examples.en: We enjoy the blessings of nature.

凶.etymology: Ideograph: a pit with a warning cross in it — misfortune: evil, calamity. The anti-吉.
凶.mnemonic: The fortune slip you fold and tie to the tree — キョウ. 凶器: the bad-luck tool.

lesson_examples.jp: おみくじで　凶（きょう）が　でました。
lesson_examples.en: I drew bad luck in the fortune slip.

峡.etymology: Phono-semantic: mountain (山) + 夾 'pressed between' (phonetic キョウ) — squeezed between peaks: a gorge, strait.
峡.mnemonic: Where the mountains stand shoulder to shoulder — キョウ. 海峡: the sea's gorge.

恭.etymology: Phono-semantic: 共 (phonetic キョウ) + heart below — the heart offered with both hands: reverent.
恭.mnemonic: Both hands and the heart, presented — うやうやしい. 恭賀新年: the New Year's deepest bow.

狂.etymology: Phono-semantic: beast (犭) + 王 (phonetic キョウ) — the animal running wild: mad, frenzied.
狂.mnemonic: The dog that crowned itself — くるう. 熱狂: crowds doing it together.

矯.etymology: Phono-semantic: arrow (矢) + 喬 (phonetic キョウ) — bending arrows true: to straighten, correct.
矯.mnemonic: The brace that unbends the shaft — キョウ. 歯列矯正: braces, dentally.

脅.etymology: Phono-semantic: 劦 'joined force' (phonetic キョウ) + flesh (月) — force pressed against the body: to menace.
脅.mnemonic: Three muscles against one ribcage — おどす. 脅迫: menace, notarized.

響.etymology: Phono-semantic: 郷 (phonetic キョウ) + sound (音) — sound returning across the village: echo, resonance.
響.mnemonic: The valley answers back — ひびく. 影響: the echo that changes things.

驚.etymology: Phono-semantic: 敬 (phonetic キョウ) + horse (馬) — the horse shying: startled: to be amazed.
驚.mnemonic: Even the horse jumped — おどろく. 驚き: the kanji with its mane up.

仰.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 卬 (phonetic ギョウ) — the face turned upward: to look up, revere; to say (honorific おっしゃる).
仰.mnemonic: Chin up toward the higher thing — あおぐ. 信仰: looking up, made a practice.

lesson_examples.jp: 空（そら）を　仰（あお）ぎます。
lesson_examples.en: I look up at the sky.

凝.etymology: Phono-semantic: ice (冫) + 疑 (phonetic ギョウ) — hesitation frozen solid: to congeal; attention frozen on one thing: engrossed.
凝.mnemonic: Stuck fast, by frost or fascination — こる. 凝る: hobbies and shoulders, both.

暁.etymology: Phono-semantic: sun (日) + 尭 (phonetic ギョウ) — the sun climbing the mound: dawn; the moment of realizing (暁に).
暁.mnemonic: The sun tops the ridge and everything is known — あかつき. 暁: poetry's favorite hour.

錦.etymology: Compound: cloth (帛) shot with gold (金) — woven splendor: brocade.
錦.mnemonic: Fabric with bullion in the weft — にしき. 錦鯉: the koi wearing it.

斤.etymology: Pictograph: an axe head on its haft — the axe; borrowed for the old weight unit (600g), now bread loaves.
斤.mnemonic: The axe that ended up in the bakery — キン. 食パン一斤: one loaf, by axe-weight.

琴.etymology: Phono-semantic: paired jades (strings' bridges) + 今 (phonetic キン) — the long zither: koto.
琴.mnemonic: Two gem-bright strings and the present moment — こと. 琴: the sound gardens are built around.

緊.etymology: Phono-semantic: 臤 (phonetic キン) + thread (糸) — the cord drawn taut: tense, urgent.
緊.mnemonic: The thread with no slack left — キン. 緊張: interviews, stages, first dates.

菌.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 囷 (phonetic キン) — growth in the sealed store: mold, fungus, bacteria.
菌.mnemonic: What blooms in the closed rice bin — キン. 殺菌: the counterstrike.

襟.etymology: Phono-semantic: garment (衤) + 禁 (phonetic キン) — the closing front of the robe: collar; the breast it guards: one's heart (襟を開く).
襟.mnemonic: The garment's border checkpoint — えり. 襟を正す: straightening collar and conduct.

謹.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 堇 (phonetic キン) — speech held careful: respectful, discreet.
謹.mnemonic: Words in their Sunday best — つつしむ. 謹賀新年: the card's most careful phrase.

吟.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 今 (phonetic ギン) — the drawn-out chant: to recite, hum.
吟.mnemonic: The now (今) sung slowly — ギン. 吟味: tasting words (or sake) line by line.

駆.etymology: Phono-semantic: horse (馬) + 区 (phonetic ク) — spurring across the district: to gallop, drive.
駆.mnemonic: Hooves through every ward — かける. 駆け込み乗車: the platform gallop.

駒.etymology: Phono-semantic: horse (馬) + 句 (phonetic ク) — the young horse: pony; the little 'horses' of shōgi: pieces.
駒.mnemonic: The pocket-size horse — こま. 将棋の駒: cavalry you can lose in a tatami seam.

愚.etymology: Phono-semantic: 禺 (phonetic グ) + heart (心) — the heart aping about: folly.
愚.mnemonic: A monkey at the controls of the heart — おろか. 愚痴: folly's favorite output — complaints.

虞.etymology: Phono-semantic: 虍 (phonetic グ) + 呉 — foreseen danger: apprehension (the legal 〜のおそれ).
虞.mnemonic: The tiger you plan around — おそれ. 虞: statute-book worry.

遇.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 禺 (phonetic グウ) — met on the road: to encounter; how one is met: treatment (待遇).
遇.mnemonic: The chance meeting that sets your salary — グウ. 待遇: how the road treats you.

屈.etymology: Compound: the body (尸) bent to get out (出) — to bend, submit; bent spirits: boredom (退屈).
屈.mnemonic: Folded double under the low exit — かがむ. 退屈: the spirit slouching.

繰.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 喿 (phonetic ソウ→く) — winding thread in: to reel; to turn over in sequence (繰り返す).
繰.mnemonic: Hand over hand on the spool — くる. 繰り返す: rewind, replay, repeat.

桑.etymology: Pictograph: the tree of many picking hands (又×3) — the silkworm's mulberry.
桑.mnemonic: Hands all over the branches at harvest — くわ. 桑: the silk industry's root.

勲.etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + 力 — service that earns the decoration: merit.
勲.mnemonic: Effort that smells of gun-smoke and medals — クン. 勲章: the chest hardware.

薫.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + a phonetic — scent carried on smoke: fragrant.
薫.mnemonic: Herbs on the coals — かおる. 薫風: May's perfumed wind.

刑.etymology: Phono-semantic: 开 (phonetic ケイ) + blade (刂) — the law's blade: punishment.
刑.mnemonic: The sentence with an edge — ケイ. 刑事: the detective who serves it.

lesson_examples.jp: おもい　刑（けい）です。

啓.etymology: Compound: the hand opening the door (戸) for the word (口) — to open, instruct; letters' opening bow (拝啓).
啓.mnemonic: Door opened, truth announced — ケイ. 拝啓: the letter's knock.

契.etymology: Compound: the tally notched with a blade — the cut both parties keep: pledge, contract.
契.mnemonic: One cut, two halves, one promise — ちぎる. 契約: the notch, in triplicate.

慶.etymology: Compound: bringing a deer-hide gift with a glad heart — congratulation, felicity.
慶.mnemonic: Arriving with gifts and a full heart — ケイ. 慶応: the era, the university, the joy.

憩.etymology: Compound: catching breath (息) and tongue — pausing: rest.
憩.mnemonic: Breath and voice both on break — いこい. 休憩: the ten sacred minutes.

掲.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 曷 (phonetic ケイ) — raised for all to see: to post, hoist.
掲.mnemonic: Pinned at eye height — かかげる. 掲示板: the bulletin board, then the internet forum.

携.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + a phonetic — kept in hand: to carry on one; to cooperate (提携).
携.mnemonic: Never sets it down — たずさえる. 携帯: the device this kanji predicted.

渓.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 奚 (phonetic ケイ) — the stream in the ravine: mountain torrent.
渓.mnemonic: Water with cliffs for banks — ケイ. 渓谷: the postcard gorge.

継.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 繼): thread (糸) + a phonetic — the thread spliced on: to succeed, inherit.
継.mnemonic: The line knotted to the next spool — つぐ. 中継 relays; 後継者 inherits.

茎.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 巠 (phonetic ケイ) — the plant's vertical line: stem.
茎.mnemonic: The green mast the leaves rig onto — くき. 茎: what the vase actually holds.

蛍.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 螢): blazing crown + insect (虫) — the bug that carries fire: firefly.
蛍.mnemonic: The insect with its own lantern — ほたる. 蛍光灯: fluorescent light, named after it.

鶏.etymology: Phono-semantic: 奚 (phonetic ケイ) + bird (鳥) — the yard bird: chicken.
鶏.mnemonic: The bird on a string in the yard — にわとり. 鶏肉: the menu's plainest kanji.

鯨.etymology: Phono-semantic: fish (魚) + 京 (phonetic ゲイ) — the capital-sized fish: whale.
鯨.mnemonic: A fish the size of a city — くじら. 鯨: the ocean's metropolis.

撃.etymology: Phono-semantic: a striking phonetic + hand (手) — the blow landed: to strike, attack, shoot.
撃.mnemonic: The hand under the war-cart — うつ. 攻撃, 衝撃, 目撃: strikes physical, emotional, visual.

傑.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 桀 (phonetic ケツ) — the one standing above the crowd: outstanding.
傑.mnemonic: Head and shoulders over the grove — ケツ. 傑作: the masterpiece shelf.

lesson_examples.jp: 傑（けっ）作（さく）が　できました。

倹.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 僉 (phonetic ケン) — a person who tallies everything: thrifty.
倹.mnemonic: Counts every coin twice — ケン. 倹約: the budget's kanji.

lesson_examples.jp: 倹（けん）約（やく）して　お金（かね）を　ためます。
lesson_examples.en: I save money by being frugal.

兼.etymology: Pictograph: one hand holding two grain stalks — doing both at once: concurrent.
兼.mnemonic: Two jobs in one fist — かねる. 兼業: the side-hustle kanji, a millennium early.

剣.etymology: Phono-semantic: 僉 (phonetic ケン) + blade (刂) — the double-edged sword: saber.
剣.mnemonic: 刀's formal duelist cousin — つるぎ. 剣道: the way of this kanji.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　剣（けん）です。

圏.etymology: Phono-semantic: enclosure (囗) + 巻 (phonetic ケン) — the drawn circle: sphere, range.
圏.mnemonic: The circle you function inside — ケン. 首都圏, 圏外: the commuter belt, and where your phone gives up.

堅.etymology: Phono-semantic: 臤 (phonetic ケン) + earth (土) — ground packed hard: solid, steadfast.
堅.mnemonic: Earth you could build a vow on — かたい. 堅実: reliably unexciting, admirably so.

嫌.etymology: Phono-semantic: 女 + 兼 (phonetic ケン) — suspicion held alongside: dislike, aversion.
嫌.mnemonic: Holding the grudge and the smile at once — きらい, いや. 機嫌: the mood dial.

懸.etymology: Phono-semantic: 県 (originally 'to hang') + thread + heart — hung in the air, heart included: suspended, at stake.
懸.mnemonic: The heart dangling by its thread — かかる. 懸命: living like everything hangs on it — because it does.

拳.etymology: Phono-semantic: a rolling phonetic + hand (手) — the hand rolled closed: fist.
拳.mnemonic: The hand packed like a rice ball — こぶし. 拳: じゃんけん's rock, formally.

献.etymology: Compound: the sacrificial dog (犬) at the tripod — presented upward: to offer, donate.
献.mnemonic: Placed on the altar with both hands — ケン. 献血: the modern offering, 400ml.

謙.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 兼 (phonetic ケン) — speech that holds itself back: humble.
謙.mnemonic: The voice that gives others the credit — ケン. 謙譲語: grammar for bowing.

遣.etymology: Compound: sent down the road (辶) with a charge — to dispatch; care spent (気遣い).
遣.mnemonic: Handed the packet and pointed at the horizon — つかわす. 派遣: dispatch, employment-agency edition.

顕.etymology: Phono-semantic: a bright phonetic + head (頁) — brought into full light: manifest, prominent.
顕.mnemonic: Held up where the light hits it — ケン. 顕微鏡: the microscope, maker of the invisible visible.

幻.etymology: Pictograph: a thread twisted to look reversed — what the eye is tricked into: illusion.
幻.mnemonic: A thread of almost-real — まぼろし. 幻: the pokémon, fittingly.

lesson_examples.jp: それは　幻（まぼろし）でした。

弦.etymology: Phono-semantic: bow (弓) + 玄 (phonetic ゲン) — the taut cord: bowstring, instrument string.
弦.mnemonic: The dark line that sings — つる. 弦楽器: strings, orchestral.

玄.etymology: Pictograph: dyed thread hung dark — deep black-red: dark, profound.
玄.mnemonic: The color of deep questions — ゲン. 玄関: the dark threshold; 玄米: rice still in its mystery.

孤.etymology: Phono-semantic: child (子) + 瓜 (phonetic コ) — the child left on the vine: orphan, solitary.
孤.mnemonic: One child, one melon, one field — コ. 孤独: solitude with no exit sign.

弧.etymology: Phono-semantic: bow (弓) + 瓜 (phonetic コ) — the bow's curve: an arc.
弧.mnemonic: The bow's shape without the shot — コ. 括弧: brackets — twin arcs holding words.

虎.etymology: Pictograph: the tiger — striped head (虍) and springing legs.
虎.mnemonic: The stripes walk on two strokes — とら. 虎: Osaka's baseball religion.

誇.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 夸 'inflate' (phonetic コ) — speech puffed large: to boast; held high: pride (誇り).
誇.mnemonic: Words a size bigger than the facts — ほこる. 誇り: the good kind, worn quietly.

顧.etymology: Phono-semantic: 雇 (phonetic コ) + head (頁) — the head turned to what's behind: to review, regard.
顧.mnemonic: The glance over the shoulder at the years — かえりみる. 顧客: the customer you keep looking after.

鼓.etymology: Compound ideograph: the drum (壴) and the hand beating it (支) — drum; to rouse (鼓舞).
鼓.mnemonic: Stand, skin, stick — つづみ. 鼓動: the chest's house drummer.

呉.etymology: Pictograph: a figure with head thrown back mid-speech — the old state of Wu; in Japanese, to give (呉れる).
呉.mnemonic: The kingdom that keeps giving — くれる. 呉服: kimono cloth, named for Wu's weavers.

lesson_examples.jp: これを　呉（く）れる？

娯.etymology: Phono-semantic: 女 + 呉 (phonetic ゴ) — delight taken: amusement.
娯.mnemonic: Fun, scheduled — ゴ. 娯楽: the entertainment column.

悟.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 吾 'I' (phonetic ゴ) — the heart meeting itself: to realize, awaken.
悟.mnemonic: The moment 'I' and the heart finally agree — さとる. 悟り: satori, this very kanji.

碁.etymology: Phono-semantic: 其 (phonetic ゴ) + stone (石) — the game of placed stones: Go.
碁.mnemonic: Stones on the grid — ゴ. 囲碁: territory, one pebble at a time.

侯.etymology: Pictograph: the archery target of the nobles' rite — the rank that shot at it: marquis.
侯.mnemonic: Nobility measured at the archery butt — コウ. 諸侯: the assembled lords.

lesson_examples.jp: 侯（こう）爵（しゃく）の　やしきです。

坑.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 亢 (phonetic コウ) — the dug shaft: pit.
坑.mnemonic: The hole with rails going down — コウ. 炭坑: the coal pit of old songs.

孔.etymology: Pictograph: the opening at the infant's crown — an orifice: hole; also Confucius' name (孔子).
孔.mnemonic: The smallest official hole — コウ. 孔: needle-eyes and philosopher-names.

巧.etymology: Phono-semantic: 工 + 丂 (phonetic コウ) — craft with finesse in it: skillful.
巧.mnemonic: The work with no visible effort — たくみ. 巧妙: cleverness you notice too late.

恒.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 亘 (phonetic コウ) — the heart unchanged across time: constant.
恒.mnemonic: Same heart, every visit — コウ. 恒例: the annual, without fail.

慌.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 荒 (phonetic コウ) — the heart gone to weeds: flustered.
慌.mnemonic: The heart's tidy field in sudden chaos — あわてる. 慌てる: keys, train, panic.

抗.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 亢 (phonetic コウ) — the hand raised against: to resist.
抗.mnemonic: Palm out, neck up — コウ. 抗議: resistance with signatures.

拘.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 句 (phonetic コウ) — held fast: to detain; held to details: particular (拘る).
拘.mnemonic: Gripped and not released — コウ. こだわり: the chef's arrest of one ingredient.

控.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 空 (phonetic コウ) — the hand drawn back: to hold off, note down, wait.
控.mnemonic: Reaching, then pulling back into the empty — ひかえる. 控え室: the waiting room of restraint.

攻.etymology: Phono-semantic: 工 (phonetic コウ) + 攵 'strike' — worked over by force: to attack; to specialize in (専攻).
攻.mnemonic: Engineering applied to the enemy — せめる. 攻略: attack turned into a walkthrough guide.

江.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 工 (phonetic コウ) — originally the Yangtze; in Japan, the inlet: creek.
江.mnemonic: The workaday waterway — え. 江戸: the inlet-door that became Tokyo.

洪.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 共 (phonetic コウ) — all waters at once: flood.
洪.mnemonic: Every river RSVPs yes — コウ. 洪水: the deluge proper.

溝.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 冓 (phonetic コウ) — the built channel: ditch; the gap between people (溝ができる).
溝.mnemonic: Water in its assigned lane — みぞ. 溝: also the rift no plumber fixes.

甲.etymology: Pictograph: a seed bursting its shell — the hard casing: armor, shell (甲羅); the first of the ordinal signs.
甲.mnemonic: The shell with a sprout's tail — コウ. 甲乙: ranks A and B; 甲子園: stadium of the first rank.

稿.etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + 高 (phonetic コウ) — originally straw; the rough straw-stage of writing: a draft.
稿.mnemonic: Writing still in the husk — コウ. 原稿: the manuscript, deadline attached.

絞.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 交 (phonetic コウ) — cords crossed and twisted tight: to wring, strangle.
絞.mnemonic: The towel twisted to its last drop — しぼる. 絞る: also what exams do to brains.

綱.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 岡 (phonetic コウ) — the master rope: hawser; the guiding line: principle (綱領).
綱.mnemonic: The rope everything else is tied to — つな. 綱引き: tug-of-war on the main line.

衡.etymology: Compound: the balance beam carried level between (行) — the crossbar of scales: equilibrium.
衡.mnemonic: The beam that must not tip — コウ. 均衡: balance, treaty-grade.

貢.etymology: Phono-semantic: 工 (phonetic コウ) + 貝 — goods sent up to the court: tribute; to contribute (貢献).
貢.mnemonic: The wagon of goods heading to the capital — みつぐ. 貢献: tribute turned teamwork.

購.etymology: Phono-semantic: money (貝) + 冓 (phonetic コウ) — structured buying: to purchase.
購.mnemonic: Money exchanged through the lattice — コウ. 購入: the checkout kanji.

酵.etymology: Phono-semantic: jar (酉) + 孝 (phonetic コウ) — the brew working: fermentation, yeast.
酵.mnemonic: The jar's dutiful bubbling — コウ. 発酵: bread, miso, and time.

項.etymology: Phono-semantic: 工 (phonetic コウ) + head (頁) — originally the nape; each 'head' of a text: item, clause.
項.mnemonic: Every heading gets its number — コウ. 項目: the list's skeleton.

剛.etymology: Phono-semantic: 岡 (phonetic ゴウ) + blade (刂) — hard as a tempered edge: stalwart.
剛.mnemonic: Ridge-hard steel — ゴウ. 金剛: diamond-hard, temple-guardian grade.

拷.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 考 (phonetic ゴウ) — interrogation by force: torture.
拷.mnemonic: 考's dark interrogation twin — ゴウ. 拷問: the word history apologizes for.

豪.etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + 豕 — originally the bristling porcupine: formidable, magnificent; Australia (豪州).
豪.mnemonic: The boar in the high hall — ゴウ. 豪華: grandeur with bristles.

克.etymology: Pictograph: a figure bearing a heavy helm and standing anyway — to prevail: overcome.
克.mnemonic: Carrying ten (十) troubles and still walking — コク. 克服: the comeback kanji.

酷.etymology: Phono-semantic: jar (酉) + 告 (phonetic コク) — liquor harsh on the throat: severe, cruel.
酷.mnemonic: The vintage that punishes — コク. 残酷: cruelty, and 酷暑: August.

獄.etymology: Compound: two dogs (犭,犬) snarling over testimony (言) — the lawsuit's end: prison.
獄.mnemonic: Guard dogs on both sides of the deposition — ゴク. 地獄: the prison below all prisons.

墾.etymology: Phono-semantic: a rooting-beast phonetic + earth (土) — wild land clawed open: to break ground.
墾.mnemonic: Claws before plows — コン. 開墾: the frontier verb.

恨.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 艮 (phonetic コン) — the heart that won't let go: grudge.
恨.mnemonic: The splinter kept on purpose — うらむ. 恨み: grievance with a shrine.

懇.etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + heart (心) — the heart worked over thoroughly: earnest, intimate.
懇.mnemonic: Sincerity that digs in — コン. 懇親会: the bonding banquet.

昆.etymology: Compound: the swarm under the sun (日) lined up (比) — multitudes: descendants; the swarming class: insects (昆虫).
昆.mnemonic: Rows of little lives in the light — コン. 昆布: kelp, the sea's crowd.

紺.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 甘 (phonetic コン) — cloth dyed deepest indigo: navy.
紺.mnemonic: Indigo steeped until sweet-dark — コン. 紺色: the school-uniform sea.

魂.etymology: Phono-semantic: 云 (phonetic コン) + 鬼 — the spirit-breath of the dead: soul.
魂.mnemonic: The vapor the ghost is made of — たましい. 大和魂: the national soul, capital S.

唆.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 夋 (phonetic サ) — whispered urging: to instigate.
唆.mnemonic: The voice at your shoulder with bad ideas — そそのかす. 示唆: its respectable cousin — suggestion.

沙.etymology: Compound ideograph: water (氵) + 少 — stone worn few and fine by water: sand (the elegant twin of 砂).
沙.mnemonic: What the river leaves when it's done — サ. ご無沙汰: 'long silence' — sand gathered on the correspondence.

詐.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 乍 (phonetic サ) — words cut to deceive: fraud.
詐.mnemonic: A story carved to fit your wallet — サ. 詐欺: the phone call to hang up on.

鎖.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + a phonetic — links locked in series: chain; to close off (鎖国).
鎖.mnemonic: Small rings holding like money holds people — くさり. 鎖国: the chained country era.

債.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 責 (phonetic サイ) — obligation personified: debt, bond.
債.mnemonic: 責 with a co-signer — サイ. 国債: the nation's IOU.

催.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 崔 (phonetic サイ) — pressing something into happening: to hold, urge (催促).
催.mnemonic: The one who makes the event exist — もよおす. 開催: doors open, banners up.

lesson_examples.jp: たいかいを　催（もよお）します。

宰.etymology: Compound: the knife-and-needle work of the household (宀) — the steward who runs it: to manage.
宰.mnemonic: The sharp one under the roof who decides — サイ. 主宰: running the show.

彩.etymology: Phono-semantic: 采 (phonetic サイ) + 彡 'strokes' — hues laid on: coloring.
彩.mnemonic: Three brushstrokes of gathered color — いろどる. 色彩: the palette's formal name.

栽.etymology: Phono-semantic: 𢦏 (phonetic サイ) + tree (木) — trees set out with care: to cultivate.
栽.mnemonic: Pruned into art — サイ. 盆栽: the tree kept bonsai-small.

采.etymology: Pictograph: a hand plucking from a tree — gathering; the gathered look of things: mien; the tossed lot: dice (采配).
采.mnemonic: The hand that picks — and the general's baton it became — サイ. 采配を振る: calling the plays.

砕.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 碎): stone (石) + a phonetic — broken to bits: to crush.
砕.mnemonic: Rock reduced to gravel — くだく. 粉砕: pulverized — arguments included. Your seventh CS-Kanji.

斎.etymology: Phono-semantic: 斉 (phonetic サイ) — abstinence before rites: purification; the quiet room for it: a study (書斎).
斎.mnemonic: Cleansed, quiet, shelved with books — サイ. 書斎: the room this kanji would live in.

載.etymology: Phono-semantic: 𢦏 (phonetic サイ) + cart (車) — set aboard: to load; set into print: to publish (掲載).
載.mnemonic: Cargo on the cart, articles on the page — のせる. 記載: loaded into the record.

剤.etymology: Phono-semantic: 斉 'even' (phonetic ザイ) + blade (刂) — medicine cut to even doses: a preparation.
剤.mnemonic: The pharmacist's even portions — ザイ. 洗剤: the cleaning agent under your sink.

削.etymology: Phono-semantic: 肖 (phonetic サク) + blade (刂) — shaved away: to whittle, cut down.
削.mnemonic: Shavings curling off the pencil — けずる. 削除: whittled to zero — delete.

搾.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + a phonetic — pressed until it yields: to squeeze, exploit.
搾.mnemonic: The press coming down — しぼる. 搾取: squeezing people, economics' ugly word.

索.etymology: Pictograph: hands twisting rope — the cord; following it hand over hand: to search (検索).
索.mnemonic: Pull the rope till the answer surfaces — サク. 検索: this kanji, every time you google.

錯.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 昔 (phonetic サク) — inlaid metals crossing: interleaved, mixed up.
錯.mnemonic: Gold and iron braided until no one can say which is which — サク. 錯覚: the senses' inlay error.

撮.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 最 (phonetic サツ) — pinching the moment out of time: to photograph.
撮.mnemonic: The moment seized between two fingers — とる. 撮影: the shutter kanji.

擦.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 察 (phonetic サツ) — surface against surface: to rub, scrape.
擦.mnemonic: The hand that polishes and the knee that pays — する, こする. 摩擦: friction, physical and diplomatic.

傘.etymology: Pictograph: the canopy with people and ribs beneath — an umbrella.
傘.mnemonic: The kanji IS the drawing — かさ. 傘: four strangers sharing one in a downpour.

惨.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 参 (phonetic サン) — the heart pierced by the scene: miserable, cruel.
惨.mnemonic: What you wish you hadn't gone (参) to see — みじめ. 悲惨: the accident-report adjective.

桟.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 戔 (phonetic サン) — planking over the void: scaffold, wharf.
桟.mnemonic: Boards where there was only air — サン. 桟橋: the pier's plank walk.

暫.etymology: Phono-semantic: 斬 'cut' (phonetic ザン) + 日 — a slice of time: a while.
暫.mnemonic: A day cut short on purpose — しばらく. 暫く: 'see you in a slice'.

嗣.etymology: Compound: the successor named aloud (口) from the registry (冊) by authority (司) — the heir.
嗣.mnemonic: The name read from the family book — シ. 嗣ぐ: to carry the register on.

施.etymology: Phono-semantic: the banner radical + 也 (phonetic シ/セ) — carried out under the standard: to administer, bestow.
施.mnemonic: Under the flag, works distributed — ほどこす. 施設: what administration builds.

旨.etymology: Compound: the spoon (匕) at something sweet — tasty; the taste of a statement: its gist.
旨.mnemonic: One spoonful tells you everything — うまい, むね. 要旨: the dish reduced to its flavor.

祉.etymology: Phono-semantic: altar (ネ) + 止 (phonetic シ) — blessing that comes to rest on one: welfare.
祉.mnemonic: Fortune told to stay put — シ. 福祉: blessing, institutionalized.

紫.etymology: Phono-semantic: 此 (phonetic シ) + thread (糸) — the costliest dye of antiquity: purple.
紫.mnemonic: The thread only royalty could afford — むらさき. 紫式部 wrote under its name.

肢.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 支 'branch' (phonetic シ) — the body's branches: limbs.
肢.mnemonic: The trunk's four branches — シ. 選択肢: choices — the decision's limbs.

諮.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 咨 (phonetic シ) — asking those below: to consult.
諮.mnemonic: The chairman actually asking — はかる. 諮問: the committee's summons.

賜.etymology: Phono-semantic: treasure (貝) + 易 (phonetic シ) — handed down from above: to bestow.
賜.mnemonic: Received with both hands and a bow — たまわる. 賜る: keigo's gift verb.

雌.etymology: Phono-semantic: 此 (phonetic シ) + bird (隹) — the hen side of the pair: female.
雌.mnemonic: The quieter half of the birdsong — めす. 雌雄: female and male, biology's pair.

侍.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 寺 'administration' (phonetic ジ) — one in attendance on a lord: retainer — the samurai.
侍.mnemonic: The one who serves standing — さむらい. 侍: the sword was the side detail.

慈.etymology: Phono-semantic: 茲 (phonetic ジ) + heart (心) — the nurturing heart: mercy, parental love.
慈.mnemonic: The heart that feeds before it asks — いつくしむ. 慈悲: mercy in temple script.

璽.etymology: Phono-semantic: 爾 (phonetic ジ) + jade (玉) — the sovereign's jade stamp: the imperial seal.
璽.mnemonic: The one stamp above all stamps — ジ. 御璽: the emperor's ink.

軸.etymology: Phono-semantic: cart (車) + 由 (phonetic ジク) — the shaft wheels turn on: axle, axis.
軸.mnemonic: What everything else revolves around — ジク. 軸: graphs, scrolls, and arguments all have one.

examples.reading:
しゅうじゃく
しゅうちゃく

執.etymology: Compound: hands clamped in the manacles' grip (幸+丸) — seized fast: to grasp, carry out; refusal to release: obsession (執着).
執.mnemonic: The grip that outlasts reason — とる, シツ. 執筆: gripping the pen till the book exists.

漆.etymology: Phono-semantic: liquid (氵) + 桼 'sap tree' (phonetic シツ) — the tree's black gloss: lacquer.
漆.mnemonic: Tree-blood polished to a mirror — うるし. 漆器: Japan's glossiest export.

疾.etymology: Compound: illness (疒) striking arrow-fast (矢) — disease; arrow-speed itself: swift.
疾.mnemonic: The arrow that brings the fever — シツ. 疾走: running like the arrow, not the patient.

芝.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 之 (phonetic シ) — the low spreading grass: lawn.
芝.mnemonic: Grass cut to golf height — しば. 芝居: theater — once played on the lawn.

赦.etymology: Phono-semantic: 赤 (phonetic シャ) + 攵 — the rod lowered: to forgive.
赦.mnemonic: The sentence commuted at the red seal — シャ. 恩赦: the state's rare mercy.

斜.etymology: Phono-semantic: 余 (phonetic シャ) + 斗 'ladle' — poured at a tilt: slanting.
斜.mnemonic: The ladle that can't pour straight — ななめ. 斜め: the angle of mischief.

煮.etymology: Phono-semantic: 者 (phonetic シャ — itself originally 'boiling') + fire (灬) — the pot at work: to simmer.
煮.mnemonic: 者 finally gets its fire back — にる. 煮物: the simmered side dish.

遮.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 庶 (phonetic シャ) — stepped into the path: to block.
遮.mnemonic: The crowd closing the road — さえぎる. 遮断機: the railway crossing's arm.

蛇.etymology: Compound: 虫 (originally the viper) + 它 (also originally a snake) — doubly serpent: snake.
蛇.mnemonic: The creature so snake it's written twice — へび. 蛇口: the faucet — a tamed snake's mouth.

邪.etymology: Phono-semantic: 牙 (phonetic ジャ) + city (阝) — crooked ways: wicked, evil; the body's invader: 風邪.
邪.mnemonic: Tusks inside the city walls — ジャ. 邪魔: evil's polite little brother — 'excuse the intrusion'.

爵.etymology: Pictograph: the sparrow-shaped bronze wine cup of investiture — the rank it conferred: peerage.
爵.mnemonic: The cup that made you nobility — シャク. 男爵: the baron — and the potato named after one.

酌.etymology: Compound: jar (酉) + ladle (勺) — pouring for another: to serve; to weigh circumstances (酌量).
酌.mnemonic: The ladle at the jar, reading the room — シャク. 晩酌: the evening pour.

釈.etymology: Phono-semantic: 釆 'distinguish' + 尺 (phonetic シャク) — untangled and let go: to explain, release; Shakyamuni (釈迦).
釈.mnemonic: The knot explained until it unties itself — シャク. 解釈: interpretation, licensed.

寂.etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 叔 (phonetic ジャク) — the hushed house: still, lonely; Buddhist tranquility (寂滅).
寂.mnemonic: The house after everyone left — さびしい. わび寂び: loneliness aged into beauty.

朱.etymology: Ideograph: a tree with its red heartwood marked — the red pigment: vermilion.
朱.mnemonic: The red inside the trunk — シュ. 朱印: the shrine's vermilion stamp.

殊.etymology: Phono-semantic: 歹 + 朱 (phonetic シュ) — set apart from the rest: special, particular.
殊.mnemonic: The one marked in red — こと. 特殊: filed under 'exceptional'.

狩.etymology: Phono-semantic: hound (犭) + 守 (phonetic シュ) — the managed chase: to hunt.
狩.mnemonic: Dog and warden working the woods — かり. 紅葉狩り: hunting autumn leaves, harmlessly.

珠.etymology: Phono-semantic: jade (王) + 朱 (phonetic シュ) — the round treasure: pearl.
珠.mnemonic: The gem the oyster signs in red — シュ. 真珠: the true pearl of Mikimoto.

趣.etymology: Phono-semantic: run (走) + 取 (phonetic シュ) — where one's interest runs and takes hold: flavor, intent, hobby.
趣.mnemonic: What you chase for no salary — おもむき. 趣味: the weekend's true employer.

儒.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 需 (phonetic ジュ) — the scholar society requires: Confucian.
儒.mnemonic: The needed man with the classics — ジュ. 儒教: the curriculum of empires.

寿.etymology: Simplified from 壽: the long winding road of years — long life, felicitations.
寿.mnemonic: Years stacked with a bow on top — ことぶき. 寿司: named 'felicitous' — and it is.

需.etymology: Compound: waiting under the rain (雨) — what one waits needing: demand.
需.mnemonic: Standing in the rain until supply arrives — ジュ. 需要: the market's umbrella-less crowd.

囚.etymology: Compound ideograph: a person (人) inside walls (囗) — the prisoner, drawn literally.
囚.mnemonic: The kanji is its own cell — シュウ. 囚人: the diagram with a name.

愁.etymology: Phono-semantic: 秋 (phonetic シュウ) + heart (心) — the autumn heart: melancholy.
愁.mnemonic: The season falls inside the chest — うれい. 郷愁: homesickness in October light.

秀.etymology: Compound: the grain stalk that outgrows the field — standing above: excellent.
秀.mnemonic: One ear taller than the harvest — ひいでる. 優秀: the transcript word.

臭.etymology: Compound ideograph: the nose (自) of the dog (犬) — smell itself; gone bad: stink.
臭.mnemonic: What the dog's nose finds first — くさい. 臭い: socks, drains, cover-ups.

襲.etymology: Phono-semantic: 龍 (phonetic シュウ) + 衣 — layered robes: to inherit (襲名); falling on like a cloak: to attack.
襲.mnemonic: The dragon drops from above wearing your ancestor's coat — おそう. 襲撃 and 世襲: raids and dynasties.

酬.etymology: Phono-semantic: jar (酉) + 州 (phonetic シュウ) — the answering toast: to reciprocate, reward.
酬.mnemonic: The return pour — シュウ. 報酬: the toast in currency form.

醜.etymology: Phono-semantic: 酉 (phonetic シュウ) + 鬼 — the drunken demon face: ugly, shameful.
醜.mnemonic: The ghost after the third jar — みにくい. 醜い: conduct more often than faces.

充.etymology: Pictograph: a child grown to fill its frame — filled: to fill, be sufficient.
充.mnemonic: Topped up to the line — あてる. 充電: filling the battery — and yourself on weekends.

lesson_examples.jp: 電（でん）池（ち）を　充（じゅう）電（でん）します。

汁.etymology: Phono-semantic: liquid (氵) + 十 (phonetic ジュウ) — the essence pressed out: juice, broth.
汁.mnemonic: Ten drops of the good part — しる. みそ汁: the daily bowl.

渋.etymology: Compound (simplified from 澁): water that puckers and stalls — astringent; movement that stalls: hesitant, congested (渋滞).
渋.mnemonic: The persimmon that seizes your mouth — しぶい. 渋谷: astringent valley — now the least hesitant crossing on earth.

獣.etymology: Compound (simplified from 獸): the hunt with dogs (犬) — the quarry: beast.
獣.mnemonic: Everything the hunt was for — けもの. 野獣: the beast of the fairy tale.

銃.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 充 (phonetic ジュウ) — the loaded barrel: firearm.
銃.mnemonic: Metal, filled — ジュウ. 銃: the kanji Japan reads more than sees.

叔.etymology: Phono-semantic origin as 'to gather beans'; borrowed for the third brother: the younger uncle.
叔.mnemonic: The younger of dad's brothers — シュク. 叔父さん: the uncle who spoils you.

淑.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 叔 (phonetic シュク) — clear as still water: virtuous, refined (of women, classically).
淑.mnemonic: Composure like an unrippled pond — シュク. 淑女: the textbook lady.

粛.etymology: Compound (simplified from 肅): work done with held breath — solemn, hushed, strict.
粛.mnemonic: The room where everyone straightens — シュク. 厳粛: gravity, ceremonial strength.

塾.etymology: Phono-semantic: 孰 (phonetic ジュク) + earth (土) — the gatehouse school: private academy.
塾.mnemonic: Where evenings go to study — ジュク. 塾: the second school after school.

俊.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 夋 (phonetic シュン) — the one who outpaces: talented.
俊.mnemonic: Quickest mind in the row — シュン. 俊足: the fast legs version.

lesson_examples.jp: 俊（しゅん）足（そく）の　選（せん）手（しゅ）です。

瞬.etymology: Phono-semantic: eye (目) + 舜 (phonetic シュン) — the eye's quickest motion: a blink, an instant.
瞬.mnemonic: Gone between lid and lid — またたき. 一瞬: the camera's enemy.

准.etymology: Variant of 準 used in official titles — approved at the associate grade: quasi-, associate.
准.mnemonic: 準 minus the water, plus a title — ジュン. 准教授: associate professor.

lesson_examples.jp: 准（じゅん）教（きょう）授（じゅ）に　なりました。

循.etymology: Phono-semantic: step (彳) + 盾 (phonetic ジュン) — going along the line: to follow, circulate.
循.mnemonic: Round the circuit behind the shield — ジュン. 循環: the loop — blood, buses, economies.

旬.etymology: Compound: days (日) bundled (勹) by tens — the ten-day week of the old calendar; the season's peak: 旬.
旬.mnemonic: Ten days wrapped to ripeness — シュン. 旬の魚: the fish at its own peak.

殉.etymology: Phono-semantic: death (歹) + 旬 (phonetic ジュン) — dying in the following of: martyrdom.
殉.mnemonic: Following even into the grave — ジュン. 殉職: died at one's post.

潤.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 閏 (phonetic ジュン) — moisture that enriches: to moisten, profit.
潤.mnemonic: The rain that fattens the fields and the ledger — うるおう. 利潤: profit, well-watered.

盾.etymology: Pictograph: a shield with its eye-slit (目) — the shield.
盾.mnemonic: The board with an eye behind it — たて. 矛盾: spear vs shield — the original contradiction.

巡.etymology: Compound: moving (辶) like a winding stream (巛) — the rounds: to patrol, tour.
巡.mnemonic: The beat cop's looping route — めぐる. お巡りさん: the patrol, personified.

lesson_examples.jp: まちを　巡（めぐ）ります。

遵.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 尊 (phonetic ジュン) — walking the revered line: to comply.
遵.mnemonic: The path followed out of respect — ジュン. 遵守: compliance, notarized.

庶.etymology: Compound: the many at the hearth under one roof — the multitude: commoners, various.
庶.mnemonic: Everyone around the kitchen fire — ショ. 庶民: the people, unranked.

叙.etymology: Phono-semantic: 余 (phonetic ジョ) + hand (又) — setting things in order: to confer (rank), to narrate.
叙.mnemonic: Events dealt out in order like cards — ジョ. 叙述: narration; 叙勲: the medal ceremony.

徐.etymology: Phono-semantic: step (彳) + 余 (phonetic ジョ) — walking with time to spare: slowly.
徐.mnemonic: No hurry in the stride — ジョ. 徐々に: little by little, officially.

償.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 賞 (phonetic ショウ) — payment rendered back: to compensate.
償.mnemonic: The prize paid in reverse — つぐなう. 弁償: the broken-window bill.

匠.etymology: Compound ideograph: the axe (斤) in its toolbox (匚) — the craftsman: artisan.
匠.mnemonic: The tool chest that thinks — ショウ. 巨匠: the master of masters.

升.etymology: Pictograph: the grain measure — the shō (1.8L): measuring box.
升.mnemonic: The wooden cube sake still respects — ます. 一升瓶: the big bottle.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　升（ます）です。

奨.etymology: Phono-semantic: 将 (phonetic ショウ) + 大 — urging toward greatness: to encourage.
奨.mnemonic: The coach's push with funding attached — ショウ. 奨学金: encouragement you repay.

宵.etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 肖 (phonetic ショウ) — the hours after lamps are lit: early night.
宵.mnemonic: Lanterns on, streets warm — よい. 今宵: tonight, said beautifully.

尚.etymology: Pictograph: rising above the roofline — held high: esteem; furthermore.
尚.mnemonic: Held one notch above — なお. 尚: the formal 'moreover' at paragraph heads.

lesson_examples.jp: 尚（なお）、ちゅういしてください。

彰.etymology: Phono-semantic: 章 (phonetic ショウ) + 彡 — merit made visible: to make clear, commend.
彰.mnemonic: The badge with light rays drawn on — ショウ. 表彰: the certificate moment.

抄.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 少 (phonetic ショウ) — a little taken out: excerpt.
抄.mnemonic: A pinch of the text — ショウ. 抄訳: the abridged translation.

掌.etymology: Phono-semantic: 尚 (phonetic ショウ) + hand (手) — the hand's flat: palm; to hold in it: control.
掌.mnemonic: Everything in the flat of one hand — ショウ. 車掌: the conductor — the train in his palm.

晶.etymology: Compound ideograph: three suns (日×3) — concentrated light: crystal.
晶.mnemonic: Light stacked three deep — ショウ. 水晶: quartz — frozen triple sunlight.

沼.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 召 (phonetic ショウ) — the shallow standing water: swamp.
沼.mnemonic: The pond that pulls you in — ぬま. 沼にはまる: modern slang for obsession.

渉.etymology: Compound ideograph: walking (歩) through water (氵) — to wade: to cross into another's business: negotiate (交渉).
渉.mnemonic: Trousers rolled, meeting midstream — ショウ. 交渉: fording toward a deal.

焦.etymology: Compound ideograph: the bird (隹) over the fire (灬) — scorched: to char; scorched nerves: impatience (焦る).
焦.mnemonic: The bird knows the grill is winning — こげる, あせる. 焦げ: dinner's warning smell.

症.etymology: Phono-semantic: sickness (疒) + 正 (phonetic ショウ) — the illness identified precisely: symptoms.
症.mnemonic: The sickness with its correct name — ショウ. 花粉症: spring's diagnosis.

硝.etymology: Phono-semantic: stone (石) + 肖 (phonetic ショウ) — the mineral of gunpowder and glass: saltpeter.
硝.mnemonic: The rock that explodes and the glass it makes — ショウ. 硝子: garasu, written mineral.

礁.etymology: Phono-semantic: stone (石) + 焦 (phonetic ショウ) — the rocks that scorch hulls: a reef.
礁.mnemonic: Stone waiting just under the waterline — ショウ. 暗礁に乗り上げる: plans on the rocks.

祥.etymology: Phono-semantic: altar (ネ) + 羊 (phonetic ショウ) — the good omen at the offering: auspicious.
祥.mnemonic: The sheep accepted, the signs good — ショウ. 発祥: where the good thing began.

称.etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + a phonetic — weighed and named: to call, praise, claim.
称.mnemonic: Weighed on the scale, given its title — ショウ. 名称: the official label.

粧.etymology: Phono-semantic: rice powder (米) + 庄 (phonetic ショウ) — the face powdered: makeup.
粧.mnemonic: Rice flour's second career — ショウ. 化粧: the morning transformation.

肖.etymology: Compound: flesh (月) in miniature (小) — the smaller likeness: resemblance.
肖.mnemonic: The child wearing the parent's face — ショウ. 肖像画: the portrait.

衝.etymology: Phono-semantic: crossroads (行) + 重 (phonetic ショウ) — weight meeting weight in the road: collision, impact.
衝.mnemonic: Two heavies, one lane — ショウ. 衝撃: the moment of contact; 衝動: the inner one.

訟.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 公 (phonetic ショウ) — the dispute made public: litigation.
訟.mnemonic: The argument moved to a public podium — ショウ. 訴訟: the lawsuit pair.

詔.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 召 (phonetic ショウ) — the sovereign summons in words: an edict.
詔.mnemonic: The scroll everyone kneels for — みことのり. 詔: history's loudest whisper.

詳.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 羊 (phonetic ショウ) — spelled out fully: detailed.
詳.mnemonic: Every wool fiber accounted for — くわしい. 詳細: the fine print's kanji.

鐘.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 童 (phonetic ショウ) — the great temple bell: bell.
鐘.mnemonic: Bronze that owns New Year's Eve — かね. 除夜の鐘: 108 strikes of this kanji.

丈.etymology: Ideograph: ten hand-spans — the old length unit; measured and found solid: sturdy (丈夫).
丈.mnemonic: Measured to the last span and it holds — ジョウ. 大丈夫: 'big and sturdy' — it's fine.

冗.etymology: Compound: idle hands under the roof — surplus: redundant, idle.
冗.mnemonic: Furniture nobody sits on — ジョウ. 冗談: surplus words — a joke.

lesson_examples.jp: 冗（じょう）談（だん）を　言（い）って　わらいました。

剰.etymology: Phono-semantic: 乗 (phonetic ジョウ) + blade (刂) — what remains after the cut: surplus.
剰.mnemonic: The slice left after everyone's served — ジョウ. 余剰: the warehouse's extra shelf.

壌.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + a phonetic — the fertile worked soil: loam.
壌.mnemonic: Dirt that's been enriched — ジョウ. 土壌: soil in agronomy reports.

嬢.etymology: Phono-semantic: woman (女) + a phonetic — the well-raised daughter: young lady.
嬢.mnemonic: The daughter of the good soil house — ジョウ. お嬢さん: the honorific miss.

浄.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 争 (phonetic ジョウ) — washed pure: clean.
浄.mnemonic: Water winning the fight against grime — ジョウ. 浄水器: the filter; 浄土: the Pure Land.

譲.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + a phonetic — yielding one's place in words: to cede, transfer.
譲.mnemonic: 'After you' — formalized — ゆずる. 譲る: seats, rights, and the last piece of cake.

醸.etymology: Phono-semantic: jar (酉) + a phonetic — fermented into being: to brew; to give rise to (醸し出す).
醸.mnemonic: The jar working in the dark — かもす. 醸造: breweries' front-door kanji.

錠.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 定 (phonetic ジョウ) — the fixing metal: a lock; the fixed dose: a tablet.
錠.mnemonic: Metal that makes things stay decided — ジョウ. 錠剤: the pill; 施錠: the click.

嘱.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 属 (phonetic ショク) — charged by word: to commission.
嘱.mnemonic: The task attached by a sentence — ショク. 嘱託: the commissioned post.

飾.etymology: Compound: cloth laid over — to adorn: decorate.
飾.mnemonic: The cloth that makes the table an occasion — かざる. 飾り: everything the room doesn't need and loves.

殖.etymology: Phono-semantic: 歹 + 直 (phonetic ショク) — stock that multiplies: to breed, increase.
殖.mnemonic: Numbers growing on their own — ふえる. 繁殖: biology's compound interest.

辱.etymology: Compound: the hand (寸) that missed the farming season (辰) — disgraced: to humiliate.
辱.mnemonic: Caught idle at planting time — はずかしめる. 侮辱: the insult, formal charge.

侵.etymology: Compound: a person sweeping forward step by step — creeping in: to invade.
侵.mnemonic: The fence moved a broom-width per night — おかす. 侵入: trespass, accomplished.

lesson_examples.jp: プライバシーを　侵（しん）害（がい）しては　いけません。

唇.etymology: Phono-semantic: 辰 'clamshell' (phonetic シン) + mouth (口) — the mouth's twin shells: lips.
唇.mnemonic: The clam of the face — くちびる. 唇: opens for 音, closes for silence.

娠.etymology: Phono-semantic: woman (女) + 辰 'stirring' (phonetic シン) — new life quickening: pregnancy.
娠.mnemonic: The first stir within — シン. 妊娠: the announcement kanji.

審.etymology: Compound: tracks (番) examined under the roof (宀) — close scrutiny: to judge, examine.
審.mnemonic: Reading the footprints in chambers — シン. 審判: umpires and verdicts alike.

慎.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 真 (phonetic シン) — the heart held true and careful: prudence.
慎.mnemonic: Checked twice against the true heart — つつしむ. 慎重: caution with a capital 慎.

振.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 辰 'stirring' (phonetic シン) — set in motion: to shake, wave, wield.
振.mnemonic: The hand that stirs everything awake — ふる. 振り込み and 振られる: transfers, and being shaken off.

浸.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + the creeping phonetic — water advancing in: to soak, permeate.
浸.mnemonic: The flood claims one floorboard at a time — ひたす. 浸る: baths and nostalgia.

紳.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 申 (phonetic シン) — the broad sash of rank: the gentleman who wears it.
紳.mnemonic: The belt that certifies the manners — シン. 紳士: gentleman, sash included.

薪.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 新 'freshly cut' (phonetic シン) — wood cut for the fire: firewood.
薪.mnemonic: 新's original job: fresh-split logs — たきぎ. 薪ストーブ: the fireplace comeback.

診.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 㐱 (phonetic シン) — the doctor's questioning look: to examine.
診.mnemonic: 'Say ahh' — みる. 診察: the white-coat interview.

刃.etymology: Ideograph: 刀 with a dot marking the cutting edge — the blade itself.
刃.mnemonic: The dot shows exactly where it cuts — は. 刃物: everything with that dot.

尋.etymology: Compound: both arms stretched (the old fathom measure) — reaching for an answer: to ask, search.
尋.mnemonic: Arms out wide, asking everyone — たずねる. 尋ねる: the polite interrogative stride.

甚.etymology: Compound: pleasure (甘) doubled — excessive: extreme, very.
甚.mnemonic: Sweetness past the safe dose — はなはだ. 甚大: damage reports' favorite adjective.

尽.etymology: Compound (simplified from 盡): the brush scraping the empty vessel — used to the last: to exhaust.
尽.mnemonic: Scraped to the final drop — つくす. 力を尽くす: everything, spent.

迅.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 卂 (phonetic ジン) — bolt-fast: swift.
迅.mnemonic: Gone before the sound arrives — ジン. 迅速: same-day everything.

陣.etymology: Compound: chariots (車) drawn up at the mound (阝) — the battle formation: camp, position.
陣.mnemonic: Wagons in fighting order on the hill — ジン. 陣地: the claimed ground.

須.etymology: Pictograph: the beard on the face (頁) — borrowed for 'must': necessarily.
須.mnemonic: The beard of obligation — ス. 必須: non-negotiable, bearded.

酢.etymology: Phono-semantic: jar (酉) + 乍 (phonetic サク) — wine gone sharp: vinegar.
酢.mnemonic: The jar's tart second act — す. 酢: sushi's hidden signature.

帥.etymology: Compound: the banner (巾) before the troops — the one it follows: commander.
帥.mnemonic: Where the flag goes, the army goes — スイ. 元帥: the marshal's kanji.

炊.etymology: Phono-semantic: fire (火) + 欠 (phonetic スイ) — breath on the flame: to cook rice.
炊.mnemonic: Blowing the coals under the pot — たく. 炊飯器: this kanji, automated.

睡.etymology: Phono-semantic: eye (目) + 垂 'droop' (phonetic スイ) — lids coming down: sleep.
睡.mnemonic: The eye obeying gravity — スイ. 睡眠: the doctor's word for what you lack.

粋.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 粹): rice (米) polished pure — the essence; Edo's refined cool: いき.
粋.mnemonic: Everything inessential milled away — いき, スイ. 純粋: purity; 粋: purity with style.

衰.etymology: Pictograph: the mourning garment of plaited straw — worn down: to wane.
衰.mnemonic: The coat gone slack on the frame — おとろえる. 衰退: empires and batteries.

遂.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + a phonetic — carried through to the end: to accomplish.
遂.mnemonic: The road walked to its very last meter — とげる. 遂に: 'at last', earned.

酔.etymology: Phono-semantic: jar (酉) + 卒 (phonetic スイ) — finished by the jar: drunk; carried away (酔う).
酔.mnemonic: The jar wins the evening — よう. 二日酔い: the jar's revenge.

随.etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + a phonetic — going along with: to follow, at one's discretion (随意).
随.mnemonic: Wherever it leads, you drift after — ズイ. 随分: 'quite' — following the degree.

髄.etymology: Phono-semantic: bone (骨) + a phonetic — the core within the bone: marrow, pith.
髄.mnemonic: The bone's innermost tenant — ズイ. 骨髄: marrow; 真髄: the marrow of an art.

崇.etymology: Phono-semantic: mountain (山) + 宗 (phonetic スウ) — reverence mountain-high: to venerate.
崇.mnemonic: The shrine placed on the summit — スウ. 崇拝: worship, altitude included.

枢.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 区 (phonetic スウ) — the door's turning post: pivot, the crucial center.
枢.mnemonic: The small wooden part the whole door obeys — スウ. 中枢: the nerve center.

据.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 居 (phonetic キョ→す) — placed to stay: to install.
据.mnemonic: Set down where it will live — すえる. 据え置き: left right there.

杉.etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + 彡 (phonetic サン→すぎ) — the needle-streaked conifer: cedar.
杉.mnemonic: The tree drawn with falling needles — すぎ. 杉: Japan's pollen antagonist.

澄.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 登 (phonetic チョウ→す) — sediment settled, water clear: limpid.
澄.mnemonic: Still long enough to see the bottom — すむ. 澄んだ空: the post-rain sky.

瀬.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 頼 (phonetic ライ→せ) — the fast shallow stretch: rapids.
瀬.mnemonic: Where the river shows its stones — せ. 瀬戸際: the brink — one shallow from disaster.

畝.etymology: Compound: the field (田) worked in measured ridges — the furrow; the old land unit.
畝.mnemonic: The field's corduroy — うね. 畝: what tractors write.

是.etymology: Compound ideograph: straight (正) under the sun (日) — plainly right: this, just so.
是.mnemonic: True in broad daylight — ゼ. 是非: right-and-wrong — 'by all means'.

征.etymology: Phono-semantic: march (彳) + 正 (phonetic セイ) — the 'righteous' expedition: to conquer.
征.mnemonic: Marching with justification papers — セイ. 征服: conquest, filed.

牲.etymology: Phono-semantic: ox (牛) + 生 (phonetic セイ) — the live offering: sacrifice.
牲.mnemonic: Life given whole — セイ. 犠牲: the cost column.

誓.etymology: Compound: words (言) sealed by the breaking (折) of an arrow — the oath: to vow.
誓.mnemonic: Snap the arrow, keep the word — ちかう. 誓い: weddings and courtrooms.

請.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 青 (phonetic セイ) — the formal request: to petition, contract.
請.mnemonic: Asked in writing, blue ink — こう. 請求書: the bill that solicits you.

逝.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 折 (phonetic セイ) — gone down the road not returning: to pass away.
逝.mnemonic: The journey with no return ticket — ゆく. 逝去: the obituary verb.

斉.etymology: Pictograph: grain heads at one level — even, uniform.
斉.mnemonic: The field trimmed to one height — セイ. 一斉に: everyone at once.

隻.etymology: Compound: one bird (隹) in the hand (又) — a single one: the counter for ships (and one of a pair).
隻.mnemonic: One bird, one hull — セキ. 一隻: one ship logged.

惜.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 昔 (phonetic セキ) — the heart clinging to what passes: regret, reluctance to lose.
惜.mnemonic: Held one second past goodbye — おしい. 惜しい!: so close!

斥.etymology: Ideograph: the axe (斤) turned against — driven off: to repel.
斥.mnemonic: Shooed away with the axe blunt-side — セキ. 排斥: exclusion, organized.

析.etymology: Compound ideograph: wood (木) split by the axe (斤) — taken apart: to analyze.
析.mnemonic: Split along the grain to see inside — セキ. 分析: the lab's kanji.

籍.etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo records (⺮) + a phonetic — the family and land rolls: register.
籍.mnemonic: Your name in the bamboo files — セキ. 国籍, 戸籍: where the state keeps you.

跡.etymology: Phono-semantic: foot (足) + a phonetic (セキ) — where feet have been: traces, ruins.
跡.mnemonic: What remains after the walking — あと. 遺跡: history's footprints in stone.

拙.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 出 (phonetic セツ) — work that shows its seams: clumsy; my humble (拙宅).
拙.mnemonic: The hand that shows too much of itself — つたない. 拙い: the modest craftsman's word.

摂.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + a phonetic — taking in hand for another: regent (摂政); taking in: ingest (摂取).
摂.mnemonic: Handling it on someone's behalf — セツ. 摂取: the body's intake ledger.

窃.etymology: Phono-semantic: hole (穴) + 切 (phonetic セツ) — in through the gap: to steal.
窃.mnemonic: Cut a hole, slip through — セツ. 窃盗: theft, in the police log.

仙.etymology: Compound ideograph: the person (亻) of the mountain (山) — the immortal recluse: hermit-sage.
仙.mnemonic: Moved uphill, transcended the mail — セン. 仙人: beard, mist, wisdom.

扇.etymology: Compound ideograph: a door (戸) of feathers (羽) — the swinging leaf that moves air: fan.
扇.mnemonic: A feather door for the wind — おうぎ. 扇風機: the fan gone electric.

栓.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 全 (phonetic セン) — the wooden stopper: plug.
栓.mnemonic: The little wood that keeps the whole (全) in — セン. 消火栓: the hydrant's official name.

潜.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + a phonetic (セン) — gone under: to dive, lurk.
潜.mnemonic: Under the surface, still there — もぐる. 潜水艦: the lurking ship.

旋.etymology: Compound: feet wheeling under the banner — turning about: rotation.
旋.mnemonic: The parade wheels in place — セン. 旋律: melody — sound turning gracefully.

繊.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + a phonetic (セン) — thread-thin: fine, delicate.
繊.mnemonic: Thinner than the thread it's written with — セン. 繊維: fiber, textile and dietary.

examples.word: お勧め・御勧め・御薦め

薦.etymology: Compound: the sacred beast's grass mat, offered up — to present: recommend.
薦.mnemonic: Laid on the best mat for consideration — すすめる. 推薦状: the letter that vouches.

践.etymology: Phono-semantic: foot (足) + 戔 (phonetic セン) — stepping onto in fact: to put into practice.
践.mnemonic: Theory, stepped on until it works — セン. 実践: practice over podium.

遷.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + a phonetic (セン) — the seat moved: transfer, transition.
遷.mnemonic: The whole capital packed and carried — セン. 遷都: history's moving day.

鮮.etymology: Compound: fish (魚) and sheep (羊) — the two meats at their best only fresh: fresh, vivid; Korea (朝鮮).
鮮.mnemonic: Fish and lamb, judged by the hour — あざやか. 新鮮: the market's first word.

漸.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 斬 (phonetic ゼン) — water advancing cut by cut: gradually.
漸.mnemonic: The tide takes the beach one slice at a time — ゼン. 漸く: 'finally', after all those slices.

禅.etymology: Phono-semantic: altar (ネ) + 単 (phonetic ゼン) — the rite of stillness, from Sanskrit dhyāna: Zen.
禅.mnemonic: The altar stripped simple (単) — ゼン. 座禅: sitting with this kanji for hours.

繕.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 善 (phonetic ゼン) — made good with thread: to mend.
繕.mnemonic: The hole made virtuous again — つくろう. 繕う: socks and appearances.

塑.etymology: Phono-semantic: 朔 (phonetic ソ) + earth (土) — clay shaped: to model.
塑.mnemonic: Mud with a future — ソ. 彫塑: sculpture's wet half.

措.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 昔 (phonetic ソ) — placed and left: to set aside, take (measures).
措.mnemonic: Filed under 'later' — ソ. 措置: the measures officially taken.

疎.etymology: Phono-semantic: 疋 + 束 (phonetic ソ) — combed loose: sparse; kept at distance: estranged.
疎.mnemonic: Threads pulled apart until light shows through — うとい. 疎遠: friendship gone sparse.

礎.etymology: Phono-semantic: stone (石) + 楚 (phonetic ソ) — the stone under the pillar: foundation.
礎.mnemonic: The rock the whole temple secretly rests on — いしずえ. 基礎: your grammar drills, structurally.

租.etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + 且 (phonetic ソ) — the harvest share owed: land tax.
租.mnemonic: Sheaves stacked for the collector — ソ. 租税: taxation's oldest form.

粗.etymology: Phono-semantic: rice (米) + 且 (phonetic ソ) — unpolished grain: coarse, rough.
粗.mnemonic: Rice with the husks still arguing — あらい. 粗末: handled coarsely — the apology word.

訴.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 斥 (phonetic ソ) — the grievance brought forward: to sue, appeal.
訴.mnemonic: Words aimed at the bench — うったえる. 訴える: courts and heartstrings both.

阻.etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 且 (phonetic ソ) — the ridge in the way: to obstruct.
阻.mnemonic: One more hill between you and it — はばむ. 阻止: the block, official.

僧.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 曽 (phonetic ソウ) — from Sanskrit saṃgha: the monk.
僧.mnemonic: The person of the layered robes — ソウ. 僧侶: the temple's resident.

喪.etymology: Compound: weeping mouths over the burial — mourning; what mourning marks: loss.
喪.mnemonic: The house wearing black — も. 喪服: the wardrobe's quietest suit.

壮.etymology: Phono-semantic: 爿 (phonetic ソウ) + 士 — manhood at full strength: robust, grand.
壮.mnemonic: The gentleman in his prime — ソウ. 壮大: scale with muscles.

爽.etymology: Ideograph: light lattices around a figure (大) — bright and airy: refreshing.
爽.mnemonic: Air moving through every gap — さわやか. 爽やか: May mornings, bottled.

挿.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + a phonetic (ソウ) — pushed in: to insert.
挿.mnemonic: Slotted in with one push — さす. 挿入: the USB verb.

曹.etymology: Compound: paired parties at the tribunal — the office ranks: sergeant, comrade class.
曹.mnemonic: The mid-rank desk between the bench and the street — ソウ. 軍曹: the sergeant's stripe.

槽.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 曹 (phonetic ソウ) — the great wooden trough: vat.
槽.mnemonic: The tub big enough to need paperwork — ソウ. 水槽: the aquarium tank.

荘.etymology: Phono-semantic: 艹 + 壮 (phonetic ソウ) — the grand country manor: villa; stately.
荘.mnemonic: The estate with its own name-board — ソウ. 山荘: the mountain villa; 〜荘: every old apartment building.

葬.etymology: Compound ideograph: the dead (死) laid between grasses (艹 above and below) — burial.
葬.mnemonic: Grass above, grass beneath, rest between — ほうむる. 葬式: the ceremony of laying down.

藻.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + a watery phonetic (ソウ) — water plants: algae, seaweed.
藻.mnemonic: The garden that grows underwater — も. 海藻: the miso soup forest.

遭.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 曹 (phonetic ソウ) — met upon the road: to run into (usually misfortune).
遭.mnemonic: The meeting nobody scheduled — あう. 遭難: encountering the mountain's bad mood.

霜.etymology: Phono-semantic: weather (雨) + 相 (phonetic ソウ) — the white morning coat: frost.
霜.mnemonic: Dew that turned formal overnight — しも. 霜降り: frost-marbled beef.

騒.etymology: Phono-semantic: horse (馬) + 蚤 'flea' (phonetic ソウ) — the horse with fleas: uproar.
騒.mnemonic: One flea, one horse, total chaos — さわぐ. 騒音: the neighbor's playlist.

促.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 足 (phonetic ソク) — stepping close behind: to press, urge.
促.mnemonic: The footsteps that hurry yours — うながす. 催促: the reminder email, embodied.

即.etymology: Compound: seated at the food the moment it's set — at once: immediately; which is to say.
即.mnemonic: Fork in hand before the plate lands — ソク. 即座に: zero-delay.

lesson_examples.jp: それが　即（すなわ）ち　こたえです。

俗.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 谷 (phonetic ゾク) — the ways of the valley folk: customs; unrefined: vulgar.
俗.mnemonic: How the valley actually lives — ゾク. 風俗 and 俗語: customs and street speech.

賊.etymology: Compound: weapons (戈) against property (貝) — the plunderer: bandit, rebel.
賊.mnemonic: Armed and after the shells — ゾク. 海賊: pirates — the sea's 賊.

汰.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 太 (phonetic タ) — washed and sorted by the current: sifting.
汰.mnemonic: The river keeps what matters — タ. 淘汰: natural selection; ご無沙汰: the correspondence washed away.

堕.etymology: Phono-semantic: a falling phonetic + earth (土) — dropped from the height: to fall, degenerate.
堕.mnemonic: Downhill with no brakes left — ダ. 堕落: the moralist's word.

妥.etymology: Compound: the hand calmed (爫) — settled peacefully: appropriate, compromise (妥協).
妥.mnemonic: The raised hand lowered gently — ダ. 妥協: both sides unclench.

惰.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + a phonetic (ダ) — the heart gone slack: idle.
惰.mnemonic: The heart in sweatpants — ダ. 惰性: momentum without intention.

駄.etymology: Phono-semantic: horse (馬) + 太 (phonetic ダ) — the packhorse's load: burden; load-grade goods: cheap (駄菓子).
駄.mnemonic: What the fat packhorse carries — ダ. 無駄: load with no destination — waste; 下駄: the wooden clogs.

耐.etymology: Compound: holding steady (寸) under it (而) — to bear: endure; resistant: -proof (耐火).
耐.mnemonic: Grip held while it keeps coming — たえる. 耐震: earthquake-proof — Japan's favorite suffix.

怠.etymology: Phono-semantic: 台 (phonetic タイ) + heart (心) — the heart off its post: to neglect, be idle.
怠.mnemonic: The guard heart asleep on the platform — なまける. 怠け者: the couch's tenant.

泰.etymology: Compound: hands bathing in abundant water — ease at the largest scale: peace, Thailand (泰国).
泰.mnemonic: Warm water, no schedule — タイ. 安泰: security you can nap in.

滞.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 帯 (phonetic タイ) — the current belted in place: to stall, stay.
滞.mnemonic: The river wearing a too-tight obi — とどこおる. 渋滞: traffic, belted.

胎.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 台 (phonetic タイ) — the body's cradle-platform: womb.
胎.mnemonic: The first apartment — タイ. 胎児: the tenant.

逮.etymology: Compound: the pursuing hand (隶) catching up on the road (辶) — to seize: arrest.
逮.mnemonic: The chase ends with a hand on the collar — タイ. 逮捕: the handcuff kanji.

滝.etymology: Compound: water (氵) + dragon (竜) — the dragon of falling water: waterfall. Your CS-Kanji 滝.
滝.mnemonic: The dragon standing on its tail in the river — たき. 滝: Cascade, in-game and out.

卓.etymology: Compound: standing tall above — eminent; the raised board: table (食卓).
卓.mnemonic: Head and table both above the floor — タク. 卓球: ping-pong — eminence, miniaturized.

択.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 擇): hand (扌) + a phonetic — picked out: to select.
択.mnemonic: The hand hovering over options — タク. 選択: the menu moment.

拓.etymology: Compound: hand (扌) against stone (石) — ground broken: to open land; stone-印 pressed to paper: rubbing (拓本).
拓.mnemonic: Stones out, fields in — タク. 開拓: the pioneer verb.

沢.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 澤): water (氵) + a phonetic — the wet lowland: marsh; moist abundance: luster, favor (贅沢).
沢.mnemonic: Where water lingers and life fattens — さわ. 贅沢: luxury — the swamp of plenty.

託.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 乇 (phonetic タク) — handed over with instructions: to entrust.
託.mnemonic: Given with a sentence attached — タク. 委託, 託児所: outsourcing, and daycare.

濁.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 蜀 (phonetic ダク) — stirred murky: turbid; the 'muddied' voiced sounds: dakuten.
濁.mnemonic: The clear stream stirred — にごる. 濁点: the two dots that muddy か into が.

諾.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 若 (phonetic ダク) — the yes given: assent.
諾.mnemonic: The nod in writing — ダク. 承諾: consent, countersigned.

但.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 旦 (phonetic タン) — the qualifying clause: however, provided that.
但.mnemonic: The asterisk in human form — ただし. 但し書き: the fine print's opener.

奪.etymology: Compound ideograph: the bird (隹) wrenched from the hand (寸) — snatched away: to rob.
奪.mnemonic: The prize gone mid-grip — うばう. 奪う: what plot twists do to victories.

脱.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 兌 'slip out' (phonetic ダツ) — out of the skin: to remove, escape.
脱.mnemonic: Shed like a jacket — ぬぐ. 脱出: escaping the room; 脱線: the train undressing its rails.

棚.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 朋 (phonetic ホウ→たな) — boards paired level: shelf.
棚.mnemonic: Planks holding hands — たな. 棚: where 本 sleep; 棚上げ: where issues sleep.

丹.etymology: Pictograph: the mine with its红 ore inside — cinnabar: red; the elixir it made: devotion (丹念).
丹.mnemonic: One drop of red in the pit — タン. 丹念: care applied drop by drop.

lesson_examples.jp: 丹（たん）念（ねん）に　じゅんびを　します。

嘆.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + a phonetic (タン) — the long exhale: to sigh, deplore, admire.
嘆.mnemonic: Breath heavy with clay — なげく. 感嘆: the sigh of awe; ため息's kanji cousin.

旦.etymology: Ideograph: the sun (日) on the horizon (一) — daybreak.
旦.mnemonic: Sun touching the line — タン. 元旦: the year's first sunrise; 一旦: 'once' — for one dawn.

淡.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 炎 (phonetic タン) — the fire watered down: pale, faint, fresh (water).
淡.mnemonic: Flavor at 10% opacity — あわい. 淡水: freshwater; 淡い期待: hopes, diluted.

端.etymology: Phono-semantic: 立 + 耑 (phonetic タン) — where the thing begins and stops: edge, tip; proper (端正).
端.mnemonic: Standing at the very rim — はし. 端っこ: the corner seat everyone wants.

胆.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 旦 (phonetic タン) — the organ of daring: gall: courage.
胆.mnemonic: Guts, anatomically filed — タン. 大胆: bold — big gall.

鍛.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 段 (phonetic タン) — hammered in stages: to forge, train.
鍛.mnemonic: Beaten better, step by step — きたえる. 鍛える: swords and abdominals.

壇.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 亶 (phonetic ダン) — the raised earth platform: altar, podium.
壇.mnemonic: The dirt promoted above the crowd — ダン. 花壇: the flower podium; 仏壇: the family altar.

弾.etymology: Phono-semantic: bow (弓) + 単 (phonetic ダン) — what the bow lets fly: projectile; the plucked release: to play strings.
弾.mnemonic: The string releases: bullet or音 — たま, ひく. 弾丸 flies; ピアノを弾く sings.

痴.etymology: Compound: knowing (知) fallen ill (疒) — wits astray: foolish, besotted.
痴.mnemonic: Knowledge with a fever — チ. 痴漢: the train's criminal; 音痴: melody-blind.

稚.etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + 隹 (phonetic チ) — grain still green: young, childish.
稚.mnemonic: Harvest attempted in June — チ. 幼稚: kindergarten-grade.

致.etymology: Compound: brought all the way (至) by effort (攵) — to bring about; humble doing (致します).
致.mnemonic: Delivered personally, with a bow — いたす. 一致: brought to the same point — agreement.

蓄.etymology: Phono-semantic: 艹 + 畜 (phonetic チク) — stores laid up: to accumulate.
蓄.mnemonic: The barn loft filling year on year — たくわえる. 貯蓄: savings, the long game.

逐.etymology: Compound: chasing the boar (豕) down the road (辶) — to pursue; item by item (逐一).
逐.mnemonic: After the pig, step for step — チク. 逐一報告: every hoofprint reported.

秩.etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + 失 (phonetic チツ) — sheaves stacked by rank: order.
秩.mnemonic: The granary's filing system — チツ. 秩序: order — society's stacking.

窒.etymology: Compound: the hole (穴) filled to its end (至) — stopped: to suffocate; nitrogen (窒素), the smothering gas.
窒.mnemonic: The airway arrived at zero — チッ. 窒息: the choking word; 窒素: N₂.

嫡.etymology: Phono-semantic: woman (女) + 啇 (phonetic チャク) — the principal wife's line: legitimate.
嫡.mnemonic: The line the register recognizes — チャク. 嫡男: the heir apparent.

抽.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 由 (phonetic チュウ) — drawn out: to extract, draw lots.
抽.mnemonic: One ticket pulled from the box — チュウ. 抽選: the lottery draw; 抽象: meaning, extracted.

衷.etymology: Compound: the middle (中) worn inside the robe (衣) — the innermost feeling.
衷.mnemonic: What's worn under everything else — チュウ. 折衷: compromise — inner middles averaged.

鋳.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 寿 (phonetic チュウ) — poured to last: to cast metal.
鋳.mnemonic: Molten metal given a long life's shape — いる. 鋳造: the mint's verb.

弔.etymology: Pictograph: the mourner with bow — guarding the dead from birds, the old rite: to mourn.
弔.mnemonic: The bow carried to the graveside — とむらう. 弔電: the telegram of sympathy.

彫.etymology: Phono-semantic: 周 (phonetic チョウ) + 彡 — cut in patterns: to engrave.
彫.mnemonic: Chisel lines all the way around — ほる. 彫刻: sculpture; 彫り: the tattooist's word too.

徴.etymology: Compound: signs sought out and called in — a sign; to summon, levy (徴収).
徴.mnemonic: The state reads the signs, then collects — チョウ. 特徴: the distinguishing sign; 徴税: the collecting.

懲.etymology: Phono-semantic: 徴 (phonetic チョウ) + heart (心) — the lesson pressed into the heart: to punish, learn from (懲りる).
懲.mnemonic: Once burned, the heart remembers — こりる. 懲役: the penal term.

挑.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 兆 (phonetic チョウ) — the glove thrown: to challenge.
挑.mnemonic: Reading the omens and going anyway — いどむ. 挑戦: the try-anyway kanji.

眺.etymology: Phono-semantic: eye (目) + 兆 (phonetic チョウ) — gazing into the distance: to view.
眺.mnemonic: Eyes lost past the horizon — ながめる. 眺め: the room's best feature.

聴.etymology: Compound: the ear (耳) with upright heart — hearing with intention: to listen.
聴.mnemonic: 聞く with the heart plugged in — きく. 聴く: what you do to music, not noise.

跳.etymology: Phono-semantic: foot (足) + 兆 (phonetic チョウ) — the foot springing: to leap.
跳.mnemonic: Feet reading the cracks and jumping them — とぶ. 跳躍: the long jump's kanji.

勅.etymology: Compound: authority (力) bound (束) in the sovereign's word — the imperial edict.
勅.mnemonic: The order that binds by itself — チョク. 勅語: the throne speaking.

朕.etymology: Ancient first-person of the sovereign — the imperial We: 朕.
朕.mnemonic: The pronoun with a throne under it — チン. 朕: one user, historically.

鎮.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 真 (phonetic チン) — the true weight that stills: to calm, suppress.
鎮.mnemonic: The paperweight on the province — しずめる. 鎮痛剤: pain, weighted quiet.

陳.etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 東 (phonetic チン) — set out in rows: to display, state; long-set: stale (陳腐).
陳.mnemonic: Goods lined along the eastern wall — チン. 陳列: the shop window verb.

津.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 聿 (phonetic シン) — the crossing point: ferry port.
津.mnemonic: Where the boats write their arrivals — つ. 津波: the wave that finds every port.

墜.etymology: Phono-semantic: 隊 (phonetic ツイ) + earth (土) — down to the ground: to plummet.
墜.mnemonic: Altitude, then geology — ツイ. 墜落: the aviation word.

椎.etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + 隹 (phonetic ツイ) — the chinquapin oak; the spine's stacked 'mallets': vertebrae (脊椎).
椎.mnemonic: The tree in your back — つい. 椎間板: the discs between.

塚.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 冢 (phonetic チョウ→つか) — the raised burial mound: hillock.
塚.mnemonic: The little hill someone made on purpose — つか. 貝塚: the shell mound archaeologists love.

漬.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 責 (phonetic シ→つ) — steeped under weight: to pickle.
漬.mnemonic: Vegetables doing time in brine — つける. 漬物: the rice bowl's sidekick.

坪.etymology: Compound: land (土) leveled (平) — the tsubo, two tatami of ground: ~3.3m².
坪.mnemonic: Real estate's atomic unit — つぼ. 30坪: the house ad's number.

釣.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 勺 (phonetic チョウ) — the hook that ladles fish out: to angle; balanced exchange: change (お釣り).
釣.mnemonic: Metal spoon-hook in the water — つる. お釣り: the change fished back to you.

鶴.etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + bird (鳥) — the thousand-year bird: crane.
鶴.mnemonic: The origami everyone learns first — つる. 千羽鶴: a thousand of them, folded in hope.

亭.etymology: Phono-semantic: the tall-building form + 丁 (phonetic テイ) — the roadside rest-house: pavilion, and rakugo stage names (〜亭).
亭.mnemonic: The teahouse with a poet's name-board — テイ. 料亭: dining at pavilion prices.

偵.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 貞 (phonetic テイ) — sent to find out: scout, detective.
偵.mnemonic: The quiet one who reports back — テイ. 探偵: the trench-coat kanji.

貞.etymology: Compound: divining (卜) at the tripod (貝) — the true reading: constancy, virtue.
貞.mnemonic: The oracle's answer that doesn't bend — テイ. 貞子, ironically, from the horror well.

呈.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 王-form (phonetic テイ) — held up before: to present, exhibit.
呈.mnemonic: Offered up with an announcement — テイ. 贈呈: the trophy handover.

堤.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 是 (phonetic テイ) — the raised bank: levee.
堤.mnemonic: Earth doing the river's paperwork — つつみ. 堤防: the flood's opponent.

帝.etymology: Pictograph: the great altar of highest heaven — its lord: the emperor.
帝.mnemonic: The title above kings — テイ. 帝国: empire — the altar with an army.

廷.etymology: Compound: officials in file (壬) in the long hall (廴) — the court: imperial or legal.
廷.mnemonic: The corridor where verdicts walk — テイ. 法廷: the courtroom.

抵.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 氐 (phonetic テイ) — braced at the base: to resist; roughly (大抵).
抵.mnemonic: Heels dug to the root — テイ. 抵抗: resistance, physics and teenagers.

締.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 帝 (phonetic テイ) — bound fast: to tighten, conclude (a pact).
締.mnemonic: The knot pulled to imperial standards — しめる. 締め切り: the deadline — the rope's end.

艇.etymology: Phono-semantic: boat (舟) + 廷 (phonetic テイ) — the light craft: boat.
艇.mnemonic: The boat small enough to carry upstairs — テイ. 競艇: powerboat racing.

訂.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 丁 (phonetic テイ) — the text nailed straight: to correct.
訂.mnemonic: Hammering the typos flat — テイ. 訂正: the correction notice.

逓.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + a phonetic (テイ) — passed station to station: relay.
逓.mnemonic: The parcel changing hands down the line — テイ. 逓信: the old post-and-telegraph ministry.

邸.etymology: Phono-semantic: 氐 (phonetic テイ) + city (阝) — the noble's town seat: mansion.
邸.mnemonic: The address with gates — テイ. 豪邸: the mansion tour word.

摘.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 啇 (phonetic テキ) — plucked out precisely: to pick; to single out (指摘).
摘.mnemonic: Two fingers on the exact flaw — つむ. 指摘: the reviewer's pinch.

哲.etymology: Phono-semantic: 折 (phonetic テツ) + mouth (口) — discerning speech: wisdom: philosophy.
哲.mnemonic: Ideas broken open and examined aloud — テツ. 哲学: the department of good questions.

徹.etymology: Compound: carried through to the end (彳...攵) — all the way: thorough.
徹.mnemonic: Through the wall, not around — テツ. 徹夜: through the whole night.

撤.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + the 徹 phonetic — taken all the way out: to withdraw.
撤.mnemonic: Everything packed back out the way it came — テツ. 撤退: the organized retreat.

迭.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 失 (phonetic テツ) — one out, one in: alternation (更迭).
迭.mnemonic: The minister walks, the replacement arrives — テツ. 更迭: the cabinet reshuffle word.

添.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + a phonetic (テン) — added alongside: to attach, accompany.
添.mnemonic: Poured in beside, not instead — そえる. 添付: the email attachment; 付き添い: the human one.

吐.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 土 (phonetic ト) — out of the mouth: to spit, disgorge, confess (吐く).
吐.mnemonic: What the mouth returns to earth — はく. 弱音を吐く: spitting out one's weakness.

斗.etymology: Pictograph: the grain ladle — the measure (18L); the sky's ladle: the Big Dipper.
斗.mnemonic: The scoop hanging in the north sky — ト. 北斗七星: the seven-starred ladle.

奴.etymology: Compound: the seized servant (女+又) — slave; roughened into 'that guy' (あいつ's kanji).
奴.mnemonic: History's harshest kanji gone slangy — やつ. 奴ら: 'those guys'.

唐.etymology: The name of the T'ang dynasty — the China of Japan's classical imports: Chinese, foreign (唐揚げ's 唐).
唐.mnemonic: The dynasty that shipped Japan its alphabet — トウ. 唐揚げ: T'ang-style frying, allegedly.

lesson_examples.jp: 唐（から）の　じだいです。

悼.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 卓 (phonetic トウ) — the heart bowed for the dead: to mourn.
悼.mnemonic: Grief for someone who stood tall — いたむ. 追悼: the memorial address.

搭.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 荅 (phonetic トウ) — loaded aboard: to board, mount.
搭.mnemonic: Bags up, body in — トウ. 搭乗: the boarding-gate kanji.

桃.etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + 兆 (phonetic トウ) — the auspicious fruit tree: peach.
桃.mnemonic: The tree of good omens — もも. 桃太郎: the boy the peach delivered.

棟.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 東 (phonetic トウ) — the roof's spine beam: ridgepole; the counter for buildings.
棟.mnemonic: The beam the whole roof salutes — むね. 病棟: the hospital wing.

痘.etymology: Phono-semantic: sickness (疒) + 豆 (phonetic トウ) — the bean-like pustules: smallpox.
痘.mnemonic: Illness in bean-shaped spots — トウ. 種痘: the vaccine that ended it.

藤.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + a phonetic (トウ) — the cascading vine: wisteria; half of Japan's surnames (佐藤, 伊藤).
藤.mnemonic: The purple waterfall of May — ふじ. 藤: on trellises and business cards everywhere.

謄.etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + words (言) — words carried over: transcript.
謄.mnemonic: The certified word-for-word — トウ. 謄本: the family register copy.

踏.etymology: Phono-semantic: foot (足) + 沓 (phonetic トウ) — the foot coming down: to tread.
踏.mnemonic: Weight onto the board — ふむ. 踏切: the crossing you stop at; 踏まえる: standing on the facts.

透.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 秀 (phonetic トウ) — passing clean through: transparent.
透.mnemonic: Light walks through without knocking — すける. 透明: the clear kanji.

陶.etymology: Phono-semantic: mound/kiln (阝) + 匋 (phonetic トウ) — clay fired at the hill kiln: ceramics; absorbed delight (陶酔).
陶.mnemonic: The hillside kiln's output — トウ. 陶器: the shelf you don't let children near.

騰.etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + horse (馬) — the horse rearing: to leap; prices doing it: surge.
騰.mnemonic: The chart bolting like a spooked horse — トウ. 高騰: the headline about eggs.

闘.etymology: Compound (simplified from 鬥, two fighters facing off): combat at the gate: to fight.
闘.mnemonic: The brawl in the doorway — たたかう. 闘う: 戦う's scrappier twin — illness, matches, Mondays.

憧.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 童 (phonetic ショウ/ドウ) — the child-heart looking up: to long for.
憧.mnemonic: The kid's poster on the wall — あこがれる. 憧れ: the senpai effect.

洞.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 同 (phonetic ドウ) — the hollowed space: cave; seeing into it: insight (洞察).
洞.mnemonic: The hollow the river carved — ほら. 洞窟: the cave proper.

瞳.etymology: Phono-semantic: eye (目) + 童 (phonetic ドウ) — the child in the eye (the tiny reflection): pupil.
瞳.mnemonic: Look close: a small someone looks back — ひとみ. 瞳: songwriting's favorite anatomy.

胴.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 同 (phonetic ドウ) — the body's barrel: torso.
胴.mnemonic: The body minus its extremities — ドウ. 胴上げ: the victory toss.

峠.etymology: A kokuji — made in Japan: mountain (山) + up (上) + down (下) — where the climb turns to descent: the pass; the crisis point (峠を越す).
峠.mnemonic: Up, then the ridge, then down — とうげ. 峠: illness and hikes both have one.
