匿.etymology: Phono-semantic: box (匚) + 若 (phonetic トク) — tucked out of sight: to conceal.
匿.mnemonic: Folded into the cupboard — トク. 匿名: the nameless comment's kanji.

督.etymology: Phono-semantic: 叔 (phonetic トク) + eye (目) — the watching eye over the work: to superintend.
督.mnemonic: The uncle-eye on your form — トク. 監督: coach and film director.

篤.etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 馬 (phonetic トク) — solid as a steady horse: earnest; grave (危篤).
篤.mnemonic: Devotion at draft-horse strength — トク. 危篤: gravely — the hospital call.

凸.etymology: Pictograph: a shape with a boss protruding — convex. Partner of 凹.
凸.mnemonic: The bump drawn as itself — トツ. 凸凹: the road report in two glyphs.

屯.etymology: Pictograph: the sprout gathering force underground — massed troops waiting: garrison.
屯.mnemonic: Force coiled below the surface — トン. 駐屯地: the garrison base.

lesson_examples.jp: ここは 昔（むかし）の 屯所（とんしょ）です。
lesson_examples.en: This used to be a garrison post.

豚.etymology: Compound ideograph: flesh (月) + pig (豕) — the pig as food: pork.
豚.mnemonic: The pig with a menu destiny — ぶた. 豚カツ: the kanji, breaded.

那.etymology: Old phonetic character for transcription — 'which/that'; survives in names (那覇) and 旦那.
那.mnemonic: The syllable that settled in Okinawa — ナ. 那覇: Naha; 旦那: the husband, borrowed from Sanskrit.

尼.etymology: From Sanskrit bhikṣuṇī via 比丘尼 — the Buddhist nun.
尼.mnemonic: The robe and the shaved head — あま. 尼寺: the convent temple.

lesson_examples.jp: 尼（あま）さんに　あいました。

弐.etymology: The forgery-proof legal 'two' — 二 armored with extra strokes for documents.
弐.mnemonic: 二 in a bank vault — ニ. 金弐万円: two, notarized.

虹.etymology: Phono-semantic: 虫 (the old dragon-serpent) + 工 (phonetic コウ) — the sky-serpent arching to drink: rainbow.
虹.mnemonic: The dragon bending between two clouds — にじ. 虹: the sky's bridge kanji.

如.etymology: Phono-semantic: 女 + 口 (phonetic ジョ) — following as told: like, as; suchness (如来).
如.mnemonic: 'Just as said' — ごとく. 突如: as if from nowhere; 如来: the Thus-Come Buddha.

尿.etymology: Compound ideograph: water (水) from the body (尸) — urine. Clinical and unblushing.
尿.mnemonic: The diagram explains itself — ニョウ. 尿検査: the little cup at the clinic.

妊.etymology: Phono-semantic: woman (女) + 壬 'carrying' (phonetic ニン) — carrying life: pregnant.
妊.mnemonic: The carried weight that kicks — ニン. 妊娠: with 娠, the full announcement.

忍.etymology: Phono-semantic: 刃 (phonetic ニン) + heart (心) — the heart under the blade, unmoving: to endure; unseen endurance: stealth.
忍.mnemonic: A blade on the heart and not a sound — しのぶ. 忍者: endurance, weaponized.

寧.etymology: Compound: the heart fed and housed — at peace: tranquil; 'rather' (むしろ) by extension.
寧.mnemonic: Everything in its place under the roof — ネイ. 丁寧: care, roofed and fed.

粘.etymology: Phono-semantic: rice (米) + 占 (phonetic ネン) — the grain's cling: sticky, tenacious.
粘.mnemonic: Rice that won't let go of the bowl — ねばる. 粘り: the virtue of natto and negotiators.

把.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 巴 (phonetic ハ) — the closed grip: to grasp; a handle on a situation (把握).
把.mnemonic: Fingers around the whole of it — ハ. 把握: getting the grip, mentally.

覇.etymology: Originally the moon's first light reclaiming the sky — the overlord who claims all: hegemony.
覇.mnemonic: The new moon annexing the night — ハ. 制覇: total conquest — tournaments included.

婆.etymology: Phono-semantic: 波 (phonetic バ) + woman (女) — the grandmother: old woman.
婆.mnemonic: The woman with wave-lines of years — ばあ. お婆さん: the folktale's second resident.

廃.etymology: Phono-semantic: building (广) + 発 (phonetic ハイ) — the hall let go to ruin: to abolish, fall into disuse.
廃.mnemonic: The institution with its lights off — すたれる. 廃墟: the explorer's ruin.

排.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 非 (phonetic ハイ) — pushed out and away: to expel, exclude.
排.mnemonic: Both hands showing it the door — ハイ. 排気: the exhaust pipe's verb.

輩.etymology: Phono-semantic: 非 (phonetic ハイ) + 車 — carts in rank: one's cohort: fellows.
輩.mnemonic: The convoy you entered service with — ハイ. 先輩・後輩: the whole social ladder.

培.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 咅 (phonetic バイ) — earth banked at the roots: to cultivate.
培.mnemonic: Soil heaped with intention — つちかう. 栽培 and 培う: crops and character.

媒.etymology: Phono-semantic: woman (女) + 某 (phonetic バイ) — the matchmaker: go-between; the carrying medium.
媒.mnemonic: The one who carries messages between — バイ. 媒体: the media — professional go-betweens.

賠.etymology: Phono-semantic: money (貝) + 咅 (phonetic バイ) — payment for damage: indemnity.
賠.mnemonic: The check that says sorry — バイ. 賠償: reparations, itemized.

陪.etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 咅 (phonetic バイ) — seated alongside in attendance: auxiliary.
陪.mnemonic: The extra chairs beside the bench — バイ. 陪審: the jury's kanji.

伯.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 白 (phonetic ハク) — the elder of the line: chief, count; uncle (伯父).
伯.mnemonic: The white-haired senior brother — ハク. 伯爵: the count of novels.

拍.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 白 (phonetic ハク) — palm on palm: to clap; the beat it keeps.
拍.mnemonic: Hands keeping the count — ハク. 拍手: applause; 拍子: the rhythm it makes.

舶.etymology: Phono-semantic: boat (舟) + 白 (phonetic ハク) — the ocean-going vessel: liner.
舶.mnemonic: The big white hull from abroad — ハク. 舶来品: goods off the liner — imports.

迫.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 白 (phonetic ハク) — closing in: to press, approach menacingly.
迫.mnemonic: The deadline's headlights in the mirror — せまる. 迫力: pressure you can feel from a screen.

漠.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 莫 'none' (phonetic バク) — waterless expanse: desert; featureless: vague.
漠.mnemonic: Water written where none exists — バク. 漠然: fog-shaped thinking; 砂漠: the desert itself.

縛.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 尃 (phonetic バク) — roped fast: to bind.
縛.mnemonic: Wound until movement is theory — しばる. 束縛: the relationship red flag.

鉢.etymology: From Sanskrit pātra via 鉢多羅 — the monk's alms bowl: bowl, flowerpot.
鉢.mnemonic: The begging bowl that took up gardening — はち. 植木鉢: the balcony's pot.

伐.etymology: Compound ideograph: the weapon (戈) at the person (亻) — to strike down: to fell (trees, enemies).
伐.mnemonic: The axe swing, forestry or war — バツ. 伐採: logging's verb.

lesson_examples.jp: 古（ふる）い　木（き）を　伐（き）ります。

罰.etymology: Compound: caught (罒), sentenced (言), enforced (刂) — punishment.
罰.mnemonic: Net, verdict, blade: the full pipeline — バツ. 罰金: the fine; バチが当たる: cosmic 罰.

閥.etymology: Phono-semantic: gate (門) + 伐 (phonetic バツ) — the gate only insiders pass: faction, clique.
閥.mnemonic: The door with an unwritten guest list — バツ. 財閥: the zaibatsu conglomerates.

伴.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 半 (phonetic ハン) — one's other half on the road: to accompany.
伴.mnemonic: The half that walks beside — ともなう. 伴奏: the accompaniment, musical or marital.

帆.etymology: Phono-semantic: cloth (巾) + 凡 (phonetic ハン) — the wind-cloth: sail.
帆.mnemonic: Cloth doing the engine's job — ほ. 出帆: setting sail.

搬.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 般 (phonetic ハン) — moved by hand and boat: to transport.
搬.mnemonic: The moving crew's kanji — ハン. 運搬: haulage, invoiced.

畔.etymology: Phono-semantic: field (田) + 半 (phonetic ハン) — the dividing ridge: levee; the water's edge (湖畔).
畔.mnemonic: The walkable line between paddies — ハン. 湖畔: the lakeside hotel's word.

繁.etymology: Compound: threads multiplying every (毎) which way — thriving thick: flourishing, busy.
繁.mnemonic: Growth outpacing the pruning — ハン. 繁華街: downtown at full leaf.

藩.etymology: Phono-semantic: hedge (艹) + a phonetic (ハン) — the fenced fief: the Edo domain: han.
藩.mnemonic: The hedge around a daimyo's map square — ハン. 藩: every samurai drama's political unit.

範.etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + a phonetic (ハン) — the bamboo mold: model, scope (範囲).
範.mnemonic: The template everyone traces — ハン. 模範 and 師範: the model, and your gym leaders 師範.

煩.etymology: Compound ideograph: fire (火) at the head (頁) — the burning head: vexation.
煩.mnemonic: A head on low boil — わずらう. 煩悩: the 108 desires the New Year bell strikes away.

頒.etymology: Phono-semantic: 分 (phonetic ハン) + 頁 — dealt out per head: to distribute.
頒.mnemonic: One share per head, official — ハン. 頒布: the handout word.

盤.etymology: Phono-semantic: 般 (phonetic バン) + dish (皿) — the broad flat base: tray, board, disc.
盤.mnemonic: The surface games are played on — バン. 基盤: the foundation board; 円盤: the disc.

蛮.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 蠻): a phonetic + 虫 — the old slur for southern peoples: barbarian.
蛮.mnemonic: History's rude label, kanji form — バン. 南蛮: the 'southern barbarian' trade era — and the chicken dish.

卑.etymology: Pictograph: a hand with a menial's ladle — low station: base, vulgar; humble (卑下).
卑.mnemonic: The task nobody thanks — いやしい. 卑怯: base and cowardly, the playground verdict.

lesson_examples.jp: 卑（いや）しい　こころです。

妃.etymology: Phono-semantic: woman (女) + 己 (phonetic ヒ) — the sovereign's consort: princess, queen.
妃.mnemonic: The crown's other half — ヒ. 妃殿下: Her Highness.

扉.etymology: Phono-semantic: door (戸) + 非 (phonetic ヒ) — the swinging leaves: door panel; a book's title page.
扉.mnemonic: The door with wings — とびら. 扉を開く: every chapter one's first line.

披.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 皮 (phonetic ヒ) — peeled open: to unveil.
披.mnemonic: The cover pulled back for the audience — ヒ. 披露宴: the wedding unveiling banquet.

泌.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 必 (phonetic ヒツ) — seeping without fail: to secrete.
泌.mnemonic: The slow guaranteed drip — ヒ. 分泌: glands at work.

碑.etymology: Phono-semantic: stone (石) + 卑 (phonetic ヒ) — the standing inscribed stone: stele.
碑.mnemonic: Stone that remembers so we can forget — ヒ. 記念碑: the plaza's memory.

罷.etymology: Compound: the able beast (能) caught in the net (罒) — worn out, removed: to dismiss.
罷.mnemonic: Talent, netted and retired — ヒ. 罷免: the dismissal decree.

避.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 辟 (phonetic ヒ) — stepping out of the path: to avoid.
避.mnemonic: The sidestep perfected — さける. 避難: evacuation — avoidance at scale.

尾.etymology: Compound ideograph: fur (毛) at the body's end (尸) — the tail; the tail end (末尾).
尾.mnemonic: The body's punctuation — お. 尾行: tailing someone, detective-style.

微.etymology: Compound: motion nearly imperceptible — minute, faint.
微.mnemonic: Visible only if you already knew — ビ. 微妙: the untranslatable shrug; 微笑: the faint smile.

眉.etymology: Pictograph: the brow drawn above the eye (目) — eyebrow.
眉.mnemonic: The eye wearing its accent mark — まゆ. 眉をひそめる: the brow's opinion.

姫.etymology: Compound: the noble lady attended (臣) — princess.
姫.mnemonic: The one everyone bows toward — ひめ. 姫路城: the White Heron castle of the princess.

漂.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 票 (phonetic ヒョウ) — carried on the current: to drift; bleaching in water (漂白).
漂.mnemonic: The message bottle's itinerary — ただよう. 漂流: adrift, novel-length.

描.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 苗 (phonetic ビョウ) — lines planted on paper: to draw, describe.
描.mnemonic: Seedlings of ink in neat rows — えがく. 描く: painters and novelists share it.

苗.etymology: Compound ideograph: young plants (艹) in the field (田) — seedlings; the family 'seedling': surname (苗字).
苗.mnemonic: The nursery rows before transplanting — なえ. 苗字: your family's sprout-name.

浜.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 濱): water (氵) + a phonetic — the shore: beach.
浜.mnemonic: Where the water stations its troops — はま. 横浜: the sideways beach, now a port city.

賓.etymology: Compound: the guest received under the roof with gifts (貝) — honored guest.
賓.mnemonic: The visitor the good china comes out for — ヒン. 来賓: the front-row guests.

頻.etymology: Compound: the head turning at every step — again and again: frequent.
頻.mnemonic: Checking the phone every three paces — ヒン. 頻繁: the notification frequency.

敏.etymology: Compound: responding at every (毎) prompt (攵) — quick: agile, sharp.
敏.mnemonic: The reflex that answers before the question ends — ビン. 敏感: sensitivity dialed up.

瓶.etymology: Phono-semantic: 并 (phonetic ビン) + 瓦 'earthenware' — the ceramic vessel: bottle, jar.
瓶.mnemonic: Pottery gone glass — びん. 瓶ビール: the proper way, some insist.

扶.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 夫 (phonetic フ) — the supporting arm: to assist.
扶.mnemonic: The arm under the elbow — フ. 扶養: dependents, legally leaning.

敷.etymology: Phono-semantic: 尃 'spread' (phonetic フ) + 攵 — laid out flat: to spread, lay.
敷.mnemonic: The futon unrolled, the rails laid — しく. 敷金: the deposit spread under your lease.

腐.etymology: Phono-semantic: 府 (phonetic フ) + meat (肉) — flesh in storage too long: to rot; fermented on purpose: 豆腐.
腐.mnemonic: The warehouse smell — くさる. 豆腐: rot, domesticated into dinner.

譜.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 普 (phonetic フ) — the systematic record: score, genealogy.
譜.mnemonic: Music written so anyone can replay it — フ. 楽譜: the sheet on the stand.

賦.etymology: Phono-semantic: money (貝) + 武 (phonetic フ) — exacted by force: levy; allotted by heaven: gift (天賦); the classical ode.
賦.mnemonic: What's taken, and what's granted — フ. 月賦: the installment plan.

赴.etymology: Phono-semantic: run (走) + 卜 (phonetic フ) — hastening to the post: to proceed.
赴.mnemonic: Orders in hand, already moving — おもむく. 赴任: the job posting journey.

附.etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 付 (phonetic フ) — 付's formal double: attached, appended.
附.mnemonic: 付 with legal letterhead — フ. 附属: the attached school.

侮.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 毎 (phonetic ブ) — looked down on: to despise.
侮.mnemonic: Dismissed daily — あなどる. 侮る: the mistake before every upset victory.

伏.etymology: Compound ideograph: a person down like a dog (犬) at heel — bent low: to crouch, hide.
伏.mnemonic: Flat as a guard dog at rest — ふせる. 伏線: the plot's crouching hints.

覆.etymology: Phono-semantic: cover (覀) + 復 (phonetic フク) — turned over upon: to cover; turned right over: to capsize, overturn (a ruling).
覆.mnemonic: The lid that flips — おおう, くつがえす. 覆す: verdicts and boats.

噴.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 賁 (phonetic フン) — bursting out: to spout.
噴.mnemonic: The earth clearing its throat — ふく. 噴火: the volcano verb.

墳.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 賁 (phonetic フン) — the raised burial mound: tumulus.
墳.mnemonic: The keyhole hills of old Japan — フン. 古墳: the kofun era's namesake.

憤.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 賁 (phonetic フン) — the heart bursting: indignation.
憤.mnemonic: The pressure valve of principle — いきどおる. 憤慨: fury with footnotes.

紛.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 分 (phonetic フン) — threads divided every way: tangled, confused.
紛.mnemonic: The drawer of indistinguishable cables — まぎれる. 紛争: conflict — nations tangled.

雰.etymology: Phono-semantic: weather (雨) + 分 (phonetic フン) — the diffused air: atmosphere.
雰.mnemonic: Weather you feel indoors — フン. 雰囲気: the room's invisible weather.

丙.etymology: Pictograph: an altar stand — third of the ordinal signs (甲乙丙): grade C.
丙.mnemonic: After A and B — ヘイ. 丙: the report card's gentle euphemism.

併.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 并 (phonetic ヘイ) — brought side by side: to merge.
併.mnemonic: Two companies, one letterhead — あわせる. 合併: the merger headline.

lesson_examples.jp: ふたつの　会（かい）が　合（がっ）併（ぺい）します。

塀.etymology: A kokuji: earth (土) + screen — the property wall: fence.
塀.mnemonic: The wall you chat over or don't — へい. 塀: suburbia's kanji.

幣.etymology: Phono-semantic: 敝 (phonetic ヘイ) + cloth (巾) — the offering cloth; cloth as currency: money (貨幣).
幣.mnemonic: Cloth that became cash — ヘイ. 紙幣: the paper bill.

弊.etymology: Phono-semantic: 敝 'worn out' (phonetic ヘイ) + hands — worn practices: evils; worn-down humility: our (弊社).
弊.mnemonic: The threadbare habits — ヘイ. 弊社: 'our shabby company' — business keigo.

柄.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 丙 (phonetic ヘイ) — the tool's grip: handle; one's grip on character: nature, pattern (柄).
柄.mnemonic: The handle and the pattern on it — がら. 人柄: a person's grain.

癖.etymology: Phono-semantic: 疒 + 辟 (phonetic ヘキ) — the ingrown tendency: habit, kink.
癖.mnemonic: The tic filed under chronic — くせ. 口癖: the phrase you can't stop saying.

偏.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 扁 (phonetic ヘン) — leaning to one side: biased.
偏.mnemonic: The scale with a thumb on it — かたよる. 偏見: the tilted view.

lesson_examples.jp: 食（しょく）事（じ）が　偏（かたよ）って　います。

遍.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 扁 (phonetic ヘン) — gone the whole round: everywhere; a full round: once (一遍).
遍.mnemonic: Every door on the route knocked — ヘン. 普遍: the universal.

舗.etymology: Phono-semantic: building + 甫 (phonetic ホ) — the laid-out storefront: shop; laid flat: paved (舗装).
舗.mnemonic: The frontage with wares laid out — ホ. 店舗 and 舗装: shops and the asphalt to reach them.

穂.etymology: Phono-semantic: grain (禾) + 恵 (phonetic スイ→ほ) — the laden head of the stalk: ear.
穂.mnemonic: The stalk's payout, bowing — ほ. 稲穂: the golden autumn nod.

慕.etymology: Phono-semantic: 莫 (phonetic ボ) + heart below — the heart reaching after: to yearn, adore.
慕.mnemonic: Longing that outlasts the sunset — したう. 慕う: how disciples and orphans love.

簿.etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo slips (⺮) + a phonetic (ボ) — the bound record: ledger.
簿.mnemonic: The book every name ends up in — ボ. 名簿: the roll call list.

倣.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 放 (phonetic ホウ) — following the model: to imitate.
倣.mnemonic: Copying the master's release — ならう. 模倣: imitation, the first apprenticeship.

俸.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 奉 (phonetic ホウ) — the servant's allotted pay: stipend.
俸.mnemonic: Service, salaried — ホウ. 俸給: the official pay slip.

奉.etymology: Compound: both hands raising the offering — to present reverently: to dedicate, serve.
奉.mnemonic: Lifted higher than your own head — たてまつる. 奉仕: service, bowed.

lesson_examples.jp: かみさまに　奉（たてまつ）ります。
lesson_examples.en: I offer it to the god.

峰.etymology: Phono-semantic: mountain (山) + 夆 (phonetic ホウ) — the meeting point of slopes: peak.
峰.mnemonic: Where all the ridgelines agree — みね. 連峰: the range's skyline.

崩.etymology: Phono-semantic: mountain (山) + 朋 (phonetic ホウ) — the slope letting go: to collapse; an emperor's death (崩御).
崩.mnemonic: The mountain resigns — くずれる. 崩壊: collapse, structural or emotional.

泡.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 包 (phonetic ホウ) — water wrapping air: bubbles.
泡.mnemonic: Air in tiny water parcels — あわ. 泡: beer's crown, bath's blanket.

砲.etymology: Phono-semantic: stone (石) + 包 (phonetic ホウ) — the stone-thrower grown up: cannon.
砲.mnemonic: Wrapped stone, delivered far — ホウ. 大砲: the artillery kanji.

縫.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + a phonetic (ホウ) — thread meeting cloth: to stitch.
縫.mnemonic: The needle's dotted path — ぬう. 縫う: hems and stitches, surgical included.

胞.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 包 'wrap' (phonetic ホウ) — the body's wrapping: placenta; life's wrapped units: cells (細胞).
胞.mnemonic: Flesh in its original packaging — ホウ. 細胞: biology's smallest room.

芳.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 方 (phonetic ホウ) — fragrance on the air: sweet-smelling; honorific 'your' (芳名).
芳.mnemonic: The scent that arrives before the garden — かんばしい. 芳名帳: the guest book's flattery.

褒.etymology: Phono-semantic: robe (衣) + 保 (phonetic ホウ) — the robe of honor conferred: to praise.
褒.mnemonic: Wrapped in the commendation — ほめる. 褒める: the teacher's best tool.

邦.etymology: Compound: the planted land (丰) with its borders (阝) — the state: one's country; domestic (邦画).
邦.mnemonic: The fields inside our border — ホウ. 邦画: homegrown cinema.

飽.etymology: Phono-semantic: food (飠) + 包 (phonetic ホウ) — full to wrapping: satiated; too full of it: bored (飽きる).
飽.mnemonic: The last bite you didn't want — あきる. 飽きた: hobby graveyard's epitaph.

乏.etymology: Ideograph: 正 reversed in the old script — off the proper path: lacking: scarce.
乏.mnemonic: The pantry echo — とぼしい. 貧乏: scarcity squared.

lesson_examples.jp: 経（けい）験（けん）が　乏（とぼ）しいです。

傍.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 旁 (phonetic ボウ) — the one at the side: nearby, bystander.
傍.mnemonic: Present, not involved — かたわら. 傍観: watching from the rail.

lesson_examples.jp: 道（みち）の　傍（かたわ）らに　花（はな）が　さいて　います。
lesson_examples.en: Flowers are blooming by the roadside.

剖.etymology: Phono-semantic: 咅 (phonetic ボウ) + blade (刂) — opened by the knife: to dissect.
剖.mnemonic: The careful opening — ボウ. 解剖: anatomy's front door.

lesson_examples.jp: 医者（いしゃ）が 解剖（かいぼう）を します。

妨.etymology: Phono-semantic: 女 + 方 (phonetic ボウ) — standing in the way: to hinder.
妨.mnemonic: The obstacle with opinions — さまたげる. 妨害: interference, flagged.

房.etymology: Phono-semantic: door (戸) + 方 (phonetic ボウ) — the side chamber: room; hanging clusters: tassel, bunch (of grapes).
房.mnemonic: Rooms and grape clusters: things that hang together — ふさ. 暖房: the heated chamber.

某.etymology: Originally the plum tree; borrowed forever for the unnamed: a certain someone.
某.mnemonic: Name withheld, tree remembered — ボウ. 某社: 'a certain company' — journalism's shield.

冒.etymology: Compound: pushing ahead with eyes covered (helmet over eye) — to defy: risk; the pushing-in opening: 冒頭.
冒.mnemonic: Visor down, into it anyway — おかす. 冒険: adventure — risk with a backpack.

紡.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 方 (phonetic ボウ) — fiber twisted to thread: to spin.
紡.mnemonic: The wheel turning fluff into line — つむぐ. 紡績: the mill industry.

肪.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 方 (phonetic ボウ) — the body's stored fat.
肪.mnemonic: The reserves nobody ordered — ボウ. 脂肪: the health-check line item.

膨.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 彭 (phonetic ボウ) — drumming outward: to expand.
膨.mnemonic: Inflating like a struck drum — ふくらむ. 膨大: swollen to enormous.

謀.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 某 (phonetic ボウ) — plans with unnamed names: to scheme.
謀.mnemonic: Whispers about a certain someone — はかる. 陰謀: the conspiracy thread.

僕.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + a phonetic (ボク) — the manservant; humbled into the boyish 'I'.
僕.mnemonic: 'Your servant' softened into 'me' — ぼく. 僕: every male protagonist's pronoun.

lesson_examples.jp: 僕（ぼく）も　さんかします。

墨.etymology: Compound: soot (黒) pressed with earth (土) — the inkstick: India ink.
墨.mnemonic: Ground soot, the calligrapher's fuel — すみ. 墨: what 書 runs on.

撲.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + a phonetic (ボク) — the striking blow: to beat.
撲.mnemonic: The open-palm impact — ボク. 相撲: sumo — mutual striking, ritualized.

朴.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 卜 (phonetic ボク) — unworked timber: plain, artless.
朴.mnemonic: The log before opinions — ボク. 素朴: simplicity, unsanded.

睦.etymology: Phono-semantic: eye (目) + 坴 (phonetic ボク) — eyes meeting kindly: friendly.
睦.mnemonic: The gaze that means family — むつまじい. 親睦会: the bonding party.

没.etymology: Compound: pulled under the water (氵) — to sink, die (没する), be rejected (ボツ).
没.mnemonic: Under the surface, file closed — ボツ. 没: the editor's stamp on your draft.

堀.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + a phonetic (クツ→ほり) — the dug channel: moat.
堀.mnemonic: The castle's wet collar — ほり. 外堀: the outer moat — negotiate it first.

奔.etymology: Compound: a figure (大) at full sprint over grass — to dash: rush.
奔.mnemonic: Arms wide, legs blurring — ホン. 奔走: running around for someone's sake.

翻.etymology: Phono-semantic: 番 (phonetic ホン) + wings (羽) — turned over in flight: to flip; turned into another tongue: translate.
翻.mnemonic: The page turns like a wing — ひるがえる. 翻訳: the flip between languages.

凡.etymology: Pictograph: a plain tray or sail — the general run: ordinary.
凡.mnemonic: The default template — ボン. 平凡: gloriously unremarkable.

lesson_examples.jp: 平（へい）凡（ぼん）な　毎（まい）日（にち）も　いいものです。

盆.etymology: Phono-semantic: 分 (phonetic ボン) + dish (皿) — the wide shallow tray: basin; the ancestors' festival: お盆.
盆.mnemonic: The tray that carries offerings home — ボン. お盆: August's homecoming.

摩.etymology: Phono-semantic: 麻 (phonetic マ) + hand (手) — hand against surface: friction.
摩.mnemonic: Skyscrapers rub the sky — マ. 摩天楼: the sky-chafing towers.

魔.etymology: Phono-semantic: 麻 (phonetic マ) + 鬼 — from Sanskrit māra: the demon: devil, magic (魔法).
魔.mnemonic: The ghost in the hemp field — マ. 魔法: magic; 魔王: every RPG's final boss.

麻.etymology: Compound: fiber plants drying under the shed (广) — hemp; numbing (麻酔, from the plant's cousin).
麻.mnemonic: Stalks hung in the shade — あさ. 麻酔: anesthesia — hemp's medical echo.

膜.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 莫 (phonetic マク) — the thin covering layer: membrane.
膜.mnemonic: The body's plastic wrap — マク. 鼓膜: the eardrum — 鼓 included.

又.etymology: Pictograph: the right hand — borrowed since oracle bones for 'again, also'.
又.mnemonic: The hand that comes back for more — また. 又は: 'or' — the form's favorite.

lesson_examples.jp: 又（また）　あいましょう。

抹.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 末 'powder-fine end' (phonetic マツ) — rubbed to powder: to grind; rubbed out: to erase (抹消).
抹.mnemonic: Ground to the finest end — マッ. 抹茶: the tea rubbed to dust.

繭.etymology: Compound ideograph: the worm (虫) and its thread (糸) boxed together — the cocoon.
繭.mnemonic: The silk factory, worker inside — まゆ. 繭: 糸's birthplace.

慢.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 曼 (phonetic マン) — the heart stretched slack: arrogant, sluggish.
慢.mnemonic: The heart lounging above others — マン. 我慢: dragging the slack heart into line — endurance.

漫.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 曼 (phonetic マン) — spreading unchecked: rambling; rambling pictures: 漫画.
漫.mnemonic: Ink allowed to wander — マン. 漫画: the wandering that conquered the world.

魅.etymology: Phono-semantic: 鬼 + 未 (phonetic ミ) — the spirit that bewitches: charm.
魅.mnemonic: Haunted, pleasantly — ミ. 魅力: the pull you can't cite.

岬.etymology: Phono-semantic: mountain (山) + 甲 (phonetic コウ→みさき) — the armored point into the sea: cape.
岬.mnemonic: The land's last argument with the ocean — みさき. 岬: lighthouse real estate.

妙.etymology: Phono-semantic: 女 + 少 (phonetic ミョウ) — subtle beyond words: exquisite; oddly so: strange.
妙.mnemonic: Fineness one hair from weird — ミョウ. 微妙 vs 絶妙: the knife edge between.

矛.etymology: Pictograph: the hooked thrusting lance — the halberd of 矛盾's famous paradox.
矛.mnemonic: The spear that pierces everything, per its seller — ほこ. 矛盾: the spear meets the shield.

霧.etymology: Phono-semantic: weather (雨) + 務 (phonetic ム) — the grounded cloud: fog.
霧.mnemonic: Weather doing overtime at ground level — きり. 霧: the mountain road's boss fight.

婿.etymology: Phono-semantic: 女 + 胥 (phonetic セイ→むこ) — the man who joins her family: son-in-law.
婿.mnemonic: The groom who changes registers — むこ. 花婿: the bride's counterpart.

銘.etymology: Compound: the name (名) cut in metal (金) — the maker's signature: inscription; taken to heart (肝に銘じる).
銘.mnemonic: The name that outlives the namer — メイ. 銘柄: the brand on the blade or bottle.

滅.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 烕 'fire quenched' (phonetic メツ) — put out utterly: to perish.
滅.mnemonic: Fire, water and blade in one verdict — ほろびる. 滅びる: empires' final verb; 全集中… the demon-slaying one too.

免.etymology: Pictograph: the rabbit-figure slipping the snare — let off: exemption, license (免許).
免.mnemonic: Out of the trap, papers stamped — メン. 免許: licensed to escape scrutiny; ごめん: your daily 免.

lesson_examples.jp: 運（うん）転（てん）免（めん）許（きょ）を　とります。

茂.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 戊 (phonetic モ) — growth run riot: lush.
茂.mnemonic: The garden reclaiming the path — しげる. 茂み: where the ball disappears.

妄.etymology: Phono-semantic: 亡 (phonetic モウ) + 女 — sense gone missing: reckless fancy: delusion.
妄.mnemonic: Reason left the building — モウ. 妄想: the fan-fiction of the mind.

猛.etymology: Phono-semantic: beast (犭) + 孟 (phonetic モウ) — the alpha animal: ferocious.
猛.mnemonic: The firstborn hound of the pack — モウ. 猛暑: summer, fanged.

盲.etymology: Compound ideograph: the eye (目) lost (亡) — blind; unseeing spots (盲点).
盲.mnemonic: Sight, absent — モウ. 盲点: where even good eyes are 盲.

網.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 罔 (phonetic モウ) — the woven mesh: net, network.
網.mnemonic: Thread crossed until nothing slips through — あみ. 網羅: coverage, fisherman-grade.

耗.etymology: Phono-semantic: plow (耒) + 毛 (phonetic モウ) — worn thin as hair: to wear away.
耗.mnemonic: Ground down to fuzz — モウ. 消耗: batteries and morale.

黙.etymology: Phono-semantic: 黒 (phonetic モク) + 犬 — the dog that doesn't bark: silence.
黙.mnemonic: The black dog says nothing — だまる. 沈黙: the loudest kanji pair.

紋.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 文 'pattern' (phonetic モン) — the woven emblem: crest.
紋.mnemonic: The pattern that names the clan — モン. 家紋 and 指紋: crests of house and fingertip.

冶.etymology: Phono-semantic: 冫 (from molten flow) + 台 (phonetic ヤ) — ore melted and worked: smelting.
冶.mnemonic: The forge where metal learns manners — ヤ. 冶金: metallurgy's kanji.

弥.etymology: Phono-semantic: bow (弓) + a phonetic (ミ/ヤ) — stretched further: increasingly; the auspicious 弥 of 弥生.
弥.mnemonic: Drawn a notch further each time — や. 弥生: March — spring, all the more.

厄.etymology: Compound: pinned under the cliff — calamity: bad luck.
厄.mnemonic: The boulder with your name on it — ヤク. 厄年: the unlucky years the shrine warns about.

lesson_examples.jp: これは　厄（やく）です。

躍.etymology: Phono-semantic: foot (足) + 翟 (phonetic ヤク) — springing like a pheasant: to leap.
躍.mnemonic: Feet with flight plans — おどる. 活躍: leaping large on the field.

柳.etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + 卯 (phonetic リュウ) — the trailing tree: willow.
柳.mnemonic: Hair down to the river — やなぎ. 柳: the ghost story's favorite tree.

愉.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 兪 (phonetic ユ) — the heart lightened: joy.
愉.mnemonic: The heart with the day off — ユ. 愉快: fun, certified.

癒.etymology: Phono-semantic: 疒 + 兪 (phonetic ユ) — illness carried away: to heal.
癒.mnemonic: The sickbed emptying — いやす. 癒し: the spa industry's kanji.

諭.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 兪 (phonetic ユ) — guiding words: to admonish, instruct.
諭.mnemonic: The lecture with your interests at heart — さとす. 諭吉: Fukuzawa, on the old ¥10,000.

唯.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 隹 (phonetic ユイ) — the single assent: only.
唯.mnemonic: One bird, one word — ただ. 唯一: the only one, doubly stated.

幽.etymology: Compound: threads lost in the mountain — dim, hidden: secluded; the dim world: ghosts (幽霊).
幽.mnemonic: Barely there between the peaks — ユウ. 幽霊: the resident of dimness.

悠.etymology: Phono-semantic: 攸 (phonetic ユウ) + heart (心) — the heart given room: far, unhurried.
悠.mnemonic: Time measured in horizons — ユウ. 悠々: strolling through eternity.

憂.etymology: Pictograph: the mourner walking head-down, heart heavy — grief: melancholy.
憂.mnemonic: The slow walk of worry — うれい. 憂鬱: the heaviest word in the mood diary.

湧.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 勇 (phonetic ユウ) — springing from below: to gush.
湧.mnemonic: Courage and springs share plumbing — わく. 湧き水: the mountain's free fountain.

猶.etymology: Originally a hesitant monkey-beast — pausing: still, yet; the granted pause: 猶予.
猶.mnemonic: The animal that waits and watches — ユウ. 執行猶予: the suspended sentence.

裕.etymology: Phono-semantic: garment (衤) + 谷 (phonetic ユウ) — robes with room to spare: affluence.
裕.mnemonic: Clothes a size beyond need — ユウ. 余裕: slack in the budget and the soul.

誘.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 秀 (phonetic ユウ) — drawn along by words: to invite, lure.
誘.mnemonic: The pitch you follow outside — さそう. 誘惑: temptation with a schedule.

雄.etymology: Phono-semantic: 厷 (phonetic ユウ) + bird (隹) — the cock bird: male; the grand: heroic (英雄).
雄.mnemonic: The rooster posture — おす. 英雄: the hero — flower plus rooster, oddly perfect.

融.etymology: Phono-semantic: cauldron (鬲) + 虫 (phonetic ユウ) — melted to flowing: to fuse; flowing money: finance (金融).
融.mnemonic: Solid to liquid, assets included — ユウ. 金融: money in its liquid state.

誉.etymology: Phono-semantic (simplified from 譽): lifted words (言) — acclaim: honor.
誉.mnemonic: Your name, carried overhead — ほまれ. 名誉: the honor roll.

庸.etymology: Compound: steady usable service (用) — ordinary, middling; employment (登庸).
庸.mnemonic: Perfectly adequate, on schedule — ヨウ. 中庸: the golden mean.

揚.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 昜 (phonetic ヨウ) — raised high: to hoist; raised in oil: to deep-fry (唐揚げ).
揚.mnemonic: Flags up, chicken in — あげる. 揚げ物: hoisted from the fryer.

揺.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + a phonetic (ヨウ) — rocked back and forth: to sway.
揺.mnemonic: The train's lullaby — ゆれる. 揺れる: earthquakes and resolve.

擁.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 雍 (phonetic ヨウ) — arms around: to embrace, back (a candidate).
擁.mnemonic: The endorsement, physically — ヨウ. 擁護: defense by embrace.

窯.etymology: Compound: the fire-hole (穴) roasting within — the potter's kiln.
窯.mnemonic: The cave that bakes bowls — かま. 窯元: the pottery's source.

謡.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + a phonetic (ヨウ) — the sung word: ballad, chant.
謡.mnemonic: Words carried on melody — うたい. 民謡: the folk songbook.

抑.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 卬 (phonetic ヨク) — pressed down: to suppress.
抑.mnemonic: The lid held on the pot — おさえる. 抑える: prices, tempers, sneezes.

翼.etymology: Phono-semantic: feathers (羽) + 異 (phonetic ヨク) — the paired spans: wings.
翼.mnemonic: 羽's full wingspan edition — つばさ. 左翼・右翼: politics borrowed both.

羅.etymology: Compound: the bird-net of fine thread — gauze; spread out: array (羅列); phonetic ラ (羅馬).
羅.mnemonic: The net fine enough for songbirds — ラ. 網羅 completes the sweep.

裸.etymology: Phono-semantic: garment (衤) + 果 (phonetic ラ) — stripped to the fruit: bare.
裸.mnemonic: The clothes left with the peel — はだか. 裸: the onsen dress code.

雷.etymology: Compound: the storm (雨) rolling over the fields (田) — thunder.
雷.mnemonic: The sky's drum solo over the paddies — かみなり. 雷: Pikachu's element, formally.

酪.etymology: Phono-semantic: jar (酉) + 各 (phonetic ラク) — fermented milk: dairy.
酪.mnemonic: The jar full of the herd's output — ラク. 酪農: Hokkaido's industry.

嵐.etymology: Compound ideograph: mountain (山) + wind (風) — the mountain gale: storm.
嵐.mnemonic: Wind with terrain advantage — あらし. 嵐: the weather and the boy band.

欄.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 闌 (phonetic ラン) — the railing; the ruled space: column, form field.
欄.mnemonic: The fenced box on the form — ラン. 空欄: the blank that fails you.

濫.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 監 (phonetic ラン) — past the brim: to flood; excess (濫用).
濫.mnemonic: The supervisor arrives too late — ラン. 氾濫: the river filing overtime.

藍.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 監 (phonetic ラン) — the dye plant: indigo.
藍.mnemonic: The vat that blued all of Japan — あい. 青は藍より出でて: the student surpasses the master.

吏.etymology: Compound: the record-keeper (史) in service — the functionary: official.
吏.mnemonic: The clerk the empire runs on — リ. 官吏: officialdom's old name.

履.etymology: Compound: the body's repeated steps (復) — footwear; the steps taken: to fulfill (履行), one's record (履歴).
履.mnemonic: Where your shoes have been is your résumé — はく. 履歴書: your footprints, formatted.

璃.etymology: Phono-semantic: jade (王) + 离 (phonetic リ) — from Sanskrit vaiḍūrya via 瑠璃: lapis, glass.
璃.mnemonic: The blue stone in temple names — リ. 瑠璃: lapis — heaven's glass.

痢.etymology: Phono-semantic: 疒 + 利 'flowing sharp' (phonetic リ) — the illness that runs: dysentery.
痢.mnemonic: The sickness with 利's speed — リ. 下痢: the traveler's dread.

離.etymology: Phono-semantic: 离 (phonetic リ) + bird (隹) — the bird slipping the net: to separate, leave.
離.mnemonic: The bird and the net, parting company — はなれる. 距離 and 離婚: distances physical and marital.

硫.etymology: Phono-semantic: stone (石) + a phonetic (リュウ) — the yellow flowing mineral: sulfur.
硫.mnemonic: The rock that smells like onsen — リュウ. 硫黄: sulfur — hot springs' signature.

隆.etymology: Compound: rising (生) even as the slope descends — swelling high: prosperity.
隆.mnemonic: The bulge in the graph — リュウ. 隆盛: the boom years.

竜.etymology: Pictograph (simplified from 龍): the coiled horned dragon — dragon; the imperial beast.
竜.mnemonic: The serpent that owns the waterfall — りゅう. 竜: your 滝 kanji's roommate; 恐竜: the fossil kind.

慮.etymology: Phono-semantic: 虍 (phonetic リョ) + 思 — thinking ahead of the tiger: deliberation.
慮.mnemonic: Thought with claws in view — リョ. 遠慮: prudence worn as politeness.

虜.etymology: Compound: strength (力) taken under the tiger (虍) — the prisoner: captive.
虜.mnemonic: Caught in the striped shadow — リョ. 捕虜: the POW term.

僚.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 尞 (phonetic リョウ) — those at the same fire: colleagues.
僚.mnemonic: Same torch, same shift — リョウ. 同僚: the desk neighbors.

lesson_examples.jp: 同（どう）僚（りょう）と　昼（ひる）ごはんを　食（た）べます。
lesson_examples.en: I eat lunch with my colleagues.

寮.etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 尞 (phonetic リョウ) — shared quarters: dorm.
寮.mnemonic: One roof, many alarm clocks — リョウ. 寮生活: dorm life.

lesson_examples.jp: ここは　寮（りょう）です。

猟.etymology: Phono-semantic: hound (犭) + a phonetic (リョウ) — the chase with dogs: hunting.
猟.mnemonic: The season the hounds wait for — リョウ. 猟師: the licensed hunter.

瞭.etymology: Phono-semantic: eye (目) + 尞 'torchlight' (phonetic リョウ) — seen by full light: clear.
瞭.mnemonic: Torch up, doubt gone — リョウ. 明瞭: clarity, certified; 一目瞭然: obvious at a glance.

糧.etymology: Phono-semantic: rice (米) + 量 (phonetic リョウ) — measured food for the road: provisions.
糧.mnemonic: Rations counted before the march — かて. 食糧: the national stockpile word.

陵.etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 夌 (phonetic リョウ) — the great tomb hill: imperial mausoleum.
陵.mnemonic: The hill with an emperor inside — リョウ. 御陵: the kofun's formal name.

倫.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 侖 'order' (phonetic リン) — the order among people: ethics.
倫.mnemonic: Human relations, shelved properly — リン. 倫理: the ethics course.

lesson_examples.jp: 倫（りん）理（り）を　学（まな）びます。

厘.etymology: Measure character: one-thousandth — the old fraction: rin.
厘.mnemonic: The coin too small to drop — リン. 九分九厘: 99.9% sure.

隣.etymology: Phono-semantic: mound (阝) + 粦 (phonetic リン) — the next settlement over: adjacent.
隣.mnemonic: One wall shared, everything else negotiated — となり. 隣人: the neighbor.

瑠.etymology: Phono-semantic: jade (王) + 留 (phonetic ル) — the 瑠 of 瑠璃: lapis lazuli.
瑠.mnemonic: Blue held (留) in stone — ル. 瑠璃色: the deepest temple blue.

塁.etymology: Compound: earthworks piled — ramparts; baseball's bases (一塁).
塁.mnemonic: The diamond's four little forts — ルイ. 満塁: bases loaded.

累.etymology: Compound: threads (糸) strung field on field (田) — piled up: cumulative; entangling (累が及ぶ).
累.mnemonic: Interest on interest — ルイ. 累計: the running total.

励.etymology: Phono-semantic: 厉 (phonetic レイ) + strength (力) — strength whetted: to strive, encourage.
励.mnemonic: The push that sharpens — はげます. 励まし: the friend's job.

鈴.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 令 (phonetic レイ) — the summoning chime: bell.
鈴.mnemonic: The bell that calls politely — すず. 鈴木: Japan's second surname, bell-tree.

隷.etymology: Compound: held under the reaching hand (隶) — bound in service: slave; the clerical script (隷書).
隷.mnemonic: The hand that never lets go of the collar — レイ. 奴隷: history's ledger of shame.

霊.etymology: Compound (simplified from 靈): the shaman calling rain — the spirit realm: soul, ghost.
霊.mnemonic: What the rain-caller talks to — レイ. 幽霊: the faint kind; 霊柩車: the hearse.

麗.etymology: Pictograph: the deer (鹿) with paired antler-ornaments — graceful: beautiful.
麗.mnemonic: The deer in earrings — うるわしい. 綺麗's formal ancestor — 華麗: gorgeous.

暦.etymology: Compound: the harvests (秝) counted in days (日) — the almanac: calendar.
暦.mnemonic: Seasons filed under dates — こよみ. 旧暦: the old lunar ledger.

劣.etymology: Compound ideograph: little (少) strength (力) — falling short: inferior.
劣.mnemonic: Effort minus wattage — おとる. 劣る: the comparison's losing side.

烈.etymology: Phono-semantic: 列 (phonetic レツ) + fire (灬) — burning in ranks: fierce, intense.
烈.mnemonic: Fire with discipline — レツ. 強烈: impact at full burn.

裂.etymology: Phono-semantic: 列 (phonetic レツ) + cloth (衣) — torn along the line: to rip.
裂.mnemonic: The seam gives way — さける. 分裂: the split, cellular or political.

廉.etymology: Phono-semantic: hall (广) + 兼 (phonetic レン) — the clean corner of the hall: integrity; honestly priced: cheap (廉価).
廉.mnemonic: Honesty reflected in the price tag — レン. 清廉: integrity, polished.

錬.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 柬 (phonetic レン) — worked in the fire: to temper, train.
錬.mnemonic: Heat, hammer, repeat — レン. 錬金術: alchemy — 鋼の錬金術師's first word.

呂.etymology: Pictograph: vertebrae stacked — the backbone; lent to 風呂's second syllable.
呂.mnemonic: Two blocks of your back — ロ. お風呂: where the spine unknots.

炉.etymology: Phono-semantic: fire (火) + 戸 (phonetic ロ) — the fire at the door of the house: hearth, furnace.
炉.mnemonic: The fire with its own door — ロ. 原子炉: the reactor — hearth, escalated.

露.etymology: Phono-semantic: rain (雨) + 路 (phonetic ロ) — moisture settled on the open road: dew; out in the open: exposed; Russia (露).
露.mnemonic: The morning's fine print on the grass — つゆ. 露天風呂: bathing under the dew's sky.

廊.etymology: Phono-semantic: hall (广) + 郎 (phonetic ロウ) — the covered passage: corridor.
廊.mnemonic: The hallway of squeaky floors — ロウ. 廊下: run and be scolded.

楼.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 娄 (phonetic ロウ) — the storied tower: watchtower.
楼.mnemonic: Floors stacked toward the view — ロウ. 摩天楼: the skyscraper, poetically.

浪.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 良 (phonetic ロウ) — the open wave: waves; adrift: wandering (浪人).
浪.mnemonic: The wave with no harbor plans — ロウ. 浪人: the masterless — samurai or exam-repeater.

漏.etymology: Compound: rain (雨) through the roof (尸) into water (氵) — seeping through: to leak.
漏.mnemonic: The drip that finds the futon — もれる. 漏れる: secrets and ceilings.

郎.etymology: Phono-semantic: 良 (phonetic ロウ) + 阝 — the young gentleman: son — the 〜郎 of a million names.
郎.mnemonic: The name-ending of firstborn sons — ロウ. 太郎, 一郎, 桃太郎: the clan of 郎.

賄.etymology: Phono-semantic: money (貝) + 有 (phonetic ワイ) — wealth passed under the table: bribery; to provide (賄う).
賄.mnemonic: The envelope with dinner inside — まかなう. 賄賂: the scandal's kanji.

惑.etymology: Phono-semantic: 或 (phonetic ワク) + heart (心) — the heart led astray: confusion, temptation.
惑.mnemonic: The compass needle spinning — まどう. 迷惑 and 惑星: nuisances, and the 'wandering stars' — planets.

枠.etymology: A kokuji — made in Japan: wood (木) + 卆 — the bounding frame: frame, quota.
枠.mnemonic: The wooden border around everything — わく. 枠: photo frames and budget frames.

挨.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + a phonetic (アイ) — pressing close; surviving almost solely in 挨拶.
挨.mnemonic: The nudge into contact — アイ. 挨拶: the greeting — this kanji's entire job.

宛.etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 夗 (phonetic エン) — directed to the house: addressed to (宛先).
宛.mnemonic: The envelope's target roof — あて. 宛名: the name on the front.

闇.etymology: Compound: sound (音) inside the shut gate (門) — where you hear but cannot see: darkness.
闇.mnemonic: Behind the closed gate, only sounds — やみ. 闇: night markets and dark webs.

椅.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 奇 (phonetic イ) — the seat with a back: chair.
椅.mnemonic: The odd (奇) tree you sit on — イ. 椅子: the chair, at last a kanji.

畏.etymology: Pictograph: a demon-masked figure — dread mixed with reverence: awe.
畏.mnemonic: Fear that bows — おそれる. 畏敬: awe — the mountain-shrine feeling.

萎.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 委 'bending' (phonetic イ) — the plant folding: to wilt.
萎.mnemonic: The bouquet giving up — なえる. 萎える: plants and motivation.

咽.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 因 (phonetic イン) — the passage below the mouth: throat.
咽.mnemonic: Where every 口's business goes next — イン. 咽喉: the ENT's territory.

淫.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + a phonetic (イン) — overflowing bounds: excess, licentious.
淫.mnemonic: The overflow nobody mentions at dinner — イン. 淫ら: the censor's kanji.

臼.etymology: Pictograph: the grinding mortar with its notched rim — mortar.
臼.mnemonic: The bowl mochi is punished in — うす. 臼: December's workout equipment.

餌.etymology: Phono-semantic: food (飠) + 耳 (phonetic ジ) — food set out for animals: bait, feed.
餌.mnemonic: Dinner with a hook in it — えさ. 餌: the aquarium's schedule.

怨.etymology: Phono-semantic: 夗 (phonetic エン) + heart (心) — the heart bent double: resentment.
怨.mnemonic: The heart that keeps receipts — うらみ. 怨霊: the grudge with an afterlife — J-horror's engine.

臆.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 意 (phonetic オク) — the chest where nerve lives (or fails): timidity; conjecture (臆測).
臆.mnemonic: The chest that hesitates — オク. 臆病: cowardice, anatomically filed.

俺.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 奄 (phonetic エン→おれ) — the blunt first person: ore.
俺.mnemonic: The pronoun with its sleeves rolled — おれ. 俺: 僕's tougher brother.

苛.etymology: Phono-semantic: 艹 + 可 (phonetic カ) — stinging like nettles: harsh; to torment (苛める).
苛.mnemonic: The nettle patch of words — いじめる. 苛立つ: nettled — irritation itself.

牙.mnemonic: The bite drawn mid-clench — きば. 牙を剝く: baring them.

崖.etymology: Phono-semantic: mountain (山) + 厓 (phonetic ガイ) — the sheer face: cliff.
崖.mnemonic: The mountain's abrupt opinion — がけ. 崖っぷち: the brink, career included.

蓋.etymology: Compound: the vessel (皿) covered over — the lid.
蓋.mnemonic: What keeps the pot honest — ふた. 蓋を開ける: finding out for real.

骸.etymology: Phono-semantic: bone (骨) + 亥 (phonetic ガイ) — what remains: the skeleton, remains.
骸.mnemonic: The frame after the story ends — ガイ. 残骸: wreckage — machines' 骸.

柿.etymology: Phono-semantic: tree (木) + a phonetic — the autumn fruit tree: persimmon.
柿.mnemonic: The orange lanterns of November — かき. 柿: temple-roof orchards.

顎.etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + head (頁) — the head's hinge: jaw.
顎.mnemonic: The part that drops in surprise — あご. 顎が外れる: laughing too hard.

葛.etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 曷 (phonetic カツ) — the smothering vine: kudzu; tangled conflict (葛藤).
葛.mnemonic: The vine that wins every negotiation — くず. 葛藤: inner kudzu.

釜.etymology: Phono-semantic: 父 (phonetic フ) + 金 — the rice cauldron: kettle.
釜.mnemonic: Dad's iron pot — かま. 釜飯: dinner cooked in the kanji.

瓦.etymology: Pictograph: roof tiles overlapping — tile; the gram, once.
瓦.mnemonic: The roof's fish scales — かわら. 瓦屋根: temple headwear.

韓.etymology: Phono-semantic: the old state name — Korea (韓国).
韓.mnemonic: The neighbor across the strait — カン. 韓国: K- everything's homeland.

玩.etymology: Phono-semantic: jade (王) + 元 (phonetic ガン) — the treasured plaything: toy (玩具).
玩.mnemonic: The gem you're allowed to touch — ガン. 玩具: the toy aisle's formal sign.

畿.etymology: Phono-semantic: 幾 (phonetic キ) + 田 — the fields around the throne: the capital region: Kinki (近畿).
畿.mnemonic: The emperor's home farmland — キ. 近畿: the Kansai region's formal name.

僅.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 堇 (phonetic キン) — barely any: merely.
僅.mnemonic: The margin you could exhale through — わずか. 僅か: victory by this much.

巾.etymology: Pictograph: cloth hanging from a belt — the cloth radical, finally solo: towel.
巾.mnemonic: The component clocking in as itself — キン. 布巾: the dish towel; 頭巾: the hood.

串.etymology: Pictograph: items pierced on a spit — the skewer, drawn exactly.
串.mnemonic: The kanji you can order grilled — くし. 串カツ: Osaka's fried proof.

窟.etymology: Phono-semantic: hole (穴) + 屈 (phonetic クツ) — the bent-into hollow: cave.
窟.mnemonic: The hole you stoop into — クツ. 洞窟: the full spelunking pair.

稽.etymology: Phono-semantic: 禾 + a phonetic (ケイ) — checking against the past: to consider; drilled repetition: 稽古.
稽.mnemonic: The dojo's word for homework — ケイ. お稽古: practice, with a bow.

詣.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 旨 (phonetic ケイ) — arriving to pay respects: pilgrimage (参詣).
詣.mnemonic: The new year's first walk — もうでる. 初詣: January 1st, nationwide.

隙.etymology: Compound: light through the wall's crack — the gap: opening.
隙.mnemonic: Where the light and the draft agree — すき. 隙間: the gap; 隙がない: no openings, fencer's praise.

桁.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 行 (phonetic コウ→けた) — the crossbeam; the abacus rod: digit, order of magnitude.
桁.mnemonic: The beam that carries place value — けた. 桁違い: off by a whole beam.

鍵.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 建 (phonetic ケン) — the turning bolt: key.
鍵.mnemonic: The metal that builds the door shut and open — かぎ. 鍵: pockets everywhere, checked twice.

舷.etymology: Phono-semantic: boat (舟) + 玄 (phonetic ゲン) — the ship's side: gunwale.
舷.mnemonic: The rail you grip in weather — ゲン. 右舷: starboard.

股.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 殳 (phonetic コ) — the leg's fork: thigh.
股.mnemonic: Where the legs disagree — また. 大股: the long stride.

乞.etymology: Pictograph: the bent figure asking — to beg, request (乞う).
乞.mnemonic: Bowed with palms out — こう. ご期待乞う: 'anticipation begged' — stay tuned.

勾.etymology: Pictograph: the hooked curve — bent: hook; detention's hook (勾留).
勾.mnemonic: The comma-shaped jewel — コウ. 勾玉: the magatama of shrines.

喉.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 侯 (phonetic コウ) — the voice's corridor: throat.
喉.mnemonic: The hall behind the mouth — のど. 喉が渇く: the corridor asking for water.

梗.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 更 (phonetic コウ) — the stiff stalk: blockage (梗塞); the outline (梗概).
梗.mnemonic: The branch stuck in the pipe — コウ. 心筋梗塞: the blockage that makes headlines.

頃.etymology: Compound: the head tilted — an inclined moment: about, around (that time).
頃.mnemonic: Time measured by a tilted head — ころ. 子供の頃: 'back around childhood'.

痕.etymology: Phono-semantic: 疒 + 艮 (phonetic コン) — the mark that stays: scar.
痕.mnemonic: The wound's stubborn signature — あと. 痕跡: the forensic trace.

挫.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 坐 (phonetic ザ) — bent under force: to sprain; spirit sprained: setback (挫折).
挫.mnemonic: The ankle and the ambition, twisted — ザ. 挫折: the comeback's prologue.

塞.etymology: Compound: the pass filled with earthworks — to block; the fort that does it (要塞).
塞.mnemonic: The corridor bricked shut — ふさぐ. 要塞: the fortress; 塞がる: schedules too.

柵.etymology: Compound: timber bound like book-slips (冊) — the palisade: fence.
柵.mnemonic: Logs lined like a shelf of books — サク. 柵: the zoo's polite boundary.

拶.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + a phonetic (サツ) — pressing near; alive only in 挨拶.
拶.mnemonic: 挨's other half — サツ. 挨拶: the pair that only works together.

斬.etymology: Compound: the axe (斤) at the execution cart (車) — to cut down: slay; strikingly fresh (斬新).
斬.mnemonic: The period drama's sound effect — きる. 斬新: an idea that cuts.

嫉.etymology: Phono-semantic: 女 + 疾 (phonetic シツ) — the burning envy: jealousy.
嫉.mnemonic: Envy at fever speed — シッ. 嫉妬: the green pair.

腫.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 重 (phonetic シュ) — flesh grown heavy: swelling.
腫.mnemonic: The lump that outweighs its neighbors — はれる. 腫瘍: the clinical term.

呪.etymology: Compound: the incanting mouth (口+兄, the speaker) — the spoken spell: curse.
呪.mnemonic: Words with malice compiled in — のろう. 呪い: J-horror's other engine.

蹴.etymology: Phono-semantic: foot (足) + 就 (phonetic シュウ) — the driving foot: to kick; to reject (蹴る).
蹴.mnemonic: The foot's veto — ける. 蹴る: balls and proposals.

拭.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 式 (phonetic ショク) — cleaned by hand: to wipe.
拭.mnemonic: The cloth pass over the counter — ふく. 拭う: tears too.

尻.etymology: Phono-semantic: body (尸) + 九 (phonetic キュウ→しり) — the rear: buttocks, tail end.
尻.mnemonic: The body's caboose — しり. 尻込み: backing out, literally.

芯.etymology: Phono-semantic: plant (艹) + 心 'heart' (phonetic シン) — the plant's heart: core, wick, pencil lead.
芯.mnemonic: The heart of the candle and the pencil — シン. 芯が強い: strong-cored.

腎.etymology: Phono-semantic: 臤 (phonetic ジン) + flesh (月) — the paired filter organs: kidneys.
腎.mnemonic: The body's loyal retainers, filtering — ジン. 腎臓: the kidney, on the chart.

裾.etymology: Phono-semantic: garment (衤) + 居 (phonetic キョ→すそ) — where the robe settles: hem; the mountain's hem (裾野).
裾.mnemonic: The garment's ground floor — すそ. 富士の裾野: Fuji's trailing hem.

凄.etymology: Phono-semantic: ice (冫) + 妻 (phonetic セイ) — chilling: dreadful; awe flipped positive: amazing (すごい).
凄.mnemonic: The shiver that became a compliment — すごい. 凄い: modern Japanese's busiest adjective.

醒.etymology: Phono-semantic: jar (酉) + 星 (phonetic セイ) — sobered from the jar: to wake, be disillusioned (覚醒).
醒.mnemonic: Stars fading, head clearing — セイ. 覚醒: full wakefulness — heroes and villains both claim it.

戚.etymology: Originally a ceremonial axe; borrowed for kin: relatives (親戚).
戚.mnemonic: The clan that shows up armed with advice — セキ. 親戚: the New Year's table.

脊.etymology: Pictograph: the ribs meeting the backbone over flesh (月) — the spine.
脊.mnemonic: The body's tent-pole — セキ. 脊椎: the vertebral column.

煎.etymology: Phono-semantic: 前 (phonetic セン) + fire (灬) — heated before serving: to roast, decoct.
煎.mnemonic: Fire under the 'before' — せんべい's first kanji. 煎茶: tea, properly brewed.

羨.etymology: Compound: drooling (次) over the sheep (羊) — wanting what's theirs: envy.
羨.mnemonic: Eyeing the neighbor's lamb dinner — うらやましい. 羨ましい: said fifty times a day.

腺.etymology: A kokuji — coined by Edo-era anatomists: flesh (月) + spring (泉) — the body's springs: glands.
腺.mnemonic: The flesh's fountains — セン. 涙腺: the tear gland — 'weak 涙腺' means you cry at commercials.

詮.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 全 (phonetic セン) — reasoned through fully: to examine; the point of it (詮).
詮.mnemonic: Talked through to the bottom — セン. 詮索: prying — examination without invitation.

膳.etymology: Phono-semantic: 月 + 善 (phonetic ゼン) — the meal served on its stand: tray; the counter for servings.
膳.mnemonic: Dinner on its own little stage — ゼン. お膳: the ryokan's presentation.

曽.etymology: Pictograph: the layered steamer pot — generational layers: great-grand (曽祖父); once before (かつて).
曽.mnemonic: One more layer back in time — ソ. 曽祖父: the great-grandfather stratum.

狙.etymology: Phono-semantic: beast (犭) + 且 (phonetic ソ) — the stalking eye: to aim.
狙.mnemonic: The crosshair with patience — ねらう. 狙い: the plan's exact center.

遡.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 朔 (phonetic ソ) — against the current: to retrace, go back to.
遡.mnemonic: Salmon-style through the timeline — さかのぼる. 遡る: history and bank statements.

痩.etymology: Phono-semantic: 疒 + 叟 (phonetic ソウ) — wasted lean: to grow thin.
痩.mnemonic: The waistline in retreat — やせる. 痩せる: January's verb.

捉.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 足 (phonetic ソク) — seized mid-stride: to capture, apprehend (meaning too).
捉.mnemonic: Hand closing on the running idea — とらえる. 捉え方: how you grip a concept.

袖.etymology: Phono-semantic: garment (衤) + 由 (phonetic ユウ→そで) — the arm's passage: sleeve.
袖.mnemonic: The garment's corridors — そで. 袖振り合うも他生の縁: even sleeves brushing is fate.

遜.etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 孫 (phonetic ソン) — stepping back like the junior generation: modest.
遜.mnemonic: Giving way as the grandchild would — ソン. 謙遜: humility, performed properly.

唾.etymology: Compound: what droops (垂) from the mouth (口) — saliva.
唾.mnemonic: The mouth's overflow valve — つば. 固唾を呑む: swallowing hard at the climax.

堆.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 隹 (phonetic タイ) — heaped up: piled (堆積).
堆.mnemonic: The sediment doing its slow paperwork — タイ. 堆積: geology's inbox.

戴.etymology: Phono-semantic: a phonetic + 異 — borne on the head: to be crowned; humbly receive (頂戴).
戴.mnemonic: Held above your own head in thanks — タイ. 頂戴: 'may I humbly have' — and toddlers' first keigo.

誰.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 隹 (phonetic スイ→だれ) — the asking word: who.
誰.mnemonic: The bird asking at the door — だれ. 誰: the question mark's favorite kanji.

綻.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 定 (phonetic タン) — the seam giving: to come apart; a smile breaking open (綻ぶ).
綻.mnemonic: The stitch that lets go, the face that opens — ほころぶ. 破綻: plans at seam-failure.

酎.etymology: Phono-semantic: jar (酉) + 寸 (phonetic チュウ) — thrice-brewed liquor: strong sake — the 酎 of 焼酎.
酎.mnemonic: The jar with a kick — チュウ. 酎ハイ: the izakaya's staple.

捗.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 歩 (phonetic チョク) — work walking forward: progress (進捗).
捗.mnemonic: The task taking actual steps — はかどる. 進捗どうですか: the manager's greeting.

潰.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 貴 (phonetic カイ) — burst and collapsed: to crush (and 潰れる, to go under).
潰.mnemonic: The dam, the shop, the plan: all 潰れる — つぶれる. 胃潰瘍's first act.

爪.etymology: Pictograph: the downward-grasping claw — nail, talon; the radical 爫's full form.
爪.mnemonic: The hand's hardware — つめ. 爪切り: Sunday's small ritual.

諦.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 帝 (phonetic テイ) — Buddhism's 'clear seeing' (諦観); seeing clearly enough to let go: あきらめる.
諦.mnemonic: Understanding so complete you release it — あきらめる. 諦め: enlightenment's practical cousin.

溺.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 弱 (phonetic デキ) — too weak against the water: to drown; drowning in pleasure: to indulge (溺愛).
溺.mnemonic: In over the head, willingly or not — おぼれる. 溺愛: love past the waterline.

貼.etymology: Phono-semantic: 貝 + 占 (phonetic チョウ) — affixed flat: to paste (貼る).
貼.mnemonic: The sticker claiming its spot (占) — はる. 貼り紙: the taped notice.

妬.etymology: Phono-semantic: 女 + 石 (phonetic ト) — the stone in the chest: envy.
妬.mnemonic: The pebble that grinds all day — ねたむ. 嫉妬's second half.

賭.etymology: Phono-semantic: money (貝) + 者 (phonetic ト) — wealth on the table: to wager.
賭.mnemonic: The shells pushed to the center — かける. 賭け: the all-in kanji.

頓.etymology: Phono-semantic: 屯 (phonetic トン) + 頁 — the head bowing at once: sudden; put in order (整頓).
頓.mnemonic: Everything drops into place at once — トン. 整理整頓: the classroom poster.

謎.etymology: Compound: words (言) that lead astray (迷) — the riddle: mystery.
謎.mnemonic: A sentence built like a maze — なぞ. 謎: every detective series' subtitle.

鍋.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 咼 (phonetic カ→なべ) — the cooking pot: pan; the communal winter meal (鍋).
鍋.mnemonic: The pot everyone's chopsticks share — なべ. 鍋: December's social contract.

匂.etymology: A kokuji — Japan's own character for scent: fragrance (匂い).
匂.mnemonic: The smell wrapped in air — におい. 匂い: bakery radius measurement.

捻.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 念 (phonetic ネン) — turned with force: to twist (捻挫: sprain).
捻.mnemonic: The wrong rotation at the wrong time — ひねる. 捻挫: the basketball injury.

罵.etymology: Phono-semantic: net (罒) + 馬 (phonetic バ) — words hurled like nets: to revile.
罵.mnemonic: Insults at cavalry volume — ののしる. 罵声: the stadium's dark side.

箸.etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 者 (phonetic チョ→はし) — the eating sticks: chopsticks.
箸.mnemonic: Bamboo's most-used descendants — はし. 箸: three billion meals a day.

斑.etymology: Compound: markings (文) between jades (王王) — mottled: spots.
斑.mnemonic: The pattern between the gems — まだら. 斑点: the leopard's syntax.

氾.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 㔾 (phonetic ハン) — over the banks: to flood (氾濫).
氾.mnemonic: The river ignoring its lane — ハン. 氾濫: the flood-warning pair.

汎.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 凡 (phonetic ハン) — spreading wide over: general: pan- (汎用).
汎.mnemonic: Flooding every use case — ハン. 汎用: general-purpose — the engineer's adjective.

膝.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 桼 (phonetic シツ) — the leg's hinge: knee.
膝.mnemonic: The joint that files complaints on stairs — ひざ. 膝: seiza's first casualty.

肘.etymology: Compound: the arm's measure-point (寸) in flesh (月) — elbow.
肘.mnemonic: The arm's hinge, table-banned — ひじ. 肘: the crowded-train weapon.

蔽.etymology: Phono-semantic: 艹 + 敝 (phonetic ヘイ) — screened from sight: to conceal (隠蔽).
蔽.mnemonic: The tarp over the evidence — ヘイ. 隠蔽: the scandal's second act.

蔑.etymology: Compound: the eye looking down past the blade — scorn: to despise (軽蔑).
蔑.mnemonic: The glance that files you under 'beneath' — さげすむ. 軽蔑: contempt, formalized.

蜂.etymology: Phono-semantic: insect (虫) + 夆 (phonetic ホウ) — the stinging swarm: bee, wasp.
蜂.mnemonic: The insect with a union and a sting — はち. 蜂蜜: the payoff.

貌.etymology: Compound: the creature's face and figure — looks: appearance (美貌, 全貌).
貌.mnemonic: The full picture, fur included — ボウ. 全貌: the whole shape of the affair.

勃.etymology: Phono-semantic: 孛 (phonetic ボツ) + 力 — bursting up: sudden outbreak (勃発).
勃.mnemonic: Zero to conflict in one stroke — ボツ. 勃発: the war correspondent's verb.

昧.etymology: Phono-semantic: sun (日) + 未 (phonetic マイ) — light not yet arrived: dim, obscure (曖昧).
昧.mnemonic: The hour before clarity — マイ. 曖昧: the fog between yes and no.

枕.etymology: Compound: the wooden headrest (木) under the sleeper (冘) — pillow.
枕.mnemonic: The tree the head trusts — まくら. 枕: rakugo's opening word, too.

蜜.etymology: Phono-semantic: 宓 (phonetic ミツ) + 虫 — the bees' hidden store: honey.
蜜.mnemonic: The insects' secret economy — ミツ. 蜂蜜: bee plus honey, the sweet pair.

冥.etymology: Compound: the sun covered over — deep dark: the netherworld (冥土); profound (冥想 via 瞑).
冥.mnemonic: Where the light doesn't file reports — メイ. 冥王星: Pluto — king of the dark.

麺.etymology: Phono-semantic: wheat (麦) + 面 (phonetic メン) — wheat drawn into strands: noodles.
麺.mnemonic: Wheat with 面's length — メン. ラーメン's last kanji, when it bothers with one.

餅.etymology: Phono-semantic: food (飠) + 并 (phonetic ヘイ→もち) — pounded rice cake: mochi.
餅.mnemonic: Rice compressed into ceremony — もち. 餅: the New Year's chewiest tradition.

妖.etymology: Phono-semantic: 女 + 夭 (phonetic ヨウ) — uncanny allure: bewitching; the spirits (妖怪).
妖.mnemonic: Beauty with an asterisk — あやしい. 妖怪: the folklore census.

沃.etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 夭 (phonetic ヨク) — well-watered: fertile (肥沃).
沃.mnemonic: Land that drinks well — ヨク. 肥沃: the farmer's favorite adjective.

侶.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 呂 (phonetic リョ) — one of a pair: companion (伴侶).
侶.mnemonic: The vertebra next to yours — リョ. 伴侶: the life partner.

賂.etymology: Phono-semantic: 貝 + 各 (phonetic ロ) — wealth routed privately: bribe — 賄's partner in 賄賂.
賂.mnemonic: Each (各) palm gets its shell — ロ. 賄賂: the corruption pair complete.

弄.etymology: Compound: the jade (王) turned in both hands (廾) — to toy with: to trifle (翻弄).
弄.mnemonic: Fate spinning you like a trinket — もてあそぶ. 翻弄: waves and romances do it.

麓.etymology: Phono-semantic: forest (林) + 鹿 (phonetic ロク) — the wooded base where deer graze: the mountain's foot.
麓.mnemonic: Where the deer wait out the altitude — ふもと. 麓: base camp's address.

脇.etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 劦 (phonetic キョウ) — the body's side: flank, armpit.
脇.mnemonic: Where the arm keeps its secrets — わき. 脇役: the supporting role, at the lead's side.

丼.etymology: Ideograph: something dropped into the well (井) — the plunk: donburi, the deep bowl.
丼.mnemonic: The well with dinner at the bottom — どんぶり. 牛丼, 親子丼: the dot is your meal.

傲.etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 敖 (phonetic ゴウ) — carrying oneself high: arrogant (傲慢).
傲.mnemonic: The chin at altitude — ゴウ. 傲慢: pride minus the earning — Silver's kanji, apparition #2.

刹.etymology: From Sanskrit kṣetra — the temple grounds (古刹); the instant (刹那).
刹.mnemonic: Sacred ground, split-second — セツ. 刹那: the moment before it's gone.

哺.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 甫 (phonetic ホ) — fed at the mouth: to nurse — 哺乳類, the mammals.
哺.mnemonic: The class of animals defined by dinner — ホ. 哺乳類: us, taxonomically.

喩.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 兪 (phonetic ユ) — meaning ferried across: metaphor (比喩).
喩.mnemonic: One thing said in another's boat — ユ. 比喩: the figure of speech.

嗅.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth/nose (口) + 臭 (phonetic キュウ) — taking the scent: to sniff.
嗅.mnemonic: The nose's active voice — かぐ. 嗅覚: the detective's sense.

嘲.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 朝 (phonetic チョウ) — the jeering mouth: to mock (嘲笑).
嘲.mnemonic: Laughter aimed, not shared — あざける. 自嘲: the mirror version.

毀.etymology: Compound: the vessel struck (殳) to pieces — to destroy; reputations too (毀損).
毀.mnemonic: The pot and the good name, both smashable — キ. 名誉毀損: defamation, legally.

彙.etymology: Originally the hedgehog — bristling with like things: collection: 語彙, vocabulary.
彙.mnemonic: The hedgehog of words, one spine each — イ. 語彙: your vocabulary count.

恣.etymology: Phono-semantic: 次 (phonetic シ) + heart (心) — the heart doing as it pleases: arbitrary (恣意的).
恣.mnemonic: Rules made of whim — シ. 恣意的: the criticism in academic reviews.

惧.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 具 (phonetic ク) — the wary heart: dread — 危惧, the feared outcome.
惧.mnemonic: The heart checking its toolkit and finding worry — ク. 危惧: endangered species' epithet.

慄.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 栗 (phonetic リツ) — trembling like a leaf: to shudder (戦慄).
慄.mnemonic: The chestnut-burr chill up the spine — リツ. 戦慄: horror's professional term.

憬.etymology: Phono-semantic: heart (忄) + 景 (phonetic ケイ) — the heart lit by a distant view: to aspire — 憧憬.
憬.mnemonic: The postcard the heart keeps — ケイ. 憧憬: longing, framed.

拉.etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 立 (phonetic ラツ/ラ) — dragged off: abduction (拉致); also ramen's 拉 (拉麺).
拉.mnemonic: Pulled off one's feet — ラ. 拉致 and 拉麺: the kanji's two very different jobs.

摯.etymology: Compound: the gift gripped (執) in both hands (手) — earnest offering: sincerity (真摯).
摯.mnemonic: Held out with both hands, no hedging — シ. 真摯: the apology adverb bosses want.

曖.etymology: Phono-semantic: sun (日) + 愛 (phonetic アイ) — the sun veiled: dim — 曖昧, ambiguity.
曖.mnemonic: Love clouding the daylight — アイ. 曖昧: the answer that isn't one.

楷.etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 皆 (phonetic カイ) — the model tree: the standard block script: 楷書.
楷.mnemonic: Kanji standing at attention — カイ. 楷書: the font you learned first.

鬱.etymology: Compound: vegetation choked dense — pent up: depression (憂鬱). Famously the hardest Jōyō kanji: 29 strokes.
鬱.mnemonic: The forest with no path out, drawn in full — ウツ. 鬱: even writing it is heavy.

璧.etymology: Phono-semantic: 辟 (phonetic ヘキ) + jade (玉) — the flawless ritual disc: perfection — 完璧.
璧.mnemonic: The jade with zero excuses — ヘキ. 完璧: note the 玉, not 土 — perfection is a jewel, not dirt.

瘍.etymology: Phono-semantic: 疒 + 昜 (phonetic ヨウ) — the festering swelling: ulcer (潰瘍).
瘍.mnemonic: The stomach's protest note — ヨウ. 胃潰瘍: stress, published internally.

箋.etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 戔 (phonetic セン) — the note slip: label — 付箋, the sticky note; 処方箋, the prescription.
箋.mnemonic: The small paper with big authority — セン. 処方箋: the pharmacy's password.

籠.etymology: Phono-semantic: bamboo (⺮) + 龍 (phonetic ロウ) — the woven cage: basket; shut inside: to seclude (籠る).
籠.mnemonic: A basket strong enough to hold a dragon — かご. 引き籠り: the self-woven basket.

緻.etymology: Phono-semantic: thread (糸) + 致 (phonetic チ) — woven to the last strand: precise — 緻密.
緻.mnemonic: Detail down to the thread count — チ. 緻密: the engineer's compliment.

羞.etymology: Compound: the offering presented — and the flush of presenting oneself: shame — 羞恥心.
羞.mnemonic: The blush at being served up — シュウ. 羞恥心: the shyness organ.

訃.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 卜 (phonetic フ) — the death notice: obituary (訃報).
訃.mnemonic: The news no one wants to deliver — フ. 訃報: the black-bordered word.

諧.etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 皆 (phonetic カイ) — voices agreeing: harmony — 俳諧, the haikai verse.
諧.mnemonic: Everyone's words in tune — カイ. 俳諧: Bashō's genre.

貪.etymology: Compound: treasure (貝) wanted now (今) — greed: to covet (貪欲).
貪.mnemonic: 'Mine, immediately' — むさぼる. 貪欲: hunger with a portfolio — also a compliment in sports.

踪.etymology: Phono-semantic: foot (足) + 宗 (phonetic ソウ) — the trail of steps: whereabouts — 失踪, vanishing.
踪.mnemonic: Footprints that stop mid-page — ソウ. 失踪: the missing-person file.

辣.etymology: Phono-semantic: 辛 'spicy' + 束 (phonetic ラツ) — heat concentrated: pungent — 辛辣, scathing.
辣.mnemonic: Spice at critique strength — ラツ. 辛辣: reviews that leave marks; 辣油: the oil version.

錮.etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 固 (phonetic コ) — sealed in metal: confinement — 禁錮, imprisonment.
錮.mnemonic: The cell door's alloy — コ. 禁錮: the sentence in years.

塡.etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 眞 (phonetic テン) — packed full: to fill — 補塡, covering a shortfall.
塡.mnemonic: The hole made whole — テン. 補塡: accounting's spackle.

頰.etymology: Phono-semantic: 夾 (phonetic キョウ) + head (頁) — the face's sides: cheeks.
頰.mnemonic: Where the face stores its blush — ほお. 頰張る: cheeks at capacity.

𠮟.etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 七 (phonetic シツ) — the sharp rebuke: to scold (𠮟る) — the Jōyō form of 叱.
𠮟.mnemonic: Seven words, all pointed — しかる. 𠮟る: firm, brief, over.

剝.etymology: Phono-semantic: 彔 (phonetic ハク) + blade (刂) — stripped away: to peel — 剝がす.
剝.mnemonic: The sticker's slow surrender — はがす. 剝離: coming apart in layers.
